descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity

We are looking for a Secondary Design Engineer to join our GIS engineering team. This role is ideal for candidates who have completed an apprenticeship (EFZ) in electrical engineering, automation, or a related discipline and have gained 2–3 years of experience in engineering design or drafting.
As part of our engineering team, you will create electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical documentation for high-voltage GIS substation projects. You will collaborate with experienced engineers, project managers, and global engineering teams while developing your expertise in engineering standards, tools, and technologies. The role offers a clear development path towards greater technical ownership and responsibility within an international engineering environment.

How you'll make an impact

• Prepare schematics and related engineering documents for GIS secondary engineering scopes, including LCC and digital substation applications
• Support engineering execution across project phases, from base design and detail design through manufacturing documentation and as-built updates
• Create preliminary BOMs, reports, and manufacturing documents using approved engineering tools and standard processes
• Perform structured self-checks and contribute to technically correct, high-quality, and standard-compliant deliverables
• Support technical clarifications with internal stakeholders, project teams, and factories, and help document and close open points
• Contribute to continuous improvement, standardization, and engineering best practices, including participation in relevant expert communities
• Apply internal guidelines, engineering standards, and quality requirements while supporting safe and efficient project execution
Your background

• Completed apprenticeship (EFZ) as an Electrical Draftsman, Automation Technician, Electrical Technician, or a comparable electrical engineering qualification
• 2–3 years of professional experience in electrical engineering design, drafting, automation, or engineering project execution
• Further education such as Technician School (HF), Technical College, or equivalent continuing education is preferred
• A Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering may be considered, but this role is intentionally targeted at technicians and engineering professionals with hands-on design experience rather than advanced academic profiles
• Good understanding of electrical engineering principles and interest in high-voltage substations and GIS technology
• Ability to read, understand, and create electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and engineering documentation
• Experience with CAD or engineering software is required
• Structured and reliable working style with attention to detail
• Good teamwork and communication skills
• Good English skills; German is an advantage
More about us

descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity

Join our collaborative OSS team and support daily IT operations close to the business. You ensure employees have reliable devices and a smooth digital workplace experience. In this hands‑on role, you learn how to troubleshoot technical issues and prepare essential IT equipment. You work closely with end users and gain valuable insights into how IT drives productivity. Throughout the 12 months internship, experienced colleagues support your growth and development.

How you'll make an impact

• Assist in troubleshooting basic IT issues, prepare laptops and other devices so they are ready for use by new or existing employees

• Support end users in navigating self‑service tools and standard IT procedures

• Assist with stock handling, asset pickup/return, and device preparation for onboarding/offboarding

• Support warranty processes by gathering information and preparing devices

• Help maintain IT equipment in meeting rooms and shared office spaces, ensuring systems operate correctly

• Update documentation related to device preparation and OSS procedures and report issues to the team.

• Be engaged in special projects where you make impact (relocating, changing office set-up, set up infrastructure, set-up of the meeting rooms)

• Be engaged in special on‑site projects, such as office relocations, changes to office layouts, infrastructure setup, and preparation or reconfiguration of meeting rooms, contributing directly to how the workplace functions

Your background

• Currently studying at a university or technical school (EFZ) in IT, computer science, engineering, or a related field

• Comfortable working with people and with following established procedures and you are passionate about making things better

• Basic understanding of computer hardware and operating systems

• Eager to learn and develop technical skills in a hands‑on environment

• Strong problem‑solving mindset and good attention to detail

• Good communication skills in English and German

More about us

We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity

Our local product group Insulation & Components is a global technology leader in the design and manufacture of high-voltage transformer bushings. Renowned international companies across the electrical industry—including power generation, transmission, and distribution—trust our solutions. We hold a leading worldwide position in high-voltage bushing technology.

To strengthen our operations, we are looking for a Tender and Quotation Specialist (commercial) to join our team at our MICAFIL bushing factory in Switzerland.
In this role, you will be part of an international team focusing on translating customer needs and challenges into competitive bids and quotations. You'll work closely with our sales and other internal teams to ensure that we offer the best solutions to meet our customers' needs around the globe.

If you are passionate about preparing tenders and bids and want to actively contribute, join our team!

How you'll make an impact

• Analyze Request for Quotations (RFQs), and other tender documents to understand client requirements, scope of work, and technical specifications with alignment with the Sales team

• Collaborate with sales, engineering, legal, and other internal departments to gather necessary information, technical details, and cost estimates for tender submissions

• Develop comprehensive and well-structured tender and quotation documents, including technical proposals, drawings, commercial offers and supporting documentation

• Ensure all submissions are accurate, complete, and meet the specified deadlines and submission protocols

• May participate in pre-bid meetings, client clarifications, and negotiations as required

• Maintain a systematic record of all tender activities, submissions, and outcomes, for quotations and order checklists preparation and handover

• Continuously improve tender processes and documentation templates to enhance efficiency and quality

• Coordinate with internal stakeholders for optimal solutions. Proactively maintain clear and structured communication with customers and the internal teams throughout the tendering process

Your background

• Technical (vocational, such as apprenticeship) or commercial education background

• Minimum of 3 years of administrative/business experience in tendering activities, quotation preparation and price calculation, or bid coordination, internal sales support, or project management within an industrial or technical environment

• Proven experience in formulating accurate bids and quotations

• Strong understanding of tender processes, contractual terms, and commercial aspects

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and experience with tender management software or CRM systems

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to details and solution-driven approach

• Fluency in English is required; proficiency in German and other languages is a plus

More about us

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it:
La possibilità

Hitachi Energy High Tensione Products è lo specialista di fama mondiale nella trasmissione e distribuzione di energia. L'unità di servizio è responsabile per il mondo dopo il supporto di vendita di sistemi di interruttori a circuito generatore (GCB) e commutatore isolato a gas (GIS) tra cui formazione, installazione e messa in servizio, manutenzione programmata, servizi aggiuntivi, risoluzione dei problemi, estensioni, conversioni e sostituzioni.

Il servizio è la chiave del successo. Come collega del nostro team di assistenza globale, apprezzi il lavoro indipendente, vario e orientato alla soluzione. Dopo una formazione pratica e versatile in Svizzera e all'estero, guiderai installazioni e manutenzione GIS in tutto il mondo. descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity
Would you like to contribute to the energy transition by helping to make the power grid smarter, more environmentally friendly, and more efficient? At Hitachi Energy, our goal is to drive a sustainable energy future for all.

As a Commercial Tendering Specialist, you will have many interesting actions on international tenders, in the field of substation automation, protection and control. You will complete bid submissions together with sales engineers, technical tendering specialists, support functions and you will drive Management approvals.

Join our great international team and participate in our successes.

How you'll make an impact

• Lead commercially large and complex tenders to completion in the field of Substation Automation Systems, Control and Protection, within Hub Europe
• Act as a tender lead, a coordinator with different stakeholders to evaluate all commercial aspects, costs and risks of the tender together with the technical tendering team and the support functions such as legal, supply chain, tax, trade compliance, treasury, finance control
• Prepare complex commercial tendering documentation and cost calculations including financial consolidations, cash flows, in a timely and efficient manner with high quality standards
• Challenge the tender's information, evaluate best project setup, scope of delivery, suitable terms and conditions for the company and support our Sales Managers up to contract negotiations
• Work closely with the Technical Bid Managers for all technical matters
• Support growth initiative and continuous improvement, conduct lessons learned reviews to drive efficiency and quality
• Provide regular feedback and productivity insights to Management
Your background

• At least 5 years' experience in Sales support, Tender Management or Project Management of international/export projects ideally in substation automation, control and protection or in the field of High Voltage substation's projects, ideally for an international OEM Company
• Bachelor or Master degree in Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering or similar
• General understanding of the commercial aspects of a tender (Legal, Tax, Credit Risk Management, Export Control, ….)
• Understanding of site workers assignments overseas, during international project, with secondment or payroll transfer a plus.
• Process-oriented profile with strategic mindset and ability to handle risk management
• A proactive and structured approach to your work, with a strong sense of responsibility
• Ability to work in multi-cultural and virtual teams, delivering results and interacting with stakeholders at all levels of the organization
• Extended communication skills in English, additional language like German, French or Spanish a plus
More about us
Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.en:

Working closely with Operations, Engineering and Quality, the role develops and industrializes solutions using manufacturing data, analytics, AI, machine learning and automation to improve yield, quality, equipment performance, productivity and manufacturing flow.

More about us

We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well-being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.

As a Technical Tendering Specialist, you will contribute to the successful acquisition of key projects within our growing Renewable and Offshore Business. Working closely with sales, engineering, project management, supply chain, and commercial teams, you will support the development of optimized customer solutions, evaluate technical and commercial risks, and help deliver high-quality proposals that drive sustainable business growth.
If you are passionate about power systems, enjoy solving technical challenges, and thrive in an international and collaborative environment, we look forward to hearing from you.

• Very good understanding of substation automation systems, protection and control solutions, and communication networks
• Basic knowledge of grid automation systems and applications
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines

• Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across global and cross-functional teams

• Eseguire test di accettazione di routine e di fabbrica (FAT) con i clienti internazionali
• Valutazione e documentazione dei risultati dei test
• Rilevazione e correzione di errori meccanici ed elettrici

Come l’unico sito di produzione mondiale per gli interruttori di circuiti generatori di Hitachi Energy, il nostro business continua a crescere. descriptionByLocale.en:
About the position
As an automated (electronic) test field, you test and document our products before delivery to customers worldwide. You perform Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) at our production site in Zurich, analyze errors and ensure that our generator circuit breakers meet the highest quality and safety requirements.

You can do that.

• Preparation and construction of test objects for conducting tests
• Performing routine and factory acceptance tests (FAT) with international customers
• Assessment and documentation of test results
• Detection and correction of mechanical and electrical errors

You bring that with you

• Basic electrotechnical training completed (e.g. automatic engineer EFZ, electrical installer EFZ)
• Experience in reading and understanding electrical schemes
• Good knowledge of German and English
• Enjoying practical troubleshooting and technical challenges

More about us
As the world’s only production site for generator circuit breakers at Hitachi Energy, our business continues to grow. That is why we are investing specifically in our infrastructure, testing technology and employees in the coming years. Exciting technical challenges, international customer contacts and the opportunity to actively shape a growing and future-proof environment await you.
descriptionByLocale.de:

Dich erwarten spannende technische Herausforderungen, internationale Kundenkontakte sowie die Möglichkeit, in einem wachsenden und zukunftssicheren Umfeld aktiv mitzugestalten.

descriptionByLocale.en:

Renowned international companies in power generation, transmission, and distribution count among our customers, and we hold a leading position in the high-voltage bushing sector worldwide.
Are you ready to dive into the world of high-voltage technology and make a real impact? Join our dynamic team and work at the forefront of innovation!

How you'll make an impact

• Use cutting-edge measuring and testing technologies to gather reliable data

• Analyze, evaluate, and document results systematically

• Collaborate on developing and optimizing test setups and methods

• Maintain order and safety in the lab by applying the 6S concept

• Consistently follow all relevant safety regulations

Your background

• Strong motivation to gain practical experience in a technical or industrial environment

• Willingness to work in a 2- or 3-shift system

Through an individual and practice-oriented onboarding plan, we help you quickly gain professional confidence and work independently with a high level of responsibility. Beyond onboarding, Hitachi Energy supports your professional growth with a wide range of learning and development opportunities, helping you achieve your career goals.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulla posizione
Assumere come canale di scanalatura Shift Leader Sei il direttore professionale del tuo turno e partecipa attivamente alla produzione. Organizza il processo quotidiano, supporta il tuo team con domande tecniche e assicurati che le date di sicurezza, qualità e consegna siano corrette. Siete la prima persona di contatto nel vostro turno e sono in stretto contatto con la gestione del team.
La nostra posizione a Klingnau è un centro di eccellenza per la lavorazione di materie plastiche ad alta precisione. Produciamo soluzioni di isolamento di alta qualità per applicazioni nella generazione di energia e distribuzione, ferrovia, spazio e industria. Un team motivato, gerarchie piatte e brevi percorsi decisionali plasmano la nostra cooperazione.

Puoi farlo.

• Gestione professionale dei dipendenti all'interno del turno, definendo chiare priorità e sostenendo la formazione di nuovi membri del team
• Coordinamento del personale e dello stabilimento secondo la pianificazione di produzione specificata, tenendo conto delle scadenze, della qualità e delle prestazioni
• Partecipazione attiva alla produzione, tra cui la creazione e l'installazione di presse e attrezzature per la produzione di canali scanalati e componenti isolanti
• Monitoraggio dei processi produttivi, esecuzione di controlli di qualità e documentazione tracciabile dei risultati e delle deviazioni
• Organizzazione della fornitura di materiale e garanzia di un processo di produzione regolare all'interno del turno
• Iniziazione di misure iniziali in caso di disagi e tempestivo coinvolgimento della gestione del team, dell'assicurazione della qualità o della manutenzione
• Garantire il trasferimento a turni completo con informazioni sui progressi, le interruzioni e le misure aperte
• Attuazione coerente dei requisiti per la sicurezza del lavoro, la salute e l'ordine nonché del modello di ruolo nel team
• Presentazione attiva delle proposte di miglioramento per ridurre i rottami, i tempi di fermo e i percorsi di trasporto non necessari
Lo porti con te.

• Formazione tecnica o artigianale completata, ad esempio come polimeccanico, meccanico di produzione, tecnologo plastico o falegname
• diversi anni di esperienza nella produzione industriale; Esperienza con presse o nella lavorazione della plastica è un vantaggio
• Dividere la responsabilità di un team; la prima esperienza nella leadership professionale è un vantaggio
• Gestione sicura dei disegni tecnici, delle liste dei pezzi e delle istruzioni di lavoro, nonché una forte consapevolezza della qualità e della sicurezza
• Una comunicazione chiara e rispettosa, un metodo di lavoro indipendente e la capacità di agire con calma e orientata alla soluzione anche in caso di disagi
• Buona conoscenza del tedesco nelle parole e nella scrittura, la conoscenza dell'inglese e la prontezza per l'uso in operazione a 2 turni
Ulteriori informazioni su di noi
Offriamo un compito versatile in cui combinate la collaborazione pratica con la leadership professionale. Puoi contribuire alla tua esperienza, assumerti la responsabilità e, insieme a un team dedicato, sviluppare ulteriormente i processi nella produzione di canali scanalati.
descriptionByLocale.en:
About the position
Take over as Shift Leader groove channel You are the professional manager of your shift and actively participate in production. You organize the daily process, support your team with technical questions and ensure that safety, quality and delivery dates are right. You are the first contact person in your shift and are in close contact with the team management.
Our location in Klingnau is a centre of excellence for high-precision plastics processing. We manufacture high-quality insulation solutions for applications in energy generation and distribution, rail, space and industry. A motivated team, flat hierarchies and short decision-making paths shape our cooperation.

You can do that.

• Professional management of employees within the shift, defining clear priorities and supporting the training of new team members
• Coordination of personnel and plant deployment according to the specified production planning, taking into account deadlines, quality and performance
• Active participation in production, including setting up and operating presses and equipment for the production of groove channels and insulation components
• Monitoring of manufacturing processes, carrying out quality checks and traceable documentation of results and deviations
• Organisation of material provision and ensuring a smooth production process within the shift
• Initiation of initial measures in the event of disruption and timely involvement of team management, quality assurance or maintenance
• Ensuring full shift transfer with information on order progress, disruptions and open measures
• Consistent implementation of the requirements for occupational safety, health and order as well as role model within the team
• Active submission of proposals for improvement to reduce scrap, downtime and unnecessary transport routes
You bring that with you

• Completed technical or craft training, e.g. as a polymechanic, production mechanic, plastics technologist or carpenter
• several years of experience in industrial manufacturing; Experience with presses or in plastics processing is an advantage
• Delight in taking responsibility for a team; First experience in professional leadership is an advantage
• Safe handling of technical drawings, parts lists and work instructions as well as a strong quality and safety awareness
• Clear, respectful communication, an independent working method and the ability to act calmly and solution-oriented even in the event of disruptions
• Good knowledge of German in words and writing, knowledge of English as well as readiness for use in 2-shift operation
More about us
We offer a versatile task in which you combine practical cooperation with professional leadership. You can contribute your experience, take on responsibility and, together with a dedicated team, further develop the processes in groove channel production.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Über die Position
Als Shift Leader Nutkanal übernimmst Du die fachliche Führung Deiner Schicht und arbeitest aktiv in der Produktion mit. Du organisierst den täglichen Ablauf, unterstützt Dein Team bei technischen Fragen und sorgst dafür, dass Sicherheit, Qualität und Liefertermine stimmen. Dabei bist Du die erste Ansprechperson in Deiner Schicht und stehst im engen Austausch mit der Teamleitung.
Unser Standort in Klingnau ist ein Kompetenzzentrum für hochpräzise Kunststoffverarbeitung. Wir fertigen hochwertige Isolationslösungen für Anwendungen in der Energieerzeugung und -verteilung, im Bahnbereich, in der Raumfahrt und in der Industrie. Ein motiviertes Team, flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege prägen unsere Zusammenarbeit.

Das kannst Du bewirken

• Fachliche Führung der Mitarbeitenden innerhalb der Schicht, Festlegung klarer Prioritäten sowie Unterstützung bei der Einarbeitung neuer Teammitglieder
• Koordination des Personal- und Anlageneinsatzes gemäß der vorgegebenen Produktionsplanung unter Berücksichtigung von Terminen, Qualität und Leistung
• Aktive Mitarbeit in der Produktion, einschließlich des Einrichtens und Bedienens von Pressen und Anlagen zur Herstellung von Nutkanälen und Isolationsbauteilen
• Überwachung der Fertigungsprozesse, Durchführung von Qualitätsprüfungen sowie nachvollziehbare Dokumentation von Ergebnissen und Abweichungen
• Organisation der Materialbereitstellung und Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen Produktionsablaufs innerhalb der Schicht
• Einleitung erster Maßnahmen bei Störungen sowie rechtzeitige Einbindung der Teamleitung, Qualitätssicherung oder Instandhaltung
• Sicherstellung einer vollständigen Schichtübergabe mit Informationen zu Auftragsfortschritten, Störungen und offenen Maßnahmen
• Konsequente Umsetzung der Vorgaben zu Arbeitssicherheit, Gesundheitsschutz und Ordnung sowie Vorbildfunktion innerhalb des Teams
• Aktive Einbringung von Verbesserungsvorschlägen zur Reduzierung von Ausschuss, Stillständen und unnötigen Transportwegen
Das bringst Du mit

• Abgeschlossene technische oder handwerkliche Ausbildung, z. B. als Polymechaniker, Produktionsmechaniker, Kunststofftechnologe oder Schreiner
• Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der industriellen Fertigung; Erfahrung mit Pressen oder in der Kunststoffverarbeitung ist von Vorteil
• Freude daran, Verantwortung für ein Team zu übernehmen; erste Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung ist von Vorteil
• Sicherer Umgang mit technischen Zeichnungen, Stücklisten und Arbeitsanweisungen sowie ein ausgeprägtes Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsbewusstsein
• Klare, respektvolle Kommunikation, eine selbstständige Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, auch bei Störungen ruhig und lösungsorientiert zu handeln
• Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil sowie Bereitschaft zum Einsatz im 2-Schichtbetrieb
Mehr über uns
Wir bieten eine vielseitige Aufgabe, in der Du praktische Mitarbeit mit fachlicher Führung verbindest. Du kannst Deine Erfahrung einbringen, Verantwortung übernehmen und gemeinsam mit einem engagierten Team die Abläufe in der Nutkanalfertigung weiterentwickeln.
descriptionByLocale.fr:

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità

Unisciti alla nostra organizzazione internazionale del progetto e guida la qualità attraverso progetti di grandi e complessi. In questo ruolo, lavorerai a stretto contatto con team di progetto, clienti, fornitori e organizzazioni del sito per garantire che i requisiti di qualità siano compresi, implementati e continuamente migliorati.

Potrai agire come partner di qualità affidabile per il Project Manager, aiutando il team a raggiungere obiettivi di progetto, gestire i rischi e fornire un alto livello di soddisfazione del cliente. Questa è un'ottima opportunità per qualcuno che combina competenze di qualità tecnica con forti capacità di comunicazione, una mentalità collaborativa, e la fiducia per influenzare le parti interessate in un'organizzazione di matrice globale.

Come farai ad avere un impatto

• Pianificare, organizzare, guidare e monitorare attività di progetto legate alla qualità, risorse, obiettivi, KPI e realizzabili

descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity

Join our international project organization and drive quality across large and complex projects. In this role, you will work closely with project teams, customers, suppliers, and site organizations to ensure that quality requirements are understood, implemented, and continuously improved.

You will act as a trusted quality partner to the Project Manager, helping the team achieve project objectives, manage risks, and deliver a high level of customer satisfaction. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who combines technical quality expertise with strong communication skills, a collaborative mindset, and the confidence to influence stakeholders across a global matrix organization.

How you'll make an impact

• Plan, organize, lead, and monitor quality-related project activities, resources, objectives, KPIs, and deliverables

• Develop, implement, and maintain the Project Quality Plan and ensure compliance with contractual requirements and the ISO 9001-certified Quality Management System

• Collaborate closely with project teams, suppliers, site organizations, and other key stakeholders

• Lead and follow up on project quality audits, non-conformances, corrective actions, lessons learned, quality risks, and continuous improvement activities

• Monitor and report relevant quality indicators, including non-conformance reports, customer complaint resolution, cost of poor quality, project savings, and customer satisfaction

• Coordinate quality requirements for critical equipment, including supplier documentation, Inspection and Test Plans, Master Test Plans, inspections, and shipment-release reviews

• Support site quality activities, including training, audits, inspections, documentation handover, and project close-out

• Promote a strong quality culture and use structured problem-solving and lean methodologies to improve quality throughout project execution

Your background

• Bachelor's degree in engineering, science, or a related field; a master's degree is an advantage

• At least five years of professional experience in EPC project quality management within a large and complex organization; experience in the power, energy, renewable energy, or oil and gas sectors is preferred

• Sound knowledge of ISO 9001; internal-auditor certification is considered an advantage

• Good understanding on SAP Quality Module as well as project and risk management; knowledge of PMI methodologies or CAPM-PMI certification is beneficial

• Experience with supplier and site quality processes, including Inspection and Test Plans, PPAP, inspections, testing procedures, punch lists, mechanical completion, and lessons learned

• Knowledge of quality and problem-solving methodologies such as 8D, root cause analysis, PDCA, 5 Why, Lean Six Sigma, and FMEA

• Excellent English communication skills, combined with a structured, proactive, solution-oriented, and collaborative working style; German or other additional languages are an advantage

• Confidence working in an international matrix environment and willingness to travel to project construction sites and supplier locations when required

More about us

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity

At Hitachi Energy, we are looking for an experienced Real Estate Controller, for a 12-month temporary assignment, to drive financial excellence across our global real estate portfolio. In this strategic role, you will oversee financial reporting, portfolio performance, compliance, and investment analysis while partnering with stakeholders across multiple functions and regions.

How you'll make an impact

• Oversee accounting, financial reporting, and performance analysis for Hitachi's global real estate portfolio, including investment and corporate properties
• Prepare and manage budgets, forecasts, cash flow analyses, and financial plans to support business objectives
• Develop, implement, and continuously improve internal controls, financial policies, and governance frameworks related to real estate activities
• Conduct financial due diligence and provide commercial assessments for acquisitions, disposals, leasing transactions, and strategic investments
• Monitor portfolio performance against financial targets, KPIs, and market benchmarks, identifying opportunities for improvement
• Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards (IFRS/GAAP), tax regulations, and real estate-related legal requirements
• Partner with internal functions such as Legal, Tax, Treasury, and Facilities Management, as well as external auditors, appraisers, and property managers
• Deliver strategic financial insights and recommendations to senior leadership while driving process optimization and digitalization initiatives
Your background

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; a Master's degree or professional certification (CPA, ACCA, CMA) is an advantage
• Minimum 8 years of experience in financial controlling, real estate finance, or real estate accounting within an international environment
• Strong knowledge of real estate accounting principles, including lease accounting under IFRS 16 and/or ASC 842
• Experience in financial modeling, investment analysis, valuation methodologies, and business case development
• Solid understanding of tax implications and regulatory requirements relating to real estate transactions and operations
• Proficiency with ERP systems such as SAP and advanced Excel skills; experience with reporting and BI tools is a plus
• Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex financial matters to non-financial audiences
• Proactive, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a dynamic, fast-paced environment
More about us

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it:

Ulteriori informazioni su di noi

Con la priorità del benessere, costruiamo un posto di lavoro dove il successo personale e organizzativo crescono insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity

We are looking for a motivated MES & Factory Integration Engineer to strengthen our semiconductor manufacturing environment. In this role, you will support and develop our manufacturing systems and their integration with production equipment, automation, and enterprise applications. Working closely with production, engineering, IT, and automation teams, you will ensure reliable system operation, drive continuous improvement, and contribute to the evolution of our future digital manufacturing landscape.

How you'll make an impact

• Maintain, support and further develop the ECS / ABB Ability MOM production control and factory integration environment
• Support and improve manufacturing processes and integrations involving SAP ME/MES, SAP ERP and adjacent production systems
• Act as a technical expert for the interaction between production equipment, automation systems, ECS, MES and ERP
• Analyze and sustainably resolve complex system, interface, data and integration issues across the manufacturing IT/OT landscape
• Support the integration and commissioning of new production equipment and automated manufacturing processes
• Translate production and engineering requirements into technical concepts, routings, workflows, master-data structures and scalable system solutions
• Contribute to application ownership, lifecycle management, vendor coordination, expert support, documentation and knowledge transfer for critical manufacturing applications
• Help shape the future MES and factory integration landscape by contributing technical expertise, manufacturing requirements and practical implementation experience
Your background

• Degree in Computer Science, Automation, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering or a comparable technical field
• Several years of professional experience in MES, manufacturing IT, factory integration, industrial automation or production systems
• Strong understanding of manufacturing execution processes and the integration between shopfloor equipment, automation, MES and ERP systems
• Hands-on experience with a Manufacturing Execution System; experience with SAP ME or SAP Digital Manufacturing is a strong advantage
• Experience with modern MES platforms used in semiconductor or other complex manufacturing environments, such as Siemens Opcenter or Critical Manufacturing MES, is highly desirable
• Experience with ECS / ABB Ability MOM or a comparable manufacturing operations and equipment integration system is an advantage
• Experience with system or solution architecture, interfaces, APIs, databases, manufacturing data flows and troubleshooting is beneficial
• Semiconductor manufacturing experience is a strong advantage
• Fluent English; German is an advantage
More about us

We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.

descriptionByLocale.en:

Als Diffusion Maintenance Engineer/Techniker spielen Sie eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Sicherstellung der Verfügbarkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unseres Werkzeugparks für die Halbleiterproduktion. Ihr Fokus liegt auf der korrektiven, präventiven und prädiktiven Wartung von Diffusionsgeräten, die funktionsübergreifend arbeiten, um Sicherheit, Produktivität und allgemeine Werkzeug- und Workflowoptimierungen in der gesamten Produktionslinie voranzutreiben.

Wie Sie einen Einfluss machen werden

• Gewährleistung einer maximalen Verfügbarkeit von Halbleiterproduktionswerkzeugen durch proaktive Wartung und Fehlersuche bei Diffusionsanlagen

• Steigern Sie die kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Geräteleistung und wenden Sie Arbeitsplatzsicherheits- und Effizienzpraktiken an, die auf die 6S-Methodik ausgerichtet sind

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Wartungs-, Prozess- und Produktionsteams, um Leistungsziele zu erreichen und die Anlageneffizienz zu optimieren

• Beteiligen Sie sich an Werkzeug-Upgrades und Modernisierungsprojekten zur Verbesserung der Werkzeugfähigkeit und -zuverlässigkeit

• Pflegen Sie eine genaue und detaillierte Dokumentation der Wartungsaktivitäten, des Gerätestatus und der Systemleistung

• Unterstützung der Ursachenanalyse und Problemlösung für technische Probleme innerhalb des Teams

• Train und Mentor Kollegen in den Bereichen Diffusion, Sicherheit und Best Maintenance Practices

• Förderung einer starken Sicherheitskultur durch Gewährleistung der Einhaltung aller relevanten Vorschriften, Verfahren und Dokumentationen

Dein Hintergrund

• Praxiserfahrung in der Wartung von Halbleiterproduktionswerkzeugen

• Solides Verständnis von Elektronik, Mechanik und Pneumatik

• Erfahrung mit Diffusionssystemen (z. B. ASM, Centrothermöfen)

• Vertrautheit mit Messtechnik-Tools zur Prozesssteuerung (z.B. Surfscan, Semilab WT-2000)

• Zusätzliche Ausbildung oder Fachkenntnisse in Vakuumsystemen oder verwandten Technologien

• Absolvierte technische Ausbildung (z. B. Automatisierungstechniker, Elektroniktechniker oder ähnliches Fachgebiet)

• Bereitschaft, in Schichten zu arbeiten, ist ein Muss

• Starker Teamplayer mit Problemlösungsmentalität, organisatorischen Fähigkeiten und Englischkenntnissen (Deutsch ist ein Plus)

Mehr über uns

Hitachi Energy bietet Ihnen interessante Aufgaben in einem hochmotivierten Team und einem offenen Kommunikationsstil. Durch einen individuellen und praxisorientierten Einführungsplan unterstützen wir Sie dabei, schnell professionelles Vertrauen zu gewinnen, um selbstständig und mit hoher Eigenverantwortung arbeiten zu können.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity

The Gate Unit Group develops, qualifies, supports production, and manages the lifecycle of gate units for IGCT devices. We translate semiconductor, converter, and system requirements into robust and reliable products, covering hardware design, embedded firmware, manufacturing, and testing.

To strengthen our team in Lenzburg, we are looking for a Senior Electronics Technician – Power Electronics & Testing who enjoys combining hands-on technical work with engineering problem-solving and wants to contribute to innovative power electronics products throughout the development lifecycle.

This position offers an excellent opportunity to develop technical expertise in power electronics and semiconductor applications while working in a collaborative and innovative engineering environment. You will gain exposure to the full product lifecycle, from development and testing through production support, and contribute to technologies that help shape the future of efficient and sustainable energy systems.

How you'll make an impact

• Support the development of gate units by collaborating with development engineers on analog and digital circuit design, schematic capture, and PCB layout activities
• Maintain laboratory equipment, test infrastructure, and inventory, ensuring calibration, availability, and a safe, well-organized work environment
• Contribute to the implementation, testing, and validation of electronic hardware solutions
• Coordinate with suppliers and EMS partners regarding component sourcing, procurement activities, order management, and shipment handling
• Design, build, and maintain test fixtures, automated test systems, and data acquisition solutions to enable efficient and reliable product validation
• Perform hands-on debugging, repair, and rework of electronic assemblies to ensure product quality and reliability
• Contribute ideas, identify opportunities for improvement, and support the continuous enhancement of products, processes, and testing capabilities
Your background

• Completed apprenticeship, technician qualification, or bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
• 3-5 years of experience in electronics development, testing, manufacturing, or validation; alternatively, recent graduates with a bachelor's degree and a strong technical foundation combined with a passion for hands-on engineering are also encouraged to apply
• Understanding of analog and digital electronics and electronic measurement techniques
• Interest in both hardware and software development
• Practical, hands-on, and solution-oriented approach to technical challenges
• Experience with Altium Designer and/or KiCad is an advantage
• Python programming skills and knowledge of SAP, are a plus
• Fluent German language skills (written and spoken) and the ability to communicate effectively in English in a professional environment are required
More about us

We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.
descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità

Il Gruppo Gate Unit sviluppa, qualifica, supporta la produzione e gestisce il ciclo di vita delle unità di gate per i dispositivi IGCT. Traduciamo semiconduttore, convertitore e requisiti di sistema in prodotti robusti e affidabili, coprendo progettazione hardware, firmware incorporato, produzione e test.

Per rafforzare il nostro team a Lenzburg, siamo alla ricerca di un Senior Electronics Technician – Power Electronics & Testing che si diletta a combinare il lavoro tecnico pratico con l'ingegneria problem-solving e vuole contribuire a prodotti elettronici di potenza innovativi durante il ciclo di vita di sviluppo.

Questa posizione offre un'eccellente opportunità per sviluppare competenze tecniche nelle applicazioni di elettronica di potenza e semiconduttori, lavorando in un ambiente di ingegneria collaborativo e innovativo. Si otterrà l'esposizione al ciclo di vita completo del prodotto, dallo sviluppo e dai test attraverso il supporto di produzione, e contribuire a tecnologie che aiutano a plasmare il futuro di sistemi energetici efficienti e sostenibili.

Come farai ad avere un impatto

• Sostenere lo sviluppo delle unità di gate collaborando con gli ingegneri di sviluppo sulla progettazione di circuiti analogici e digitali, la cattura schematica e le attività di layout PCB
• Mantenere attrezzature di laboratorio, infrastrutture di prova e inventario, garantire la calibrazione, la disponibilità e un ambiente di lavoro sicuro e ben organizzato
• Contribuisci all'implementazione, al test e alla validazione di soluzioni hardware elettroniche
• Coordinamento con fornitori e partner dello SME per quanto riguarda l'approvvigionamento dei componenti, le attività di approvvigionamento, la gestione degli ordini e la gestione delle spedizioni
• Progettazione, costruzione e manutenzione di dispositivi di prova, sistemi di test automatizzati e soluzioni di acquisizione dati per consentire una validazione efficiente e affidabile del prodotto
• Esegui il debug manuale, la riparazione e la rielaborazione di assemblaggi elettronici per garantire qualità e affidabilità del prodotto
• Contribuire idee, identificare le opportunità di miglioramento e supportare il continuo miglioramento dei prodotti, processi e capacità di test
Il tuo sfondo

• Completato l'apprendistato, la qualifica tecnica, o la laurea in Ingegneria Elettrica, Ingegneria Elettronica, Ingegneria Informatica, o un campo tecnico correlato.
• 3-5 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo dell'elettronica, nel test, nella produzione o nella validazione; in alternativa, i laureati recenti con un diploma di laurea e una forte fondazione tecnica combinata con una passione per l'ingegneria pratica sono anche incoraggiati ad applicare
• Comprensione delle tecniche di misurazione analogiche e digitali
• Interessi sia nell'hardware che nello sviluppo software
• L'approccio pratico, pratico e orientato alla soluzione alle sfide tecniche
• Esperienza con Altium Designer e/o KiCad è un vantaggio
• Le competenze di programmazione Python e la conoscenza di SAP, sono un plus
• Sono necessarie competenze linguistiche tedesche fluide (scritte e parlate) e la capacità di comunicare efficacemente in inglese in un ambiente professionale
Ulteriori informazioni su di noi

Crediamo che il grande lavoro prosperi in un ambiente in cui le persone si sentono sinceramente sostenute e premiate. I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per creare valore reale per ogni individuo – il rifornimento di impegno, le prestazioni e la crescita. Con la priorità del benessere, costruiamo un posto di lavoro dove il successo personale e organizzativo crescono insieme.
descriptionByLocale.de:

Die Gate Unit Group entwickelt, qualifiziert, unterstützt die Produktion und verwaltet den Lebenszyklus von Gate-Einheiten für IGCT-Geräte. Sie erhalten Zugang zum gesamten Produktlebenszyklus, von der Entwicklung und Prüfung bis hin zur Produktionsunterstützung, und tragen zu Technologien bei, die die Zukunft effizienter und nachhaltiger Energiesysteme mitgestalten.

Wie Sie einen Einfluss machen werden

• Entwurf, Bau und Wartung von Prüfvorrichtungen, automatisierten Testsystemen und Datenerfassungslösungen für eine effiziente und zuverlässige Produktvalidierung
• Führen Sie praktisches Debuggen, Reparieren und Überarbeiten von elektronischen Baugruppen durch, um Produktqualität und Zuverlässigkeit zu gewährleisten
• Ideen einbringen, Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten identifizieren und die kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Produkten, Prozessen und Testfähigkeiten unterstützen
Dein Hintergrund

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung, Technikerqualifikation oder Bachelor-Abschluss in Elektrotechnik, Elektroniktechnik, Computertechnik oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich.
• 3-5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Elektronikentwicklung, -prüfung, -herstellung oder -validierung; alternativ werden auch Absolventen mit einem Bachelor-Abschluss und einer starken technischen Grundlage in Kombination mit einer Leidenschaft für praktisches Engineering ermutigt, sich zu bewerben
• Verständnis von analoger und digitaler Elektronik und elektronischen Messtechniken
• Interesse an Hard- und Softwareentwicklung

Wir glauben, dass großartige Arbeit in einem Umfeld gedeiht, in dem sich die Menschen wirklich unterstützt und belohnt fühlen. Through the constant expansion of our competencies in the field of composite processing as well as through the continuous improvement of our business processes, we offer our customers innovative, reliable, individual and safe solutions for their concerns in the power generation/distribution, railway, space, service and industry segments. Your background

• Proven ability to lead and inspire teams, drive engagement, and achieve high performance
• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to manage complex situations and resolve issues
• Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop team members, implementing training and development programs that enhance skills and promote career growth

More about us

descriptionByLocale.en:

This is an excellent opportunity for a technically skilled professional to contribute to operational excellence, infrastructure projects, and continuous improvement initiatives within a highly regulated industrial environment.

Your responsibilities

• Operate, maintain, and repair utility systems, including process gas, ultrapure water, chemical supply, wastewater treatment, and cooling water systems

• Troubleshoot equipment failures and implement corrective and continuous improvement measures

• Execute and document maintenance activities and manage spare parts through the maintenance management system

• Support the operation and upkeep of site-wide infrastructure across multiple technical disciplines

• Coordinate logistics activities related to the procurement, handling, replacement, and disposal of chemicals and gases

• Monitor and ensure compliance with operational specifications, safety standards, and regulatory requirements

• Operate building management systems, fire alarm systems, gas detection systems, and other safety-critical equipment

• Support infrastructure projects, commissioning activities, and KPI reporting related to maintenance, costs, projects, and budgets

• Ensuring uninterrupted production operations around the clock (24/7) as well as the willingness to perform on-call duty

Your background

• Completed technical apprenticeship or vocational training, preferably in Chemical Engineering, Process Technology, Facility Management, or a related field

• Experience in the operation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of industrial utility or infrastructure systems

• Knowledge of process engineering and industrial plant operations

• Basic understanding of electrical, mechanical, instrumentation, and control systems

• Experience working with maintenance management systems and Microsoft Office applications

• Knowledge of occupational health and safety, environmental protection, and relevant regulatory requirement

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills with a hands-on mindset.

• Reliable team player with a structured work approach, high safety awareness, and strong communication skills

More about us

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity

As an Implant Maintenance Engineer/Technician, you play a vital role in ensuring the availability, reliability, and continuous improvement of our semiconductor production tool park. Your focus is on the corrective, preventive and predictive maintenance of implant equipment, working cross-functionally to drive safety, productivity, and general tool and workflow optimizations across the production line.

• Ensure maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools through proactive maintenance and troubleshooting of implant equipment

• Participate in tool upgrades and modernization projects to enhance tool capability and reliability

• Maintain accurate and detailed documentation of maintenance activities, equipment status, and system performance

More about us

Through an individual and practice-oriented induction plan, we will support you to quickly gain professional confidence to be able to work independently with high level of personal responsibility.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity

Join our Profit Center Surge Arresters in Wettingen, Switzerland, where we develop innovative and secure overvoltage protection solutions for power generation, distribution, railway, and industry. You'll be part of a passionate team striving to lead in technology and customer satisfaction. This internship of at least 6 months offers hands-on experience in materials research and process development. You'll contribute to impactful projects while learning from experts in a collaborative and supportive environment.

How you'll make an impact

• Support research on metal oxide varistor materials and manufacturing processes

• Analyze samples using advanced characterization techniques

• Explore links between process parameters, microstructure, and material properties

• Document findings and present results to the research team

• Conduct literature reviews to support ongoing research

Your background

• Currently pursuing a Bachelors or Masters degree in Materials Science / Materials Engineering or a related discipline (official enrollment is essential)

• Experience in ceramics and sinter technology is beneficial

• Hands-on experience in lab work and background knowledge in material analysis methods such as microscope, SEM and spectroscopy

• Enthusiastic, self-motivated mindset and ability to work independently

• Fluent command of English, both written and spoken

More about us

We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity

Join a high performing photolithography team where your expertise truly makes an impact. As a Photolithography Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and optimizing photolithography processes used in semiconductor manufacturing. Your role will involve working with advanced lithography equipment, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring high-quality production standards. This is your opportunity to shape technical decisions, contribute to long term tool strategies, and drive meaningful improvements in stability, uptime, and process performance. Are you someone who takes ownership, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and enjoys making a real impact? Then apply today!

How you'll make an impact

• Ensure processes meet the production program and yield goals and address any product yield and rework issues.

• Engage with equipment and material vendors to develop new solutions and improve existing processes, to ensure smooth functioning of the production line.

• Develop new techniques, modify existing designs, and coordinate process improvement projects.

• Analyze process data to identify trends, optimize performance, and troubleshoot issues (implement and regularly check SPC).

• Independent planning and Implementation of new machinery into the production line.

• Work closely with process integration, wet etch, diffusion, metals, dry etch, and implant teams to ensure seamless production.

• Supports some metrology tools i.e. to measure CD and Overlay.

• On-call duties on weekends and public holidays (as required from the production) with participation in the on-call meeting (before the on-call duty) agreed on his own responsibility with the other on-call service providers.

Your background

• Bachelor's degree in a related field (e.g., Electrical, Mechanical, Chemical, Materials Science or Physics) with 5+ years of experience in industry or master's degree with 3+ years of experience in industry or Ph.D. with industry experience

• Extensive experience in wafer photolithography operations especially in coating and exposure in Steppers, in a wafer manufacturing environment (thin-film-head, semiconductor wafer manufacturing)

• Familiarity with automated wafer factory software systems like SPC, MES and Experience with data extraction, manipulation, and analysis

• Strong understanding of optics and immersion lithography

• Proficiency in data science and programming is preferred

• Good English and German language skills

• Ability to work in a cleanroom environment

More about us

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

Wie Sie einen Einfluss machen werden

• Sicherstellen, dass Prozesse das Produktionsprogramm und die Ertragsziele erfüllen und alle Produkterträge und Nacharbeitsprobleme angehen.

• Engagieren Sie sich mit Ausrüstungs- und Materialanbietern, um neue Lösungen zu entwickeln und bestehende Prozesse zu verbessern, um einen reibungslosen Betrieb der Produktionslinie zu gewährleisten.

• Entwickeln Sie neue Techniken, ändern Sie bestehende Designs und koordinieren Sie Prozessverbesserungsprojekte.

• Analysieren Sie Prozessdaten, um Trends zu erkennen, die Leistung zu optimieren und Probleme zu beheben (Implementieren und regelmäßige Überprüfung von SPC).

• Unabhängige Planung und Implementierung neuer Maschinen in die Produktionslinie.

• Arbeiten Sie eng mit Prozessintegration, Nassätzen, Diffusion, Metallen, Trockenätzen und Implantatteams zusammen, um eine nahtlose Produktion zu gewährleisten.

• Unterstützt einige Metrologie-Tools, z. B. um CD und Overlay zu messen.

• Bereitschaftsdienste an Wochenenden und Feiertagen (wie ab der Produktion erforderlich) mit Teilnahme an der Bereitschaftssitzung (vor dem Bereitschaftsdienst) in eigener Verantwortung mit den anderen Bereitschaftsdienstanbietern vereinbart.

Dein Hintergrund

• Bachelor-Abschluss in einem verwandten Bereich (z. B. Elektrik, Mechanik, Chemie, Materialwissenschaften oder Physik) mit 5+ Jahren Erfahrung in der Industrie oder Master-Abschluss mit 3+ Jahren Erfahrung in der Industrie oder Ph.D. mit Branchenerfahrung

• Umfangreiche Erfahrung in Wafer-Photolithographie-Operationen, insbesondere in der Beschichtung und Belichtung in Steppers, in einer Wafer-Herstellungsumgebung (Dünnfilmkopf, Halbleiterwafer-Herstellung)

• Vertrautheit mit automatisierten Wafer Factory-Softwaresystemen wie SPC, MES und Erfahrung mit Datenextraktion, -manipulation und -analyse

• Starkes Verständnis von Optik und Immersionslithographie

• Kenntnisse in Data Science und Programmierung werden bevorzugt

• Gute Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse

• Fähigkeit, in einer Reinraumumgebung zu arbeiten

Mehr über uns

Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'opportunité

Rejoignez une équipe de photolithographie de haute performance où votre expertise fait vraiment un impact. En tant qu'ingénieur en photolithographie, vous serez chargé de développer et d'optimiser les processus de photolithographie utilisés dans la fabrication de semi-conducteurs. Votre rôle consistera à travailler avec des équipements de lithographie avancés, à collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles et à garantir des normes de production de haute qualité. C'est l'occasion pour vous d'élaborer des décisions techniques, de contribuer à des stratégies d'outils à long terme et d'apporter des améliorations significatives à la stabilité, à la disponibilité et au rendement des processus. Êtes-vous quelqu'un qui prend possession, prospère dans un environnement rapide, et aime faire un impact réel? Alors appliquez aujourd'hui !

Comment vous ferez un impact

• Veiller à ce que les processus atteignent les objectifs du programme de production et du rendement et s'attaquer aux problèmes de rendement et de retravail des produits.

• Mobiliser les fournisseurs d'équipements et de matériaux pour développer de nouvelles solutions et améliorer les processus existants, pour assurer le bon fonctionnement de la chaîne de production.

• Élaborer de nouvelles techniques, modifier les conceptions existantes et coordonner les projets d'amélioration des processus.

• Analyser les données de processus pour identifier les tendances, optimiser les performances et résoudre les problèmes (mise en œuvre et vérification régulière du CPS).

• Planification indépendante et mise en place de nouvelles machines dans la chaîne de production.

• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'intégration des procédés, d'écharpe humide, de diffusion, de métaux, d'écharpe sèche et d'implants pour assurer une production transparente.

• Prend en charge certains outils de métrologie, c'est-à-dire mesurer CD et Overlay.

• Les services de garde le week-end et les jours fériés (selon les besoins de la production) avec la participation à la réunion de garde (avant le service de garde) ont convenu de sa propre responsabilité avec les autres fournisseurs de services de garde.

Vos antécédents

• Baccalauréat dans un domaine connexe (p. ex., électrique, mécanique, chimique, science des matériaux ou physique) avec 5+ années d'expérience dans l'industrie ou maîtrise avec 3+ années d'expérience dans l'industrie ou doctorat avec expérience de l'industrie

• Expérience approfondie dans les opérations de photolithographie des wafers, en particulier dans le revêtement et l'exposition chez Steppers, dans un environnement de fabrication des wafers (fabrication des wafers à tête mince et à semi-conducteur)

• Familiarité avec les systèmes logiciels automatisés d'usine de wafer comme SPC, MES et Expérience avec l'extraction, la manipulation et l'analyse de données

• Forte compréhension de l'optique et de la lithographie d'immersion

• La compétence en sciences des données et en programmation est privilégiée

• Bonnes compétences en anglais et en allemand

• Capacité de travailler dans un environnement propre

Plus sur nous

Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et professionnelle tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity

The Gate Unit Group develops, qualifies, supports production, and manages the lifecycle of gate units for IGCT devices. We translate semiconductor, converter, and system requirements into robust and reliable products, covering hardware design, embedded firmware, manufacturing, and testing.

To strengthen our team in Lenzburg, we are looking for a Senior Electronics Technician – Power Electronics & Testing who enjoys combining hands-on technical work with engineering problem-solving and wants to contribute to innovative power electronics products throughout the development lifecycle.

This position offers an excellent opportunity to develop technical expertise in power electronics and semiconductor applications while working in a collaborative and innovative engineering environment. You will gain exposure to the full product lifecycle, from development and testing through production support, and contribute to technologies that help shape the future of efficient and sustainable energy systems.

How you'll make an impact

• Support the development of gate units by collaborating with development engineers on analog and digital circuit design, schematic capture, and PCB layout activities
• Maintain laboratory equipment, test infrastructure, and inventory, ensuring calibration, availability, and a safe, well-organized work environment
• Contribute to the implementation, testing, and validation of electronic hardware solutions
• Coordinate with suppliers and EMS partners regarding component sourcing, procurement activities, order management, and shipment handling
• Design, build, and maintain test fixtures, automated test systems, and data acquisition solutions to enable efficient and reliable product validation
• Perform hands-on debugging, repair, and rework of electronic assemblies to ensure product quality and reliability
• Contribute ideas, identify opportunities for improvement, and support the continuous enhancement of products, processes, and testing capabilities
Your background

• Completed apprenticeship, technician qualification, or bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
• 3-5 years of experience in electronics development, testing, manufacturing, or validation; alternatively, recent graduates with a bachelor's degree and a strong technical foundation combined with a passion for hands-on engineering are also encouraged to apply
• Understanding of analog and digital electronics and electronic measurement techniques
• Interest in both hardware and software development
• Practical, hands-on, and solution-oriented approach to technical challenges
• Experience with Altium Designer and/or KiCad is an advantage
• Python programming skills and knowledge of SAP, are a plus
• Fluent German language skills (written and spoken) and the ability to communicate effectively in English in a professional environment are required
More about us

We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.
descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità

Il Gruppo Gate Unit sviluppa, qualifica, supporta la produzione e gestisce il ciclo di vita delle unità di gate per i dispositivi IGCT. Traduciamo semiconduttore, convertitore e requisiti di sistema in prodotti robusti e affidabili, coprendo progettazione hardware, firmware incorporato, produzione e test.

Per rafforzare il nostro team a Lenzburg, siamo alla ricerca di un Senior Electronics Technician – Power Electronics & Testing che si diletta a combinare il lavoro tecnico pratico con l'ingegneria problem-solving e vuole contribuire a prodotti elettronici di potenza innovativi durante il ciclo di vita di sviluppo.

Questa posizione offre un'eccellente opportunità per sviluppare competenze tecniche nelle applicazioni di elettronica di potenza e semiconduttori, lavorando in un ambiente di ingegneria collaborativo e innovativo. Si otterrà l'esposizione al ciclo di vita completo del prodotto, dallo sviluppo e dai test attraverso il supporto di produzione, e contribuire a tecnologie che aiutano a plasmare il futuro di sistemi energetici efficienti e sostenibili.

Come farai ad avere un impatto

• Sostenere lo sviluppo delle unità di gate collaborando con gli ingegneri di sviluppo sulla progettazione di circuiti analogici e digitali, la cattura schematica e le attività di layout PCB
• Mantenere attrezzature di laboratorio, infrastrutture di prova e inventario, garantire la calibrazione, la disponibilità e un ambiente di lavoro sicuro e ben organizzato
• Contribuisci all'implementazione, al test e alla validazione di soluzioni hardware elettroniche
• Coordinamento con fornitori e partner dello SME per quanto riguarda l'approvvigionamento dei componenti, le attività di approvvigionamento, la gestione degli ordini e la gestione delle spedizioni
• Progettazione, costruzione e manutenzione di dispositivi di prova, sistemi di test automatizzati e soluzioni di acquisizione dati per consentire una validazione efficiente e affidabile del prodotto
• Esegui il debug manuale, la riparazione e la rielaborazione di assemblaggi elettronici per garantire qualità e affidabilità del prodotto
• Contribuire idee, identificare le opportunità di miglioramento e supportare il continuo miglioramento dei prodotti, processi e capacità di test
Il tuo sfondo

• Completato l'apprendistato, la qualifica tecnica, o la laurea in Ingegneria Elettrica, Ingegneria Elettronica, Ingegneria Informatica, o un campo tecnico correlato.
• 3-5 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo dell'elettronica, nel test, nella produzione o nella validazione; in alternativa, i laureati recenti con un diploma di laurea e una forte fondazione tecnica combinata con una passione per l'ingegneria pratica sono anche incoraggiati ad applicare
• Comprensione delle tecniche di misurazione analogiche e digitali
• Interessi sia nell'hardware che nello sviluppo software
• L'approccio pratico, pratico e orientato alla soluzione alle sfide tecniche
• Esperienza con Altium Designer e/o KiCad è un vantaggio
• Le competenze di programmazione Python e la conoscenza di SAP, sono un plus
• Sono necessarie competenze linguistiche tedesche fluide (scritte e parlate) e la capacità di comunicare efficacemente in inglese in un ambiente professionale
Ulteriori informazioni su di noi

Crediamo che il grande lavoro prosperi in un ambiente in cui le persone si sentono sinceramente sostenute e premiate. I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per creare valore reale per ogni individuo – il rifornimento di impegno, le prestazioni e la crescita. Con la priorità del benessere, costruiamo un posto di lavoro dove il successo personale e organizzativo crescono insieme.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Chance

Die Gate Unit Group entwickelt, qualifiziert, unterstützt die Produktion und verwaltet den Lebenszyklus von Gate-Einheiten für IGCT-Geräte. Wir übersetzen Halbleiter-, Konverter- und Systemanforderungen in robuste und zuverlässige Produkte, die Hardware-Design, eingebettete Firmware, Fertigung und Test umfassen.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in Lenzburg suchen wir einen Senior Electronics Technician – Power Electronics & Testing, der gerne praktische technische Arbeit mit Engineering-Problemlösungen verbindet und während des gesamten Entwicklungslebenszyklus zu innovativen Leistungselektronikprodukten beitragen möchte.

Diese Position bietet eine hervorragende Gelegenheit, technisches Know-how in Leistungselektronik und Halbleiteranwendungen zu entwickeln und gleichzeitig in einem kollaborativen und innovativen Engineering-Umfeld zu arbeiten. Sie erhalten Zugang zum gesamten Produktlebenszyklus, von der Entwicklung und Prüfung bis hin zur Produktionsunterstützung, und tragen zu Technologien bei, die die Zukunft effizienter und nachhaltiger Energiesysteme mitgestalten.

Wie Sie einen Einfluss machen werden

• Unterstützung der Entwicklung von Gate-Einheiten durch die Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklungsingenieuren bei der Gestaltung analoger und digitaler Schaltungen, der Schaltplanerfassung und den PCB-Layout-Aktivitäten
• Pflegen Sie Laborausrüstung, Testinfrastruktur und Inventar, um Kalibrierung, Verfügbarkeit und eine sichere, gut organisierte Arbeitsumgebung zu gewährleisten
• Beitrag zur Implementierung, zum Testen und zur Validierung von elektronischen Hardwarelösungen
• Koordination mit Lieferanten und EMS-Partnern in Bezug auf Komponentenbeschaffung, Beschaffungsaktivitäten, Auftragsmanagement und Versandabwicklung
• Entwurf, Bau und Wartung von Prüfvorrichtungen, automatisierten Testsystemen und Datenerfassungslösungen für eine effiziente und zuverlässige Produktvalidierung
• Führen Sie praktisches Debuggen, Reparieren und Überarbeiten von elektronischen Baugruppen durch, um Produktqualität und Zuverlässigkeit zu gewährleisten
• Ideen einbringen, Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten identifizieren und die kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Produkten, Prozessen und Testfähigkeiten unterstützen
Dein Hintergrund

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung, Technikerqualifikation oder Bachelor-Abschluss in Elektrotechnik, Elektroniktechnik, Computertechnik oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich.
• 3-5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Elektronikentwicklung, -prüfung, -herstellung oder -validierung; alternativ werden auch Absolventen mit einem Bachelor-Abschluss und einer starken technischen Grundlage in Kombination mit einer Leidenschaft für praktisches Engineering ermutigt, sich zu bewerben
• Verständnis von analoger und digitaler Elektronik und elektronischen Messtechniken
• Interesse an Hard- und Softwareentwicklung
• Praktischer, praxisnaher und lösungsorientierter Umgang mit technischen Herausforderungen
• Erfahrung mit Altium Designer und/oder KiCad ist von Vorteil
• Python Programmierkenntnisse und Kenntnisse von SAP, sind ein Plus
• Fließende Deutschkenntnisse (geschrieben und gesprochen) und die Fähigkeit, in einem professionellen Umfeld effektiv in Englisch zu kommunizieren, sind erforderlich
Mehr über uns

Wir glauben, dass großartige Arbeit in einem Umfeld gedeiht, in dem sich die Menschen wirklich unterstützt und belohnt fühlen. Unsere Vorteile sind so konzipiert, dass sie für jeden Einzelnen einen echten Mehrwert schaffen – und so Engagement, Leistung und Wachstum fördern. Durch die Priorisierung des Wohlbefindens schaffen wir einen Arbeitsplatz, an dem persönlicher und organisatorischer Erfolg zusammenwachsen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'opportunité

Le groupe d'unités Gate développe, qualifie, supporte la production et gère le cycle de vie des unités Gate pour les appareils IGCT. Nous traduisons les exigences de semi-conducteur, de convertisseur et de système en produits robustes et fiables, couvrant la conception du matériel, le firmware embarqué, la fabrication et les essais.

Pour renforcer notre équipe à Lenzburg, nous sommes à la recherche d'un Senior Electronics Technician – Power Electronics & Testing qui aime combiner un travail technique pratique avec la résolution de problèmes d'ingénierie et veut contribuer à des produits d'électronique de puissance innovants tout au long du cycle de développement.

Ce poste offre une excellente occasion de développer une expertise technique dans l'électronique de puissance et les applications semi-conducteurs tout en travaillant dans un environnement d'ingénierie collaborative et innovante. Vous serez exposés au cycle de vie complet du produit, du développement et des essais au soutien de la production, et contribuerez à des technologies qui aideront à façonner l'avenir de systèmes énergétiques efficaces et durables.

Comment vous ferez un impact

• Appuyer le développement d'unités de porte en collaborant avec des ingénieurs de développement sur la conception de circuits analogiques et numériques, la capture schématique et la mise en page des PCB
• Maintenir l'équipement de laboratoire, l'infrastructure d'essai et l'inventaire, en assurant l'étalonnage, la disponibilité et un environnement de travail sûr et bien organisé
• Contribuer à la mise en œuvre, à l'essai et à la validation des solutions matérielles électroniques
• Coordonner avec les fournisseurs et les partenaires du SGE les activités d'approvisionnement, d'approvisionnement, de gestion des commandes et de manutention des expéditions
• Concevoir, construire et entretenir des installations d'essai, des systèmes d'essai automatisés et des solutions d'acquisition de données pour permettre une validation efficace et fiable des produits
• Effectuer le débogage pratique, la réparation et le retravail des assemblages électroniques pour assurer la qualité et la fiabilité du produit
• Fournir des idées, cerner les possibilités d'amélioration et appuyer l'amélioration continue des produits, des procédés et des capacités d'essai
Vos antécédents

• Apprentissage, qualification de technicien ou baccalauréat en génie électrique, électronique, informatique ou un domaine technique connexe.
• 3-5 ans d'expérience dans le développement, le test, la fabrication ou la validation de l'électronique; alternativement, les diplômés récents avec un baccalauréat et une solide fondation technique combinée à une passion pour le génie pratique sont également encouragés à postuler
• Compréhension de l'électronique analogique et numérique et des techniques de mesure électronique
• Intérêt pour le développement du matériel et des logiciels
• Approche pratique et axée sur la solution des problèmes techniques
• Expérience avec Altium Designer et/ou KiCad est un avantage
• Python compétences de programmation et la connaissance de SAP, sont un plus
• Des compétences linguistiques (écrites et parlées) et la capacité de communiquer efficacement en anglais dans un environnement professionnel sont requises
Plus sur nous

Nous croyons que le grand travail prospère dans un environnement où les gens se sentent véritablement soutenus et récompensés. Nos avantages sont conçus pour créer une valeur réelle pour chaque individu – alimenter l'engagement, la performance et la croissance. En priorisant le bien-être, nous construisons un milieu de travail où la réussite personnelle et organisationnelle se développe ensemble.

• Führen Sie praktisches Debuggen, Reparieren und Überarbeiten von elektronischen Baugruppen durch, um Produktqualität und Zuverlässigkeit zu gewährleisten

Dein Hintergrund

descriptionByLocale.fr:

• Intérêt pour le développement du matériel et des logiciels
