descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità

Unisciti al nostro team di Automazione Industriale e contribuire a modellare soluzioni di produzione avanzate in un ambiente tecnologico ad alta tensione. In questo ruolo, supporterai progetti di automazione e digitalizzazione innovativi collaborando con ingegneri esperti in automazione, test e produzione. Acquisrai una preziosa esposizione alla gestione del progetto, ai processi ingegneristici e alle tecnologie industriali, aiutando a trasformare le idee in soluzioni pratiche. Se ti piace il pensiero analitico, il lavoro di squadra e l'apprendimento continuo, questo tirocinio di 6 - 12 mesi offre una piattaforma eccellente per sviluppare sia le tue competenze tecniche che professionali in un ambiente di supporto e inclusivo.

Come farai ad avere un impatto

• Sostenere la pianificazione, l'esecuzione e il coordinamento dei progetti di automazione industriale
• Assistere con le specifiche, la progettazione, l'implementazione e la convalida dei sistemi di automazione
• Preparare e mantenere la documentazione tecnica, i documenti di progetto e le relazioni di ingegneria
• Coordinare le attività tra team di ingegneria, produzione, qualità e fornitori esterni
• Assistenza messa in servizio, risoluzione dei problemi e ottimizzazione di attrezzature e processi automatizzati
• Monitorare i progressi del progetto, le pietre miliari, i rischi e gli elementi di azione
• Contribuire a iniziative di automazione, digitalizzazione e miglioramento continuo
• Collabora con esperti di automazione, test e produzione su progetti di ingegneria del mondo reale
Il tuo sfondo

• Attualmente iscritta a una laurea o Master, o recentemente laureata, in Ingegneria dell'automazione, Ingegneria elettrica, Meccatronica, o un campo tecnico correlato
• Conoscenza dei sistemi di automazione industriale, ingegneria del controllo e processi produttivi
• Buona comprensione dei sistemi elettrici, degli schemi e della strumentazione e dell'esperienza con l'analisi dei dati
• Familiare con PLC, sistemi HMI/SCADA, reti industriali, sensori e attuatori. MATLAB, Python, LabVIEW, C++, C e Power BI sono un vantaggio.
• Interessi nella gestione del progetto e collaborazione interfunzionale con una forte documentazione e capacità di scrittura tecnica
• Forte capacità di problem solving, comunicazione, documentazione e lavoro di squadra
• Buone competenze scritte e parlate in inglese
Ulteriori informazioni su di noi

Siamo un'azienda tecnologica con una forte attenzione all'innovazione, al miglioramento continuo e alla produzione sostenibile. Offriamo condizioni di lavoro flessibili, mentorship dedicata, e un ambiente di supporto e inclusivo in cui si può crescere personalmente e professionalmente - consentendo di prosperare mentre bilanciare la vita e il lavoro.
descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity

Join our Industrial Automation team and contribute to shaping advanced manufacturing solutions in a high-voltage technology environment. In this role, you will support innovative automation and digitalization projects while collaborating with experienced engineers across automation, testing, and manufacturing. You will gain valuable exposure to project management, engineering processes, and industrial technologies, helping transform ideas into practical solutions. If you enjoy analytical thinking, teamwork, and continuous learning, this 6 - 12 months internship offers an excellent platform to develop both your technical and professional skills in a supportive and inclusive environment.

How you'll make an impact

• Support the planning, execution, and coordination of industrial automation projects
• Assist with the specification, design, implementation, and validation of automation systems
• Prepare and maintain technical documentation, project records, and engineering reports
• Coordinate activities between engineering teams, production, quality, and external suppliers
• Support commissioning, troubleshooting, and optimization of automated equipment and processes
• Monitor project progress, milestones, risks, and action items
• Contribute to automation, digitalization, and continuous improvement initiatives
• Collaborate with automation, testing, and manufacturing experts on real-world engineering projects
Your background

• Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree, or recently graduated, in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field
• Knowledge of industrial automation systems, control engineering, and manufacturing processes
• Good understanding of electrical systems, schematics, and instrumentation as well as experience with data analysis
• Familiar with PLCs, HMI/SCADA systems, industrial networks, sensors, and actuators. MATLAB, Python, LabVIEW, C++, C and Power BI are an advantage.
• Interest in project management and cross-functional collaboration with strong documentation and technical writing skills
• Strong analytical problem-solving, communication, documentation, and teamwork skills
• Good written and spoken English skills
More about us

We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Chance

Treten Sie unserem Team für Industrieautomation bei und tragen Sie dazu bei, fortschrittliche Fertigungslösungen in einer Hochspannungstechnologieumgebung zu gestalten. In dieser Funktion unterstützen Sie innovative Automatisierungs- und Digitalisierungsprojekte und arbeiten mit erfahrenen Ingenieuren in den Bereichen Automatisierung, Test und Fertigung zusammen. Sie erhalten wertvolle Einblicke in Projektmanagement, Engineering-Prozesse und industrielle Technologien und helfen, Ideen in praktische Lösungen zu verwandeln. Wenn Sie analytisches Denken, Teamwork und kontinuierliches Lernen genießen, bietet dieses 6 - 12-monatige Praktikum eine hervorragende Plattform, um sowohl Ihre technischen als auch Ihre beruflichen Fähigkeiten in einem unterstützenden und integrativen Umfeld zu entwickeln.

Wie Sie eine Wirkung erzielen werden

• Unterstützung bei der Planung, Durchführung und Koordination von industriellen Automatisierungsprojekten
• Unterstützung bei der Spezifikation, dem Design, der Implementierung und der Validierung von Automatisierungssystemen
• Bereiten und pflegen Sie technische Dokumentation, Projektaufzeichnungen und technische Berichte
• Koordination der Aktivitäten zwischen Ingenieurteams, Produktion, Qualität und externen Lieferanten
• Unterstützung der Inbetriebnahme, Fehlerbehebung und Optimierung von automatisierten Geräten und Prozessen
• Überwachen Sie den Projektfortschritt, Meilensteine, Risiken und Aktionspunkte
• Beitrag zu Automatisierung, Digitalisierung und kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsinitiativen
• Zusammenarbeit mit Automatisierungs-, Test- und Fertigungsexperten bei realen Engineering-Projekten
Dein Hintergrund

• Derzeit eingeschrieben in einem Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss oder kürzlich absolviert, in Automatisierungstechnik, Elektrotechnik, Mechatronik oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich
• Kenntnisse über industrielle Automatisierungssysteme, Steuerungstechnik und Fertigungsprozesse
• Gutes Verständnis von elektrischen Systemen, Schaltplänen und Instrumenten sowie Erfahrung mit Datenanalyse
• Vertraut mit SPS, HMI/SCADA-Systemen, industriellen Netzwerken, Sensoren und Aktoren. MATLAB, Python, LabVIEW, C++, C und Power BI sind von Vorteil.
• Interesse an Projektmanagement und funktionsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit mit starken Dokumentations- und technischen Schreibfähigkeiten
• Starke analytische Problemlösung, Kommunikation, Dokumentation und Teamfähigkeit
• Gute geschriebene und gesprochene Englischkenntnisse
Mehr über uns

Wir sind ein technologiegetriebenes Unternehmen mit einem starken Fokus auf Innovation, kontinuierliche Verbesserung und nachhaltige Fertigung. Wir bieten flexible Arbeitsbedingungen, engagierte Mentorenschaft und ein unterstützendes, integratives Umfeld, in dem Sie persönlich und beruflich wachsen können - und ermöglichen Ihnen, zu gedeihen und gleichzeitig Leben und Arbeit in Einklang zu bringen.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity

Are you passionate about protecting people, safeguarding the environment, and driving a strong health and safety culture in a manufacturing environment? As our HSE Manager for the Generator Circuit Breaker (GCB) factory in Switzerland, you will take full ownership of the Health, Safety, and Environment function and play a key role in shaping a safe, compliant, and sustainable workplace across our operations.

In this position, you will lead and develop the local HSE organization, including one direct report, while acting as the trusted advisor to business leadership and operational teams. You will collaborate closely with managers, employees, contractors, and external stakeholders to ensure the highest HSE standards, drive continuous improvement initiatives, and contribute to Hitachi Energy's ambition of achieving zero life changing injuries.

How you'll make an impact

• Lead the HSE function for GCB Switzerland and provide leadership, coaching, and development to one direct report
• Ensure strong commitment to health, safety, and environmental standards, management systems, corporate requirements, and legal obligations
• Partner with business leaders and operational teams to integrate HSE into daily decision-making and business processes
• Communicate HSE initiatives, programs, and best practices to ensure a consistent understanding and application across the organization
• Monitor compliance with Swiss regulations, Hitachi Energy policies, and ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 requirements, ensuring timely resolution of non-conformances
• Implement, maintain, and continuously improve the HSE Management System and associated governance processes
• Lead HSE audits, inspections, and assurance activities while ensuring effective follow-up and closure of identified actions
• Investigate incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions, identify root causes, and drive sustainable corrective and preventive actions
• Support factory operations, engineering projects, facility modifications, and investment initiatives through risk assessments and expert HSE guidance
• Oversee contractor safety management and ensure effective risk controls for external service providers working on site
• Lead HSE Reviews, monitor key performance indicators, and provide management with meaningful performance insights
• Promote employee engagement and foster a proactive safety culture through training, campaigns, leadership involvement, and continuous improvement initiatives
• Collaborate with local, regional, and global HSE networks to drive standardization, share best practices, and support strategic HSE programs

Your background

• 5+ years of experience in a managerial HSE role within a manufacturing, industrial, engineering, or energy-related environment
• Certified HSE professional according to Swiss legislation
• Strong leadership personality with proven experience in leading teams and influencing stakeholders across all organizational levels
• Sound understanding of occupational health, safety, environmental, and sustainability requirements within industrial operations
• Practical hands-on experience in developing, implementing, and managing HSE management systems and improvement programs
• Strong knowledge of Swiss HSE legislation and international standards such as ISO 14001 and ISO 45001
• Experience conducting risk assessments, incident investigations, audits, and compliance reviews
• Ability to analyze complex risks, identify practical solutions, and drive sustainable improvements
• Strong interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills with the ability to engage employees, managers, and external stakeholders
• International experience and intercultural awareness are considered an advantage
• Solution-oriented, proactive, and resilient personality with a strong commitment to operational excellence
• Fluent in English and German, both written and spoken

More about us
Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'opportunité

Êtes-vous passionné par la protection des personnes, la protection de l'environnement et la promotion d'une solide culture de la santé et de la sécurité dans un environnement manufacturier? En tant que responsable HSE de l'usine de disjoncteur (GCB) en Suisse, vous serez pleinement propriétaire de la fonction Santé, Sécurité et Environnement et jouerez un rôle clé dans la mise en place d'un lieu de travail sûr, conforme et durable dans l'ensemble de nos opérations.

Dans ce poste, vous dirigerez et développerez l'organisation locale de SSE, y compris un rapport direct, tout en agissant à titre de conseiller de confiance auprès du leadership des entreprises et des équipes opérationnelles. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les gestionnaires, les employés, les entrepreneurs et les intervenants externes pour assurer les normes HSE les plus élevées, mener des initiatives d'amélioration continue et contribuer à l'ambition d'Hitachi Energy d'obtenir des blessures sans changement de vie.

Comment vous ferez un impact

• Diriger la fonction HSE pour GCB Suisse et assurer le leadership, le coaching et le développement d'un rapport direct
• Assurer un engagement ferme envers les normes en matière de santé, de sécurité et d'environnement, les systèmes de gestion, les exigences organisationnelles et les obligations juridiques
• S'associer avec les chefs d'entreprise et les équipes opérationnelles pour intégrer le HSE dans les processus décisionnels et opérationnels quotidiens
• Communiquer les initiatives, les programmes et les pratiques exemplaires de l'ESH afin d'assurer une compréhension et une application cohérentes dans l'ensemble de l'organisation
• Surveiller la conformité avec la réglementation suisse, les politiques Hitachi Energy et les exigences ISO 14001 et ISO 45001, en veillant à la résolution rapide des non-conformités
• Mettre en oeuvre, maintenir et améliorer continuellement le système de gestion des SST et les processus de gouvernance connexes
• Diriger les vérifications, les inspections et les activités d'assurance en matière de SST tout en assurant un suivi et une clôture efficaces des mesures identifiées
• Enquêter sur les incidents, les quasi-incidents et les conditions dangereuses, identifier les causes profondes et prendre des mesures correctives et préventives durables
• Appuyer les opérations des usines, les projets d'ingénierie, les modifications d'installations et les initiatives d'investissement au moyen d'évaluations des risques et d'orientations spécialisées en matière de SST
• Superviser la gestion de la sécurité des entrepreneurs et assurer un contrôle efficace des risques pour les fournisseurs de services externes travaillant sur place
• Plomb HSE Examiner, surveiller les principaux indicateurs de rendement et fournir à la direction des renseignements utiles sur le rendement
• Promouvoir l'engagement des employés et favoriser une culture de sécurité proactive par la formation, les campagnes, la participation des dirigeants et les initiatives d'amélioration continue
• Collaborer avec les réseaux locaux, régionaux et mondiaux de SST pour favoriser la normalisation, partager les meilleures pratiques et appuyer les programmes stratégiques de SST

Vos antécédents

• 5+ ans d'expérience dans un rôle de management HSE dans un environnement industriel, industriel, d'ingénierie ou lié à l'énergie
• Professionnel certifié HSE selon la législation suisse
• Personnalité de leadership solide ayant fait ses preuves dans les équipes dirigeantes et influençant les parties prenantes à tous les niveaux organisationnels
• Une bonne compréhension des exigences en matière de santé, de sécurité, d'environnement et de durabilité au sein des activités industrielles
• Expérience pratique de l'élaboration, de la mise en oeuvre et de la gestion des systèmes de gestion et des programmes d'amélioration des SST
• Forte connaissance de la législation suisse en matière de sécurité sanitaire et des normes internationales telles que ISO 14001 et ISO 45001
• Expérience en matière d'évaluation des risques, d'enquêtes sur les incidents, de vérifications et d'examens de la conformité
• Capacité d'analyser les risques complexes, de trouver des solutions pratiques et de favoriser des améliorations durables
• Fortes aptitudes en relations interpersonnelles, en communication et en présentation avec la capacité de mobiliser les employés, les gestionnaires et les intervenants externes
• L'expérience internationale et la sensibilisation interculturelle sont considérées comme un avantage
• Personnalité axée sur la solution, proactive et résiliente, avec un engagement fort envers l'excellence opérationnelle
• En anglais et en allemand, écrits et parlés

Plus sur nous
Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et professionnelle tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

Êtes-vous passionné par la transformation des données en idées utiles et aider les organisations à améliorer leur façon d'exécuter les projets?
Nous cherchons un analyste du rendement opérationnel et du portefeuille de projets pour renforcer notre organisation d'excellence en exécution de projets. Dans ce rôle, vous rassemblerez des données sur les projets, les portefeuilles et les opérations pour créer de la transparence, identifier les possibilités d'amélioration et appuyer la prise de décisions fondées sur les faits dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise.
Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les opérations de projet, la gestion de portefeuille, les équipes d'excellence opérationnelle et les principaux intervenants, fournissant les renseignements nécessaires pour améliorer le rendement de l'exécution et favoriser l'amélioration continue.

• Élaborer et tenir à jour des ICR, des tableaux de bord, des cartes de pointage et des rapports sur le rendement des projets, des portefeuilles et des opérations
• Surveiller et analyser les principales mesures, y compris le calendrier, le coût, la rentabilité, la qualité, la santé des projets, l'utilisation des ressources et l'exposition aux risques
• Identifier les tendances, les écarts, les risques et les écarts de rendement et traduire vos constatations en recommandations concrètes

descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity

At Hitachi Energy, you'll have the opportunity to lead complex and meaningful GIS projects that support the energy transition around the world. As a Project Manager, you will work with diverse international teams, customers, and stakeholders to deliver innovative solutions that make a real impact.

We are looking for a collaborative and proactive leader who enjoys bringing people together, solving challenges, and driving successful project outcomes. Whether your experience comes from GIS, substations, power infrastructure, or a related industrial environment, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives, leadership potential, and a growth mindset just as much as specific industry experience.

How you'll make an impact

• Lead complex international projects throughout the entire project lifecycle, from project handover through engineering, manufacturing, installation, commissioning, and final delivery

• Take ownership of project execution, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards

• Build trusted partnerships with customers and serve as their primary point of contact throughout project delivery

• Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams across engineering, operations, supply chain, and service functions worldwide

• Foster strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to drive alignment and project success

• Proactively identify risks, opportunities, and improvement initiatives while guiding the team through challenges and change

• Manage commercial aspects of projects, including contracts, claims, forecasting, and financial performance

• Support continuous improvement efforts and contribute to knowledge sharing, mentoring, and the development of project management excellence within the organization

Your background

• Master's degree in electrical engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field

• Several years of experience driving complex international projects in a global industrial environment

• Experience within GIS, substations, power transmission, energy infrastructure, or similar industries is highly valued

• Being able to drive project delivery, stakeholder management, and customer engagement

• Business and financial acumen with experience managing budgets, schedules, risks, and contracts

• Ability to lead cross-functional teams and successfully navigate complex, multicultural project environments

• Project Management certification (PMP, IPMA, or equivalent) is an advantage but not essential

• Fluent in English, additional languages such as French, Italian or German are a plus

• An organized, resilient, and solution-oriented mindset with a passion for collaboration and delivering value to customers

We know that no candidate meets every qualification listed above. If you're excited about this opportunity and believe your experience can contribute to our success, we encourage you to apply. We welcome diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.

More about us

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity

Hitachi Energy's High Voltage Products business is a global leader in power transmission and distribution. At our Zurich-Oerlikon site, we develop and manufacture gas-insulated switchgear (GIS) that helps deliver reliable electrical energy worldwide.

We are looking for a Project Manager Structural Engineering to join our team. In this role, you will manage technical engineering projects in close collaboration with our project team in the Czech Republic, support projects throughout their lifecycle, and lead technical discussions with internal and external stakeholders.

You bring a degree in Civil Engineering and several years of experience in structural engineering, steel construction, or a related field. You enjoy working in an international environment, coordinating multidisciplinary teams, and driving projects forward with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset.

If you're excited about this opportunity, we encourage you to apply, even if your experience doesn't perfectly match every requirement.

How you'll make an impact

• Manage structural engineering projects throughout the entire lifecycle, from sales support and design to fabrication and on-site installation
• Take technical and commercial responsibility for project execution, ensuring compliance with standards, timelines, costs, and quality targets
• Collaborate closely with sales, project management, engineering teams, and customers to define project requirements and deliver effective solutions
• Act as the interface between GIS project engineering and structural engineering, ensuring smooth coordination across disciplines
• Lead and coordinate engineering activities with teams in Brno (Czech Republic), Chennai (India), and external partners
• Initiate and oversee supply chain activities related to the procurement and fabrication of steel structures and platforms
• Ensure high-quality project delivery by reviewing engineering deliverables, resolving technical and quality issues, and supporting factories and site teams
• Drive continuous improvement by sharing lessons learned, supporting root cause analysis, and implementing sustainable solutions to enhance future project execution
Your background

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Civil Engineering or a related field
• 3+ years of experience in technical project management within civil engineering, ideally in steel structures, industrial plants, substations, or energy infrastructure
• Experience with GIS projects or substation engineering is a strong advantage
• Proficiency in CAD tools (2D and 3D AutoCAD); experience with BIM software such as Tekla Structures is beneficial

• Experience working with SAP or similar ERP systems is advantageous
• Strong communication and organizational skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in international and cross-functional teams
• Professional proficiency in English; German or additional languages are considered an advantage
More about us

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity

Hitachi Energy's High Voltage Products business is a global leader in power transmission and distribution. At our Zurich-Oerlikon site, we develop and manufacture gas-insulated switchgear (GIS) that helps deliver reliable electrical energy worldwide.

We are looking for a Project Manager Structural Engineering to join our team. In this role, you will manage technical engineering projects in close collaboration with our project team in the Czech Republic, support projects throughout their lifecycle, and lead technical discussions with internal and external stakeholders.

You bring a degree in Civil Engineering and several years of experience in structural engineering, steel construction, or a related field. You enjoy working in an international environment, coordinating multidisciplinary teams, and driving projects forward with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset.

If you're excited about this opportunity, we encourage you to apply, even if your experience doesn't perfectly match every requirement.

How you'll make an impact

• Manage structural engineering projects throughout the entire lifecycle, from sales support and design to fabrication and on-site installation
• Take technical and commercial responsibility for project execution, ensuring compliance with standards, timelines, costs, and quality targets
• Collaborate closely with sales, project management, engineering teams, and customers to define project requirements and deliver effective solutions
• Act as the interface between GIS project engineering and structural engineering, ensuring smooth coordination across disciplines
• Lead and coordinate engineering activities with teams in Brno (Czech Republic), Chennai (India), and external partners
• Initiate and oversee supply chain activities related to the procurement and fabrication of steel structures and platforms
• Ensure high-quality project delivery by reviewing engineering deliverables, resolving technical and quality issues, and supporting factories and site teams
• Drive continuous improvement by sharing lessons learned, supporting root cause analysis, and implementing sustainable solutions to enhance future project execution
Your background

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Civil Engineering or a related field
• 3+ years of experience in technical project management within civil engineering, ideally in steel structures, industrial plants, substations, or energy infrastructure
• Experience with GIS projects or substation engineering is a strong advantage
• Proficiency in CAD tools (2D and 3D AutoCAD); experience with BIM software such as Tekla Structures is beneficial
• Understanding of structural design standards and building codes (e.g., Eurocodes, AISC, EN 1090); experience with structural analysis software such as SCIA Engineer or STAAD.Pro is a plus
• Experience working with SAP or similar ERP systems is advantageous
• Strong communication and organizational skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in international and cross-functional teams
• Professional proficiency in English; German or additional languages are considered an advantage
More about us

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity
Join Hitachi Energy and become the key link between our customers in Eastern Europe and Ukraine and our global service and engineering teams. In this impactful role, you will combine technical expertise, project management, and customer focus to resolve complex quality and service challenges, drive successful recovery projects, and help ensure the reliability of critical energy infrastructure across the region.

How you'll make an impact

• Serve as the primary customer interface for quality and service-related matters in Eastern Europe, with a strong focus on Ukraine.
• Act as the communication and coordination bridge between customers, local Ukrainian organizations, and Hitachi Energy's Engineering, Troubleshooting, and Service teams in Switzerland.
• Assess equipment damages and technical issues related to Gas-Insulated Switchgear (GIS) and Generator Circuit Breakers (GCB).
• Coordinate repair, refurbishment, and recovery activities from initial damage assessment through successful project completion.
• Support field service teams remotely during inspections, troubleshooting activities, and emergency interventions.
• Prepare professional damage assessment reports, technical findings, and repair recommendations in Ukrainian and Russian.
• Review, translate, and communicate field reports, inspection findings, technical documentation, and repair proposals between customers and internal stakeholders.
• Manage communication with customers throughout the repair process, ensuring transparency, responsiveness, and alignment of expectations.
• Coordinate technical clarifications, material requirements, logistics interfaces, and repair schedules between Ukraine and the Service Switzerland organization.
• Communicate technical findings, corrective actions, repair recommendations, and mitigation measures to customers and relevant stakeholders.
• Ensure timely escalation, tracking, and resolution of quality and service-related issues.
• Support the implementation and continuous improvement of quality assurance, service, and project management processes.
• Build and maintain strong customer relationships through proactive communication and professional issue management.
• Travel within Eastern Europe and Ukraine as required.

Your background

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, preferably Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or Information Technology.
• Experience in project management, service operations, installation, maintenance, or repair of high-voltage equipment.
• Knowledge of Gas-Insulated Switchgear (GIS), Generator Circuit Breakers (GCB), or related high-voltage equipment is highly desirable.
• Experience in coordinating complex technical projects involving multiple stakeholders and international teams.
• Fluency in Ukrainian, Russian, and English is mandatory.
• German language skills are considered a strong advantage.
• Excellent technical writing skills with the ability to prepare professional reports and customer communications in Ukrainian and Russian.
• Strong interpersonal, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to work effectively across cultures and in a dynamic international environment.
• Strong problem-solving, negotiation, and customer-facing communication skills.
• Willingness to travel internationally (approximately 10-20%).

More about us
We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity

We are looking for a Secondary Design Engineer to join our GIS engineering team. This role is ideal for candidates who have completed an apprenticeship (EFZ) in electrical engineering, automation, or a related discipline and have gained 2–3 years of experience in engineering design or drafting.
As part of our engineering team, you will create electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical documentation for high-voltage GIS substation projects. You will collaborate with experienced engineers, project managers, and global engineering teams while developing your expertise in engineering standards, tools, and technologies. The role offers a clear development path towards greater technical ownership and responsibility within an international engineering environment.

How you'll make an impact

• Prepare schematics and related engineering documents for GIS secondary engineering scopes, including LCC and digital substation applications
• Support engineering execution across project phases, from base design and detail design through manufacturing documentation and as-built updates
• Create preliminary BOMs, reports, and manufacturing documents using approved engineering tools and standard processes
• Perform structured self-checks and contribute to technically correct, high-quality, and standard-compliant deliverables
• Support technical clarifications with internal stakeholders, project teams, and factories, and help document and close open points
• Contribute to continuous improvement, standardization, and engineering best practices, including participation in relevant expert communities
• Apply internal guidelines, engineering standards, and quality requirements while supporting safe and efficient project execution
Your background

• Completed apprenticeship (EFZ) as an Electrical Draftsman, Automation Technician, Electrical Technician, or a comparable electrical engineering qualification
• 2–3 years of professional experience in electrical engineering design, drafting, automation, or engineering project execution
• Further education such as Technician School (HF), Technical College, or equivalent continuing education is preferred
• A Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering may be considered, but this role is intentionally targeted at technicians and engineering professionals with hands-on design experience rather than advanced academic profiles
• Good understanding of electrical engineering principles and interest in high-voltage substations and GIS technology
• Ability to read, understand, and create electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and engineering documentation
• Experience with CAD or engineering software is required
• Structured and reliable working style with attention to detail
• Good teamwork and communication skills
• Good English skills; German is an advantage
More about us

Hitachi Energy is a global technology leader advancing a sustainable energy future for all. You will work in a collaborative and international environment where innovation, learning, and continuous improvement are part of everyday work.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità

Il nostro business unit Grid Automation ha un portafoglio completo di soluzioni. Questi spaziano dall'automazione della sottostazione, dalle reti di comunicazione, dai servizi di automazione della griglia, dalle soluzioni di bordo della griglia alle soluzioni software aziendali. Queste soluzioni affrontano tutti i segmenti chiave collegati al sistema energetico, tra cui la generazione, la distribuzione della trasmissione, le industrie, i trasporti e i settori delle infrastrutture.

Per rafforzare il nostro team Engineering, stiamo cercando un esperto Senior System Engineer (SCADA) per sostenere progetti impegnativi nel campo dell'automazione delle sottostazione per installazioni ad alta e media tensione. In questo ruolo chiave, unirete forti competenze tecniche con la responsabilità del progetto e una mentalità focalizzata sul cliente. Svilupperai soluzioni di automazione innovative, coordini interfacce tecniche e supporti progetti dalla fase concept attraverso l'ingegneria e il test per la messa in servizio di successo. Se state cercando di contribuire alla vostra esperienza in un ambiente internazionale e contribuire a plasmare il futuro delle reti di energia intelligenti, non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione.

Le tue responsabilità

• Progettazione e realizzazione di sistemi SCADA per sottostazioni ad alta e media tensione basate su IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-104/-101/-103, Modbus, DNP, OPC e altri protocolli di comunicazione pertinenti
• Sviluppare architetture di sistema e di rete e integrare sistemi RTU, gateway, protezione e automazione in ambienti complessi
• Configurare e parametrizzare le reti di comunicazione basate su Ethernet e implementare funzionalità e applicazioni software specifiche per progetti
• Eseguire il sistema, l'integrazione e i test di accettazione della fabbrica (FAT) per garantire il massimo livello di qualità del sistema
• Sostenere le attività di messa in servizio e gli interventi di assistenza presso i siti dei clienti, principalmente in Svizzera, tra cui la risoluzione dei problemi e la risoluzione di problemi tecnici complessi
• Prendere la proprietà tecnica all'interno di progetti e consigliare i clienti su soluzioni di automazione e comunicazione ottimali
• Collabora a stretto contatto con i team di project management, vendita, fornitori e ingegneria interna per garantire l'esecuzione di progetti di successo
• Preparare le specifiche tecniche, i concetti di sistema e di rete, la documentazione di prova, nonché i manuali di funzionamento e formazione
• Contribuire al miglioramento continuo delle norme di ingegneria, dei processi e delle migliori pratiche nel campo dell'automazione di sottostazione
Il tuo sfondo

• Corso di laurea o master in ingegneria elettrica, ingegneria elettrica, ingegneria dell'automazione, o una qualifica tecnica comparabile
• Min 5 anni di esperienza nell'automazione energetica, nell'automazione delle sottostazione, nei sistemi SCADA o RTU
• Forte conoscenza dei protocolli di comunicazione industriale, delle architetture di rete e della sicurezza informatica all'interno di ambienti infrastrutturali critici
• Esperienza con sistemi basati su IEC 61850 e integrazione di sistemi di protezione, controllo e automazione
• La conoscenza di MicroSCADA, RTU500, o IET600 è considerata un vantaggio
• Esperienza nel coordinamento tecnico del progetto, consulenza clienti, prove di accettazione della fabbrica (FAT), messa in servizio e/o formazione del cliente
• Stile di lavoro indipendente, strutturato e orientato alla soluzione con forti capacità di comunicazione, coordinamento e risoluzione dei problemi
• Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese, sia scritta che parlata. Le competenze linguistiche tedesche sono un vantaggio ma non richiesto
• Altre lingue sono benvenuti
Ulteriori informazioni su di noi

Crediamo che il grande lavoro prosperi in un ambiente in cui le persone si sentono sinceramente sostenute e abbastanza ricompensate. I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per creare valore reale per ogni individuo – il rifornimento di impegno, le prestazioni e la crescita. Con la priorità del benessere, costruiamo un posto di lavoro dove il successo personale e organizzativo crescono insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity

Our Grid Automation business unit has a comprehensive portfolio of solutions. These range from substation automation, communication networks, grid automation services, grid edge solutions to enterprise software solutions. These solutions address all key segments connected to the energy system including generation, transmission distribution, industries, transportation, and infrastructure sectors.

To strengthen our Engineering team, we are looking for an experienced Senior System Engineer (SCADA) to support challenging projects in the field of substation automation for high- and medium-voltage installations. In this key role, you will combine strong technical expertise with project responsibility and a customer-focused mindset. You will develop innovative automation solutions, coordinate technical interfaces, and support projects from the concept phase through engineering and testing to successful commissioning. If you are looking to contribute your experience in an international environment and help shape the future of intelligent power grids, we look forward to receiving your application.

Your responsibilities

• Design and implement SCADA systems for high- and medium-voltage substations based on IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-104/-101/-103, Modbus, DNP, OPC, and other relevant communication protocols
• Develop system and network architectures and integrate RTU, gateway, protection, and automation systems into complex plant environments
• Configure and parameterize Ethernet-based communication networks and implement project-specific functionalities and software applications

Das Team entwickelt ökoeffiziente Lösungen für Hochspannungsanwendungen. Sie werden an fortgeschrittener Forschung und industrieller Umsetzung arbeiten.
Sie tragen zu Spitzenprojekten in gasisolierten Schaltanlagen bei. Sie werden über Forschungszentren und Geschäftseinheiten hinweg zusammenarbeiten. Die Rolle bietet sowohl theoretische als auch praktische Tests.
Sie werden Ihre Expertise in der Hochspannungstechnik und Gasphysik erweitern. Sie werden Ihre Fähigkeiten in Simulationen und experimentellen Methoden stärken. Sie werden in einer kollaborativen und vielfältigen Umgebung arbeiten.
Diese Rolle bietet starke Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und technisches Eigentum. Sie tragen zu zukunftsfähigen, nachhaltigen Energielösungen bei.

Wie Sie eine Wirkung erzielen werden

• Aktiver Beitrag zu Forschungsprojekten in Gasisolationsanwendungen

• Durchführung von Untersuchungen zur Spannungsfestigkeit, dielektrischen Rückgewinnung, Teilentladung

• Planung und Durchführung von experimentellen Hochspannungsstudien

• Modell, Simulation, Interpretation von Gasentladungsphänomenen

• Entwicklung innovativer Konzepte für gasisolierte Technologien

• Support Design und Optimierung von HV-Schaltanlagen

• Zusammenarbeit mit globalen Teams und externen Forschungsinstituten

• Ergebnisse dokumentieren, Ergebnisse veröffentlichen und Ihre Arbeit auf internationalen Konferenzen präsentieren

Dein Hintergrund

• PhD in Elektrotechnik, Physik oder verwandten Bereich mit Anwendung in der Hochspannungstechnik

• Starke Kenntnisse der Gasisolations- und Entladungsphysik

• Praktische Erfahrung in HV-Tests

• Expertise in Simulationstools wie MATLAB, Python oder COMSOL

• Fähigkeit, komplexe Datensätze zu analysieren und Ergebnisse mit statistischen Methoden, modernen KI-Tools zu interpretieren

• Solide englische Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und strukturierter Arbeitsstil

• Relevante Erfahrung in der industriellen Forschung und Entwicklung ist sehr vorteilhaft

Mehr über uns

Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsweisen helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'opportunité

Rejoignez Hitachi Energy et façonnez des technologies durables à haute tension. Vous rejoindrez une équipe internationale de R-D axée sur l'isolation des gaz. L'équipe développe des solutions éco-efficaces pour les applications à haute tension. Vous travaillerez sur la recherche avancée et la mise en œuvre industrielle.
Vous contribuerez à des projets de pointe dans le domaine des commutateurs à gaz. Vous collaborerez entre les centres de recherche et les unités d'affaires. Le rôle offre une exposition à la fois à la théorie et aux tests pratiques.
Vous développerez votre expertise en ingénierie à haute tension et en physique des gaz. Vous renforcerez vos compétences en simulations et méthodes expérimentales. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement collaboratif et diversifié.
Ce rôle offre de fortes possibilités de développement et de maîtrise technique. Vous contribuerez à des solutions énergétiques durables et prêtes à l'avenir.

Comment vous allez avoir un impact

• Contribuer activement aux projets de recherche sur les applications d'isolation au gaz

• Mener des enquêtes sur la résistance diélectrique, la récupération diélectrique, la décharge partielle

• Planifier et exécuter des études expérimentales à haute tension

• Modéliser, simuler, interpréter les phénomènes de décharge de gaz

• Mettre au point des concepts novateurs pour les technologies à base de gaz

• Conception et optimisation de l'interrupteur HV

• Collaborer avec des équipes mondiales et des instituts de recherche externes

• Documenter les résultats, publier les conclusions et présenter vos travaux lors de conférences internationales

Vos antécédents

• Doctorat en génie électrique, physique ou domaine connexe avec application en génie haute tension

• Forte connaissance de l'isolation des gaz et de la physique des décharges

• Expérience pratique dans les essais HV

• Expertise en outils de simulation tels que MATLAB, Python ou COMSOL

• Capacité d'analyser des ensembles de données complexes et d'interpréter les résultats en utilisant des méthodes statistiques, des outils modernes d'IA

• Solides compétences en communication anglaise et style de travail structuré

• L'expérience pertinente en R-D industrielle est très bénéfique

Plus sur nous

Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et commerciale tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et croître.

descriptionByLocale.en:
About the position
As an assembler, you are responsible for the professional assembly and wiring of modules and systems. You will work with design drawings, schemes and detailed work instructions to ensure that our products meet high quality and safety requirements. Depending on the production order, you work in small teams, in the workshop or in line assembly. In addition, you contribute your experience, support new employees with their training and contribute to an efficient and smooth production process.

You can do that.

• Professional assembly and wiring of modules and systems according to design drawings, diagrams and detailed work instructions
• Execution of production orders in compliance with specified quality and safety standards
• Collaboration in teams of 2 and 3 in joint production orders as well as in workshops, line assembly or individual workstations
• Ensuring careful and high-quality execution of assembly and wiring operations
• Support for new and temporary employees through knowledge transfer and practical guidance
• Active participation in an efficient production process and reliable implementation of the tasks involved

You bring that with you

• Completed training as an automatic technician/EFZ or several years of professional experience as a professional in the field of electrical cabinet construction, preferably in industry or on construction sites
• Technical understanding and ability to safely read and implement design drawings, schemes and work instructions
• Independent and reliable working methods as well as a strong quality and safety awareness
• Teamwork, willingness and joy of working together in small production teams
• Good computer skills are beneficial
• Fluent knowledge of German and willingness to work overtime if necessary

More about us
Hitachi Energy is shaping the energy future with innovative technologies for a sustainable and reliable energy supply. With us, you can expect a modern working environment, a strong team and the opportunity to actively participate in future-oriented solutions.

• Zusammenarbeit in 2er- und 3er-Teams bei gemeinsamen Produktionsaufträgen sowie im Werkstattbetrieb, in der Linienmontage oder an Einzelarbeitsstationen

• Unterstützung neuer Mitarbeitender und temporärer Arbeitskräfte durch Weitergabe von Wissen und praktische Anleitung
• Aktive Mitarbeit an einem effizienten Produktionsablauf sowie zuverlässige Umsetzung der anfallenden Aufgaben

Das bringst du mit

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità
Nella nostra organizzazione basata sui dati, ci basiamo su approfondimenti di processo precisi, tempestivi e di alta qualità per migliorare le prestazioni operative e consentire il processo decisionale informato. In qualità di Celonis CoE Senior Value Engineer (Data & AI Focus), svolgerai un ruolo chiave nel consentire queste intuizioni progettando e mantenendo robuste pipeline di dati, modellando i dati del processo e integrando le informazioni dai principali sistemi aziendali nella piattaforma Celonis.

Inoltre, aiuterete l'industrializzazione dell'intelligenza di processo basata su AI, consentendo intuizioni predittive, automazione e supporto decisionale attraverso SCM e altri domini, riducendo la dipendenza dall'analisi manuale e accelerando la realizzazione del valore.

Come si fa un impatto

• Data Pipeline Engineering: Progettare, costruire e mantenere affidabili pipeline ETL per estrarre, trasformare e caricare i dati da ERP, CRM e altri sistemi aziendali in Celonis.

• Data Modeling: Sviluppa modelli di dati ottimizzati per riflettere i processi aziendali end-to-end, consentendo l'estrazione di processi avanzati, l'analisi delle cause root e le intuizioni basate su AI.

• AI Enablement of Process Intelligence: Abilita casi di utilizzo AI/ML (ad esempio, previsione, rilevamento di anomalia, analisi delle cause root) preparando set di dati di alta qualità, funzionalità e strutture di dati per supportare analisi avanzate.

• Integrazione ProprietÃ: Integra i dati da SAP, Oracle, database, API e fonti esterne, garantendo una costante disponibilitÃ dei dati sia per i casi di analisi che per l'utilizzo di AI.

• AI & Automation Integration: Supporto per l'implementazione delle capacità potenziate dall'IA all'interno di Celonis (EMS, flussi di azione, analisi predittiva, copiloti AI), incorporando l'intelligenza nei flussi di lavoro e nel processo decisionale.

• Ottimizzazione delle prestazioni: migliorare costantemente le prestazioni dei modelli e delle tubazioni di dati Celonis per supportare la scalabilità dei carichi di lavoro di analisi e AI.

• Qualità dei dati per l'AI: Stabilire la convalida dei dati, l'arricchimento e le strutture di pulizia per garantire l'affidabilità delle uscite di report e AI-driven.

• Collaborazione & Abilitazione: Partner con Value Engineers e team aziendali per tradurre i casi di utilizzo dei processi in dati scalabili e soluzioni AI, consentendo un utilizzo più rapido della distribuzione dei casi.

• Documentazione & Trasparenza: Mantenere una chiara documentazione sulle pipeline di dati, la logica di trasformazione, la disponibilità di dati AI e le dipendenze dei modelli.

• Innovazione continua: rimanere corrente con i progressi in Celonis EMS, AI/ML, LLM e ingegneria dei dati, identificare le opportunità per migliorare l'intelligenza di processo con l'automazione e l'intelligenza artificiale.

• Eccellenza Operativa: Supporta lo sviluppo di dashboard, flussi di azione, automazione e approfondimenti assistiti dall'IA per guidare risultati aziendali misurabili.

Il tuo sfondo

• 5+ anni di esperienza in Ingegneria dei dati, costruzione e gestione di piattaforme di dati, condotte, processi ETL e soluzioni di dati aziendali.

• Esperienza pratica comprovata da almeno 2 anni con Celonis, sfruttando l'intelligenza di processo per guidare intuizioni aziendali e miglioramenti operativi.

• Esperienza di integrazione e lavoro con ambienti ERP su larga scala come SAP e Oracle.

• Forte competenza in SQL, database relazionali, modellazione dati, architetture ETL e flussi di dati aziendali.

• Proficienza in Python o linguaggi di scripting simili per la trasformazione, l'automazione e l'ottimizzazione del flusso di lavoro.

• Familiarità con piattaforme cloud, framework di orchestrazione e architetture dati scalabili.

• Comprensione dei concetti AI/ML tra cui analisi predittiva, rilevamento di anomalie, modelli di classificazione e applicazioni di analisi avanzate.

• Esperienza di preparazione e gestione dei dati per casi di utilizzo AI, tra cui la qualità dei dati, l'ingegneria delle caratteristiche e l'integrazione dei modelli nei processi aziendali.

• Capacità di tradurre concetti tecnici, dati e AI complessi in insight aziendali attuabili, collaborando efficacemente in IT, scienza dei dati e team aziendali.

• Passione per l'intelligenza di processo, l'automazione e la trasformazione guidata dall'IA, combinata con una forte mentalità di proprietà, un approccio di apprendimento continuo e eccellenti capacità di comunicazione inglese.

Ulteriori informazioni su di noi
Offriamo un pacchetto di benefici svizzeri competitivo progettato per supportare la vostra crescita professionale e il benessere. A seconda dell'esperienza e del ruolo, questo può includere:

• Piani pensionistici e assicurativi

• Azioni di lavoro flessibili

• Opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo
descriptionByLocale.en:
The Opportunity
In our data‑driven organization, we rely on accurate, timely, and high‑quality process insights to improve operational performance and enable informed decision‑making. As a Celonis CoE Senior Value Engineer (Data & AI Focus), you will play a key role in enabling these insights by designing and maintaining robust data pipelines, modeling process data, and integrating information from core business systems into the Celonis platform.

Additionally, you will help industrialize AI-driven process intelligence, enabling predictive insights, automation, and decision support across SCM and other domains—reducing dependency on manual analysis and accelerating value realization.

How You'll Make an Impact

• Data Pipeline Engineering: Design, build, and maintain reliable ETL pipelines to extract, transform, and load data from ERP, CRM, and other enterprise systems into Celonis.

• Data Modeling: Develop optimized data models to reflect end‑to‑end business processes, enabling advanced process mining, root‑cause analysis, and AI-driven insights.

• AI Enablement of Process Intelligence: Enable AI/ML use cases (e.g., prediction, anomaly detection, root cause analysis) by preparing high-quality datasets, features, and data structures to support advanced analytics.

• Integration Ownership: Integrate data from SAP, Oracle, databases, APIs, and external sources, ensuring consistent data availability for both analytics and AI use cases.

• AI & Automation Integration: Support implementation of AI-powered capabilities within Celonis (EMS, action flows, predictive analytics, AI copilots), embedding intelligence into workflows and decision-making.

• Performance Optimization: Continuously improve performance of Celonis data models and pipelines to support scalability for analytics and AI workloads.

• Data Quality for AI: Establish data validation, enrichment, and cleansing frameworks to ensure reliability of both reporting and AI-driven outputs.

• Collaboration & Enablement: Partner with Value Engineers and business teams to translate process use cases into scalable data and AI solutions, enabling faster use case deployment.

• Documentation & Transparency: Maintain clear documentation on data pipelines, transformation logic, AI data readiness, and model dependencies.

• Continuous Innovation: Stay current with advancements in Celonis EMS, AI/ML, LLMs, and data engineering, identifying opportunities to enhance process intelligence with automation and AI.

• Operational Excellence: Support development of dashboards, action flows, automations, and AI-assisted insights to drive measurable business outcomes.

Your Background

• 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering, building and managing data platforms, pipelines, ETL processes, and enterprise data solutions.

• Minimum 2 years proven hands-on experience with Celonis, leveraging process intelligence to drive business insights and operational improvements.

• Experience integrating and working with large-scale ERP environments such as SAP and Oracle.

• Strong expertise in SQL, relational databases, data modeling, ETL architectures, and enterprise data flows.

• Proficiency in Python or similar scripting languages for data transformation, automation, and workflow optimization.

• Familiarity with cloud platforms, orchestration frameworks, and scalable data architectures.

• Understanding of AI/ML concepts including predictive analytics, anomaly detection, classification models, and advanced analytics applications.

• Experience preparing and managing data for AI use cases, including data quality, feature engineering, and model integration into business processes.

• Ability to translate complex technical, data, and AI concepts into actionable business insights while collaborating effectively across IT, data science, and business teams.

• Passion for Process Intelligence, Automation, and AI-driven transformation, combined with a strong ownership mindset, continuous learning approach, and excellent English communication skills.

More about us
We offer a competitive Swiss benefits package designed to support your professional growth and well‑being. Depending on experience and role, this may include:

• Pension and insurance plans

• Flexible working arrangements

• Learning and development opportunities
descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Chance

Als Celonis CoE Senior Value Engineer (Data & AI Focus) spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Ermöglichung dieser Erkenntnisse, indem Sie robuste Datenpipelines entwerfen und pflegen, Prozessdaten modellieren und Informationen aus Kerngeschäftssystemen in die Celonis-Plattform integrieren.

Darüber hinaus helfen Sie bei der Industrialisierung von KI-gesteuerter Prozessintelligenz, indem Sie prädiktive Erkenntnisse, Automatisierung und Entscheidungsunterstützung in SCM und anderen Bereichen ermöglichen - die Abhängigkeit von manueller Analyse reduzieren und die Wertrealisierung beschleunigen.

Wie Sie einen Einfluss machen werden

• Mindestens 2 Jahre nachgewiesene praktische Erfahrung mit Celonis, die Prozessintelligenz nutzen, um Geschäftserkenntnisse und operative Verbesserungen zu erzielen.

• Erfahrung in der Integration und Arbeit mit großen ERP-Umgebungen wie SAP und Oracle.

• Starke Expertise in SQL, relationalen Datenbanken, Datenmodellierung, ETL-Architekturen und Unternehmensdatenflüssen.

• Kenntnisse in Python oder ähnlichen Skriptsprachen für Datentransformation, Automatisierung und Workflowoptimierung.

• Vertrautheit mit Cloud-Plattformen, Orchestrierungsframeworks und skalierbaren Datenarchitekturen.

• Verständnis von AI/ML-Konzepten, einschließlich Predictive Analytics, Anomalieerkennung, Klassifizierungsmodellen und Advanced Analytics-Anwendungen.

• Erfahrung in der Vorbereitung und Verwaltung von Daten für KI-Anwendungsfälle, einschließlich Datenqualität, Feature Engineering und Modellintegration in Geschäftsprozesse.

• Fähigkeit, komplexe technische, Daten- und KI-Konzepte in umsetzbare Business Insights zu übersetzen und gleichzeitig effektiv in IT-, Data Science- und Business-Teams zusammenzuarbeiten.

• Leidenschaft für Prozessintelligenz, Automatisierung und KI-gesteuerte Transformation, kombiniert mit einer starken Eigenverantwortung, einem kontinuierlichen Lernansatz und hervorragenden Englischkommunikationsfähigkeiten.

Mehr über uns

descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'opportunité
Dans notre organisation axée sur les données, nous comptons sur des renseignements précis, opportuns et de haute qualité sur les processus pour améliorer le rendement opérationnel et permettre une prise de décision éclairée. En tant qu'ingénieur principal de la valeur de Celonis CoE (Data & AI Focus), vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la création et la maintenance de pipelines de données robustes, la modélisation de données de processus et l'intégration de l'information des systèmes d'affaires de base à la plateforme Celonis.

De plus, vous aiderez à industrialiser l'intelligence des processus axée sur l'intelligence artificielle, en permettant des idées prédictives, l'automatisation et le soutien à la décision dans l'ensemble des domaines de MSC et d'autres domaines, ce qui réduira la dépendance à l'analyse manuelle et accélérera la réalisation des valeurs.

Comment vous ferez un impact

• Ingénierie des pipelines de données : Concevoir, construire et entretenir des pipelines ETL fiables pour extraire, transformer et charger des données d'ERP, de CRM et d'autres systèmes d'entreprise en Celonis.

• Modélisation des données : Mettre au point des modèles de données optimisés pour refléter les processus opérationnels de bout en bout, permettant l'exploitation minière avancée des processus, l'analyse des causes profondes et les connaissances axées sur l'IA.

• Integration Ownership: Intégrer les données de SAP, Oracle, bases de données, API et sources externes, en assurant une disponibilité cohérente des données pour les cas d'utilisation de l'analyse et de l'IA.

• Intégration de l'IA et de l'automatisation : Soutenir la mise en œuvre de capacités alimentées par l'IA au sein de Celonis (EMS, flux d'action, analyse prédictive, copilotes d'IA), intégrer l'intelligence dans les flux de travail et la prise de décision.

• Optimisation de la performance : Améliorer continuellement la performance des modèles de données et des pipelines Celonis pour soutenir l'évolutivité des charges de travail en matière d'analyse et d'IA.

• Qualité des données pour l'IA: Établir des cadres de validation, d'enrichissement et de nettoyage des données pour assurer la fiabilité des rapports et des résultats axés sur l'IA.

• Collaboration et activation: Partenaire avec les ingénieurs de valeur et les équipes d'affaires pour traduire les cas d'utilisation de processus en solutions de données évolutives et d'IA, permettant un déploiement de cas d'utilisation plus rapide.

• Documentation et transparence : Conservez une documentation claire sur les pipelines de données, la logique de transformation, l'état de préparation des données sur l'IA et les dépendances des modèles.

• Innovation continue : Restez au courant des progrès réalisés dans Celonis EMS, AI/ML, LLM et l'ingénierie des données, en identifiant les possibilités d'améliorer l'intelligence des processus avec l'automatisation et l'IA.

• Excellence opérationnelle : Appuyer l'élaboration de tableaux de bord, de flux d'action, d'automatisation et de renseignements assistés par l'IA afin d'obtenir des résultats opérationnels mesurables.

Vos antécédents

• 5+ ans d'expérience en Data Engineering, la construction et la gestion de plateformes de données, pipelines, processus ETL, et solutions de données d'entreprise.

• Au moins 2 ans d'expérience pratique éprouvée avec Celonis, en tirant parti de l'intelligence des processus pour générer des idées d'affaires et des améliorations opérationnelles.

• Expérience d'intégration et de travail avec des environnements ERP à grande échelle tels que SAP et Oracle.

• Forte expertise en SQL, bases de données relationnelles, modélisation de données, architectures ETL et flux de données d'entreprise.

• Compétence en Python ou langages de scripts similaires pour la transformation des données, l'automatisation et l'optimisation du workflow.

• Familiarité avec les plateformes cloud, les cadres d'orchestration et les architectures de données évolutives.

• Comprendre les concepts d'IA/ML, y compris l'analyse prédictive, la détection d'anomalies, les modèles de classification et les applications analytiques avancées.

• Expérience de la préparation et de la gestion des données pour les cas d'utilisation de l'IA, y compris la qualité des données, l'ingénierie des caractéristiques et l'intégration des modèles dans les processus opérationnels.

• Capacité de traduire des concepts techniques, de données et d'intelligence artificielle complexes en données opérationnelles exploitables tout en collaborant efficacement entre les équipes de TI, de sciences des données et d'affaires.

• Passion pour l'intelligence des processus, l'automatisation et la transformation induite par l'IA, combinée avec une forte appropriation, une approche d'apprentissage continu et d'excellentes compétences en communication anglaise.

Plus sur nous

titleByLocale.it: Gestione globale della qualità e del miglioramento continuo

descriptionByLocale.it:
In qualità di Global Quality & Continuous Improvement Manager, definirai ed eseguirai la strategia Global Product Group (GPG) di qualità e miglioramento continuo, garantendo una forte governance della funzione Qualità e CI in linea con le priorità aziendali e le direttive globali.

Sarete la voce del cliente, incorporando l'attenzione del cliente su tutta la catena del valore e rafforzare la fiducia attraverso la leadership di qualità proattiva. Sei responsabile per il funzionamento e il continuo miglioramento del sistema di gestione della qualità globale, mantenendo le certificazioni richieste in tutte le unità di acquisizione, e l'eccellenza del processo di guida in scala.
Attraverso indicatori di prestazioni robusti e controlli interni efficaci, monitorerai le prestazioni del processo, le deviazioni degli indirizzi e condurrai azioni correttive e preventive a una chiusura di successo. Avrete anche la proprietà di risolvere non conformità di clienti di alto profilo, salvaguardando la fiducia del cliente attraverso pratiche di qualità disciplinate e trasparenti.

Come modello di ruolo visibile e agente di cambiamento, formerai e rafforzerai attivamente una cultura orientata alla qualità, stimolando il pensiero, influenzando i leader e i coetanei senior, e assicurando che le giuste decisioni supportino l'esecuzione di strategie di qualità globali.

Come farete un impatto:

• Definire e implementare la strategia Global Product Group (GPG) Quality and Continuous Improvement (CI), inclusa la governance della funzione Qualità e CI in linea con le esigenze aziendali e le direttive.
• Agire come sostenitore del Cliente assicurando che la Voce del Cliente sia rappresentata in tutta la catena del valore.
• Gestisci il Global Quality Management System e coordina il continuo miglioramento dei nostri processi aziendali.
• Contabile per mantenere e garantire le certificazioni richieste in tutte le unità nell'ambito GPG.
• Stabilire indicatori di performance di processo e garantire controlli interni efficaci sono in atto per verificare che i processi continuino a soddisfare i requisiti dei clienti e degli stakeholder.
• Analizzare continuamente gli indicatori delle prestazioni del processo e intraprendere azioni per affrontare situazioni in cui le prestazioni del processo deviano dalle aspettative e gestiscono tali deviazioni alla chiusura.
• Gestisci la risoluzione di non conformità del cliente di alto profilo. Proteggere e rafforzare la fiducia dei clienti affrontando efficacemente il feedback attraverso azioni correttive e preventive.
• Agire come modello di ruolo e cambiare agente per il comportamento necessario per sostenere una cultura di qualità. Influenza Senior Managers and Peers per garantire il corretto pensiero e il corretto processo decisionale necessario per sostenere l'implementazione e l'esecuzione di Strategie di Qualità.
Il tuo sfondo:

• Laurea magistrale in Software Engineering o disciplina analitica o tecnica strettamente correlata.
• Portare un'esperienza consistente nel fornire software enterprise di grado industriale, con una solida base nell'ingegneria del software e l'esposizione dimostrata alla garanzia della qualità, alla gestione del prodotto e/o alla gestione del progetto in ambienti complessi.

descriptionByLocale.en:
As Global Quality & Continuous Improvement Manager, you will define and execute the Global Product Group (GPG) Quality and Continuous Improvement strategy, ensuring strong governance of the Quality and CI function in line with business priorities and global directives.

You will be the voice of the customer, embedding customer focus across the entire value chain and strengthening trust through proactive quality leadership. You are accountable for operating and continuously improving the global Quality Management System, maintaining required certifications across all in‑scope units, and driving process excellence at scale.
Through robust performance indicators and effective internal controls, you will monitor process performance, address deviations, and lead corrective and preventive actions to successful closure. You will also take ownership of resolving high‑profile customer non‑conformities, safeguarding customer confidence through disciplined, transparent quality practices.

As a visible role model and change agent, you will actively shape and strengthen a quality‑driven culture—challenging thinking, influencing senior leaders and peers, and ensuring the right decisions support the successful execution of global Quality strategies.

How you'll make an impact:

• Define and implement the Global Product Group (GPG) Quality and Continuous Improvement (CI) strategy, including governance of the Quality and CI function in line with business needs and directives.
• Act as an advocate for the Customer by ensuring the Voice of the Customer is represented throughout the value chain.
• Manage the Global Quality Management System and coordinate the continuous improvement of our business processes.
• Accountable for maintaining and securing required Certifications in all units within the GPG scope.
• Establish process performance indicators, and ensure effective internal controls are in place to verify that processes continue to meet customer and stakeholder requirements.
• Analyze the process performance indicators continuously and take actions to address situations where process performance deviates from expectations and manage such deviations to closure.
• Manage resolution of high-profile customer non-conformities. Protect and strengthen customer trust by effectively addressing feedback through corrective and preventive actions.
• Act as a Role Model and Change Agent for the behavior required to support a Quality Culture. Influence Senior Managers and Peers to ensure the correct thinking and decision making required to support the implementation and execution of Quality Strategies.
Your Background:

• Master's degree in Software Engineering or a closely related analytical or technical discipline.
• Bring substantial experience delivering industry grade enterprise software, with a strong foundation in software engineering and demonstrated exposure to quality assurance, product management, and/or project management within complex environments.
• Successfully owned and operated a global Quality Management System, including leading a software organization through one or more international certification or compliance frameworks
• Hold relevant professional certifications such as Lean, Six Sigma, Capability Maturity Model Integration (CMMI), and/or Quality Auditing, and actively apply these methodologies to drive measurable improvement.
• You have a proven track record of leading continuous improvement and change initiatives, including Root Cause Analyses (RCAs), Kaizen events, Lean Action Workouts, and other structured improvement programs.
• You are an influential and inspiring leader, able to engage teams through clear direction, credibility, and a strong personal commitment to excellence.

Specific information to our Poland organisation ​
At Hitachi Energy, we recognize that our people are at the heart of our success. We are committed to providing a supportive and inclusive workplace, competitive rewards, and opportunities for professional and personal growth. Our benefits package is designed to help employees thrive both at work and in their personal lives.​
​
Our benefits offering for this role generally includes:​

• Private medical care and life insurance​​
• Access to fitness and wellness programs​​
• Access to benefits platform with discounts and perks​​
• Employee Capital Plans (PPK)​​
• Equipment for working from home or allowances for setting up a workplace at home​​
• Spectacles and contact lenses allowance​​
• Company events and team‑building activities​​
• Psychological support program​​
• Free parking available​​
​

descriptionByLocale.fr:
En tant que gestionnaire de la qualité globale et de l'amélioration continue, vous définirez et exécuterez la stratégie de qualité et d'amélioration continue du Groupe de produits mondial (GPG), assurant ainsi une bonne gouvernance de la fonction Qualité et CI conformément aux priorités opérationnelles et aux directives mondiales.

Vous serez la voix du client, intégrant l'attention du client dans toute la chaîne de valeur et renforçant la confiance grâce à un leadership de qualité proactif. Vous êtes responsable de l'exploitation et de l'amélioration continue du système mondial de gestion de la qualité, du maintien des certifications requises dans toutes les unités du champ et de l'excellence des processus à l'échelle.
Grâce à des indicateurs de rendement robustes et à des contrôles internes efficaces, vous surveillerez le rendement du processus, corrigerez les écarts et dirigerez les mesures correctives et préventives à la fermeture réussie. Vous serez également propriétaire de la résolution des non-conformités de haut niveau des clients, en préservant la confiance des clients grâce à des pratiques de qualité disciplinées et transparentes.

En tant que modèle visible et agent de changement, vous façonnerez et renforcerez activement une culture axée sur la qualité, en s'attaquant à la réflexion, en influençant les dirigeants et les pairs et en veillant à ce que les bonnes décisions appuient la bonne exécution des stratégies de qualité mondiales.

Comment vous allez avoir un impact :

• Définir et mettre en œuvre la stratégie du Groupe mondial de produits (GPG) sur la qualité et l'amélioration continue (IC), y compris la gouvernance de la fonction Qualité et IC conformément aux besoins et aux directives des entreprises.
• Agir en tant que défenseur du Client en s'assurant que la Voix du Client est représentée tout au long de la chaîne de valeur.
• Gérer le Système mondial de gestion de la qualité et coordonner l'amélioration continue de nos processus opérationnels.
• Responsable du maintien et de la sécurisation des certifications requises dans toutes les unités de la portée GPG.
• Établir des indicateurs de rendement des processus et s'assurer que des contrôles internes efficaces sont en place pour vérifier que les processus continuent de répondre aux exigences des clients et des intervenants.
• Analyser continuellement les indicateurs de rendement du processus et prendre des mesures pour remédier aux situations où le rendement du processus s'écarte des attentes et gère ces écarts jusqu'à la clôture.
• Gérer la résolution des non-conformités des clients. Protéger et renforcer la confiance des clients en traitant efficacement la rétroaction par des mesures correctives et préventives.
• Agir comme modèle de rôle et agent de changement pour le comportement nécessaire pour soutenir une culture de qualité. Influencer les cadres supérieurs et les pairs pour s'assurer que la pensée et la prise de décision sont correctes pour appuyer la mise en oeuvre et l'exécution des stratégies de qualité.
Vos antécédents :

• Maîtrise en génie logiciel ou discipline analytique ou technique étroitement liée.
• Apporter une expérience considérable en fournissant des logiciels d'entreprise de qualité industrielle, avec une solide base en génie logiciel et une exposition démontrée à l'assurance de la qualité, à la gestion de produits et/ou à la gestion de projets dans des environnements complexes.
• Un système mondial de gestion de la qualité a été mis en place avec succès, notamment grâce à un ou plusieurs cadres internationaux de certification ou de conformité.
• Tenir des certifications professionnelles pertinentes telles que Lean, Six Sigma, Capability Maturity Model Integration (CMMI) et/ou Quality Auditing, et appliquer activement ces méthodologies pour conduire à une amélioration mesurable.
• Vous avez fait la preuve de vos antécédents en menant des initiatives d'amélioration continue et de changement, y compris des analyses de causes profondes (ARC), des événements de Kaizen, des séances d'action Lean et d'autres programmes d'amélioration structurés.
• Vous êtes un leader influent et inspirant, capable d'engager des équipes par une direction claire, une crédibilité et un engagement personnel fort envers l'excellence.

• Gestire le modifiche richieste dal cliente, chiarire ordini incompleti o non chiari, e garantire l'esecuzione accurata attraverso un efficace coordinamento interfunzionale
• Sostenere la risoluzione di blocchi di credito, fatture in ritardo e pagamenti in entrata non chiari in collaborazione con i dipartimenti competenti
• Partner con vendite, esportazione, produzione, imballaggio, qualità e altri team interni per supportare progetti speciali, spedizioni express e requisiti specifici per il cliente
• Contribuire a iniziative di miglioramento continuo, compresi i progetti di automazione, le attività di ottimizzazione dei processi (ad esempio REIWA) e le attività legate alla qualità/CCRP
• Guidare l'eccellenza operativa attraverso una comunicazione efficiente, un coordinamento forte e un approccio orientato al cliente
Il tuo sfondo

• Titolo commerciale o commerciale, o equivalente
