descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity
Shape the Hitachi Energy corporate strategy and drive growth choices!
Are you ready to help define Hitachi Energy's corporate-level strategic direction and translate it into focused growth priorities?
In our Strategy function, we are looking for a Leader Corporate Strategy who can support overall Hitachi Energy strategy formulation, design and improve strategic processes, structure and drive the integrated growth portfolio, and help senior leaders prioritize opportunities based on strategic attractiveness, financial impact, and execution readiness.

This position offers a flexible European location and can be based in Italy, Germany, Spain, the United Kingdom, or Switzerland.

How you´ll make an impact
Shape Hitachi Energy's future growth agenda

• Translate market, customer, technology, and financial insights into strategic priorities that drive long-term growth.
• Identify emerging trends, new growth opportunities, and strategic risks across markets and business models.
• Develop executive-level recommendations and scenarios to support key growth and investment decisions.
• Foster alignment across businesses, regions, functions, and the broader strategy community, including collaboration with the Hitachi Group.
Drive enterprise growth governance

• Shape and manage the growth portfolio, providing visibility of strategic opportunities across the organization.
• Support Growth Board prioritization and investment decisions based on value, strategic fit, and execution feasibility.
• Prepare and facilitate Growth Board discussions and ensure decisions translate into clear actions and measurable outcomes.
Generate strategic & financial insights

• Analyze market dynamics, growth drivers, and investment opportunities to inform enterprise strategy.
• Develop long-term forecasts, scenarios, and business cases that guide strategic choices.
• Translate complex analysis into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership.
Your background
You are an analytical, structured, and collaborative strategy professional who is comfortable working with ambiguity and engaging senior stakeholders on enterprise-level choices. Specifically, you offer:

• University degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Finance, or a related field; an advanced degree such as an MBA is a plus.
• Relevant experience in strategy, sales & marketing, management consulting, corporate development, finance, or strategic planning in an international environment.
• Strong analytical and financial modeling skills, with the ability to develop scenarios, assess opportunities, and translate data into actionable recommendations.
• Experience preparing executive-level materials, facilitating senior meetings, and managing action follow-up across multiple stakeholders.
• Ability to work across business units, regions, and functions with a One Hitachi Energy mindset and strong ownership for outcomes.
• Curiosity about the energy transition, growth markets, technology shifts, and the strategic choices required to inspire the next era of sustainable energy.
• Passion to coach team members and build strategy capabilities by developing common tools, methodologies, templates, and ways of working across the strategy community.
More about us
The minimum salary for this position in the location specified is as follows:​

• Italy: starting from 86,000 EUR (Dirigente)
The final offer will be based on candidate location, skills and qualifications, experience, and aligned with internal pay structures.​
​This role may be open in multiple locations. If the salary information listed is not applicable for your current home location, salary details relevant to your location will be discussed with you at a later stage.​
​
Our benefit offering is tailored based on your country of employment and generally includes:​

• Competitive salary and incentives​
• Well-being and care ​
• Paid and unpaid leave​
• Flexible work options ​
• Benefits that support your financial security​You will receive more specific information during the recruitment process.​

descriptionByLocale.de:
The opportunity
Shape the Hitachi Energy corporate strategy and drive growth choices!
Are you ready to help define Hitachi Energy's corporate-level strategic direction and translate it into focused growth priorities?
In our Strategy function, we are looking for a Leader Corporate Strategy who can support overall Hitachi Energy strategy formulation, design and improve strategic processes, structure and drive the integrated growth portfolio, and help senior leaders prioritize opportunities based on strategic attractiveness, financial impact, and execution readiness.

This position offers a flexible European location and can be based in Italy, Germany, Spain, the United Kingdom, or Switzerland.

How you´ll make an impact
Shape Hitachi Energy's future growth agenda

• Translate market, customer, technology, and financial insights into strategic priorities that drive long-term growth.
• Identify emerging trends, new growth opportunities, and strategic risks across markets and business models.
• Develop executive-level recommendations and scenarios to support key growth and investment decisions.
• Foster alignment across businesses, regions, functions, and the broader strategy community, including collaboration with the Hitachi Group.
Drive enterprise growth governance

• Shape and manage the growth portfolio, providing visibility of strategic opportunities across the organization.
• Support Growth Board prioritization and investment decisions based on value, strategic fit, and execution feasibility.
• Prepare and facilitate Growth Board discussions and ensure decisions translate into clear actions and measurable outcomes.
Generate strategic & financial insights

• Analyze market dynamics, growth drivers, and investment opportunities to inform enterprise strategy.
• Develop long-term forecasts, scenarios, and business cases that guide strategic choices.
• Translate complex analysis into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership.
Your background
You are an analytical, structured, and collaborative strategy professional who is comfortable working with ambiguity and engaging senior stakeholders on enterprise-level choices. Specifically, you offer:

• University degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Finance, or a related field; an advanced degree such as an MBA is a plus.
• Relevant experience in strategy, sales & marketing, management consulting, corporate development, finance, or strategic planning in an international environment.
• Strong analytical and financial modeling skills, with the ability to develop scenarios, assess opportunities, and translate data into actionable recommendations.
• Experience preparing executive-level materials, facilitating senior meetings, and managing action follow-up across multiple stakeholders.
• Ability to work across business units, regions, and functions with a One Hitachi Energy mindset and strong ownership for outcomes.
• Curiosity about the energy transition, growth markets, technology shifts, and the strategic choices required to inspire the next era of sustainable energy.
• Passion to coach team members and build strategy capabilities by developing common tools, methodologies, templates, and ways of working across the strategy community.
More about us
The minimum salary for this position in the location specified is as follows:​

• Italy: starting from 86,000 EUR (Dirigente)
The final offer will be based on candidate location, skills and qualifications, experience, and aligned with internal pay structures.​
​This role may be open in multiple locations. If the salary information listed is not applicable for your current home location, salary details relevant to your location will be discussed with you at a later stage.​
​
Our benefit offering is tailored based on your country of employment and generally includes:​

• Competitive salary and incentives​
• Well-being and care ​
• Paid and unpaid leave​
• Flexible work options ​
• Benefits that support your financial security​You will receive more specific information during the recruitment process.​

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulla posizione
In qualità di ispettore di qualità, assicura che i materiali e i componenti in arrivo soddisfino i nostri requisiti di qualità. Controllare le consegne quantitativamente e qualitativamente, eseguire i controlli dei campioni iniziali e le deviazioni dei documenti. Inoltre, supporta l'assicurazione della qualità e lo sviluppo con specifici ordini di misura, raccogliere dati di qualità e avviare misure adeguate per migliorare la qualità del prodotto. Con la vostra esperienza, la comprensione tecnica e i metodi di lavoro accurati, apportate un contributo importante per garantire i nostri standard di qualità.

Puoi farlo.

• Test qualitativo e quantitativo di ingressi materiali mediante strumenti di misura meccanica, elettrica e ottica e controllo dei documenti associati
• Attuazione dei test iniziali del campione, compresa la preparazione dei rapporti di prova iniziali (ZP) e l'elaborazione della documentazione PPAP richiesta
• Preparazione di relazioni di qualità per la documentazione sistematica delle deviazioni nelle consegne in entrata
• Partecipazione a riunioni pertinenti per promuovere lo scambio di informazioni all'interno dei lavori
• Eseguire specifici compiti di misura, ad esempio per lo sviluppo o la garanzia di qualità
• Garantire la manutenzione di strumenti e strumenti IQC
• Raccolta e valutazione delle statistiche per lo sviluppo di messaggi di errore dall'assemblea (Z2) e l'avvio di misure adeguate per ridurre gli errori
• Creazione e regolazione dei piani di prova secondo le specifiche di R&D o TC

Lo porti con te.

• Formazione tecnica o professionale nonché esperienza approfondita nel controllo della qualità o in un ambiente di produzione comparabile
• Buona conoscenza nell'uso di apparecchiature di misura meccanica, elettrica e ottica, nonché nella valutazione dei documenti tecnici
• Esperienza con test di tipo iniziale, rapporti di prova di tipo iniziale e PPAP è vantaggioso
• Funzionamento analitico e strutturato nonché la capacità di rilevare, valutare e ricavare misure appropriate
• Gestione sicura dei dati e delle statistiche di qualità e fruizione del continuo miglioramento dei processi di test e produzione
• Metodi di lavoro indipendenti, attenti e responsabili, nonché buone capacità di comunicazione e piacere di lavorare con diverse aree specializzate

Ulteriori informazioni su di noi
Hitachi Energy sta plasmando il futuro dell'energia con tecnologie innovative per un approvvigionamento energetico sostenibile e affidabile. Con noi, ci si può aspettare un ambiente di lavoro moderno, un team forte e l'opportunità di partecipare attivamente a soluzioni orientate al futuro.
descriptionByLocale.en:
About the position
As a quality inspector, you ensure that incoming materials and components meet our quality requirements. You check deliveries quantitatively and qualitatively, perform initial sample checks and document deviations. In addition, you support quality assurance and development with specific measurement orders, collect quality data and initiate suitable measures to improve product quality. With your experience, technical understanding and careful working methods, you make an important contribution to ensuring our quality standards.

You can do that.

• Qualitative and quantitative testing of material inputs by means of mechanical, electrical and optical measuring instruments and control of the associated documents
• Implementation of initial sample tests including preparation of initial sample test reports (ZP) and processing of the required PPAP documentation
• Preparation of quality reports for systematic documentation of deviations in incoming deliveries
• Participation in relevant meetings to promote information exchange within the works
• Carrying out specific measurement tasks, for example for development or quality assurance
• Ensuring the maintenance of IQC instruments and tools
• Collection and evaluation of statistics for the development of error messages from the assembly (Z2) and initiation of suitable measures for reducing errors
• Creation and adjustment of test plans according to the specifications of R&D or TC

You bring that with you

• Technical or vocational training as well as in-depth experience in quality control or a comparable production environment
• Good knowledge in the use of mechanical, electrical and optical measuring equipment as well as in the assessment of technical documents
• Experience with initial type tests, initial type test reports and PPAP is beneficial
• Analytical and structured operation as well as the ability to detect, evaluate and derive appropriate measures
• Safe handling of quality data and statistics as well as enjoyment of the continuous improvement of testing and production processes
• Independent, careful and responsible working methods as well as good communication skills and pleasure in working with different specialist areas

More about us
Hitachi Energy is shaping the energy future with innovative technologies for a sustainable and reliable energy supply. With us, you can expect a modern working environment, a strong team and the opportunity to actively participate in future-oriented solutions.

• Qualitative und quantitative Prüfung von Materialeingängen mittels mechanischer, elektrischer und optischer Messmittel sowie Kontrolle der zugehörigen Dokumente
• Durchführung von Erstmusterprüfungen inklusive Erstellung der Erstmusterprüfberichte (ZP) und Bearbeitung der erforderlichen PPAP-Dokumentation
• Erstellung von Qualitätsmeldungen zur systematischen Dokumentation von Abweichungen bei eingehenden Lieferungen
• Teilnahme an relevanten Besprechungen zur Förderung des Informationsaustauschs innerhalb der Werke
• Durchführung spezifischer Messaufträge, beispielsweise für die Entwicklung oder die Qualitätssicherung
• Sicherstellung des Unterhalts der IQC-Messmittel und Hilfsmittel
• Erhebung und Auswertung von Statistiken zur Entwicklung von Fehlermeldungen aus der Montage (Z2) sowie Einleitung geeigneter Massnahmen zur Reduktion der Fehler
• Erstellung und Anpassung von Prüfplänen gemäss den Vorgaben von R&D oder TC

Das bringst du mit

• Technische oder berufliche Ausbildung sowie fundierte Erfahrung in der Qualitätsprüfung oder einem vergleichbaren Produktionsumfeld
• Gute Kenntnisse im Umgang mit mechanischen, elektrischen und optischen Messmitteln sowie in der Beurteilung technischer Dokumente
• Erfahrung mit Erstmusterprüfungen, Erstmusterprüfberichten und PPAP von Vorteil
• Analytische und strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie die Fähigkeit, Qualitätsabweichungen zu erkennen, zu bewerten und geeignete Massnahmen abzuleiten
• Sicherer Umgang mit Qualitätsdaten und Statistiken sowie Freude an der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Prüf- und Produktionsprozessen
• Selbstständige, sorgfältige und verantwortungsbewusste Arbeitsweise sowie gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen

Mehr über uns
Hitachi Energy gestaltet die Energiezukunft mit innovativen Technologien für eine nachhaltige und zuverlässige Energieversorgung. Bei uns erwartet dich ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld, ein starkes Team und die Möglichkeit, aktiv an zukunftsorientierten Lösungen mitzuwirken.

En tant qu'inspecteur de qualité, vous assurez que les matériaux et composants entrants répondent à nos exigences de qualité. Vous contrôlez les livraisons quantitativement et qualitativement, effectuez des contrôles d'échantillons initiaux et documentez les écarts. De plus, vous soutenez l'assurance qualité et le développement avec des commandes de mesure spécifiques, collectez des données de qualité et lancez des mesures appropriées pour améliorer la qualité des produits. Avec votre expérience, votre compréhension technique et vos méthodes de travail soignées, vous contribuez de manière importante à garantir nos normes de qualité.

Tu peux le faire.

• Mise en oeuvre des tests d'échantillonnage initiaux, y compris la préparation des rapports initiaux d'essais d'échantillons (ZP) et le traitement des documents requis du PPAP
• Établissement de rapports de qualité pour la documentation systématique des écarts dans les livraisons entrantes
• Participation aux réunions pertinentes pour promouvoir l'échange d'informations au sein des travaux
• Réalisation de tâches de mesure spécifiques, par exemple pour le développement ou l'assurance de la qualité
• Assurer la maintenance des instruments et outils de la CQI
• Collecte et évaluation de statistiques pour l'élaboration de messages d'erreurs provenant de l'assemblage (Z2) et lancement de mesures appropriées pour réduire les erreurs
• Création et adaptation des plans d'essai selon les spécifications de la R-D ou de TC

Apporte ça avec toi.

• Formation technique ou professionnelle et expérience approfondie en matière de contrôle de la qualité ou d'environnement de production comparable
• Bonne connaissance de l'utilisation des équipements de mesure mécaniques, électriques et optiques ainsi que de l'évaluation des documents techniques
• L'expérience des tests de type initiaux, des rapports d'essais de type initial et du PPAP est bénéfique
• fonctionnement analytique et structuré ainsi que la capacité de détecter, d'évaluer et d'élaborer des mesures appropriées
• Gestion sûre des données et des statistiques de qualité et amélioration continue des procédés d ' essai et de production
• Méthodes de travail indépendantes, prudentes et responsables, bonnes compétences en communication et plaisir à travailler avec différents domaines spécialisés

Plus sur nous
Hitachi Energy façonne l'avenir énergétique avec des technologies innovantes pour un approvisionnement énergétique durable et fiable. Avec nous, vous pouvez vous attendre à un environnement de travail moderne, une équipe forte et l'occasion de participer activement à des solutions orientées vers l'avenir.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità
Come Area Sales Manager, guiderai la penetrazione del mercato e la crescita redditizia per il nostro portafoglio di servizi Interruttore isolato a gas (GIS) e Interruttore a circuito di generatore (GCB). Potrai guidare e potenziare i team di vendita locali, promuovere le relazioni con i clienti e sfruttare gli strumenti digitali per fornire servizi e risultati eccezionali.

La nostra unità di servizio è responsabile per il supporto post-vendita mondiale dei sistemi GCB e GIS sia per il livello Transmission (220kV-550kV) sia per il livello Sub-transmission (60kV-170kV), tra cui formazione, installazione e messa in servizio, manutenzione programmata, servizi a valore aggiunto, risoluzione dei problemi, modifiche, retrofit e sostituzioni.

Hai una formazione superiore con un focus tecnico e/o commerciale? Hai un'esperienza di vendita profonda e una mentalità di servizio con forti capacità di negoziazione? Sei molto esperto nel lavorare a stretto contatto con i clienti di diversi paesi, capisci i loro requisiti e puoi gestire eventuali reclami o problemi? Avete auto-motivazione e persistenza così come un servizio-mindset? Allora abbiamo la giusta opportunità per voi!

Come farai ad avere un impatto

descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity
As Area Sales Manager, you will drive market penetration and profitable growth for our Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) and Generator Circuit Breaker (GCB) Service portfolio. You'll lead and empower local sales teams, foster customer relationships, and leverage on digital tools to deliver exceptional service and results.

Our Service unit is responsible for the worldwide after sales support of GCB and GIS systems for both Transmission (220kV-550kV) and Sub-transmission (60kV-170kV) level, including training, installation and commissioning, scheduled maintenance, value-added services, troubleshooting, modification, retrofits and replacements.

You have a higher education with a technical and/or commercial focus? You have profound sales experience and service mindset with strong negotiation skills? You are highly experienced in working closely together with customers from different countries, you understand their requirements and you can handle any complaints or issues? You have self-motivation and persistence as well as a service-mindset? Then we have the right opportunity for you!

How you'll make an impact

• Define and execute go-to-market strategies together with local service sales teams, channel partners, and service organizations to drive sustainable order growth
• Lead proactive sales and marketing activities for maintenance and service solutions while optimizing regional pricing strategies and increasing market penetration
• Analyze installed base data, market dynamics, and customer needs to develop sales action plans and grow the maintenance sales pipeline
• Build strong customer and partner relationships, provide consultative support, and enable local service sales teams through product and service knowledge sharing
• Manage the entire service project offer process, from opportunity identification and quotation preparation through contract negotiation and handover to execution
• Utilize digital tools, CRM systems, and sales analytics to ensure data quality, maintain accurate forecasts, and improve customer experience
• Monitor business performance against targets, identify gaps, develop annual order budgets, and implement actions to achieve growth objectives
• Mentor and support service sales teams at Product Service Center and Local Service Unit, foster a culture of continuous improvement, and drive enhancements of sales processes and tools
Your background

• Degree in a technical or commercial discipline
• Proven experience in sales, business development, or account management within the energy, industrial, or infrastructure sector
• Strong commercial acumen and negotiation skills with a track record of delivering results
• Customer-focused approach and the ability to build trusted relationships across diverse markets and cultures
• Experience with Salesforce, SAP, and other digital sales tools
• Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills
• Self-motivated, resilient, and driven to create business opportunities
• Fluent in English; additional languages such as Spanish are a plus
• Willingness to travel internationally up to 50%
More about us

• You will do interesting and enriching work as part of a dynamic, passionate, and collaborative team committed to innovation and continuous improvement
• You will be stretched, encouraged, and supported to grow – we pride ourselves on providing strong learning and development opportunities
• We offer an environment that fosters collaboration, connection, and diversity of thought
• Our culture is one of a kind: come as you are and bring your unique attributes, passion, and drive to the design and management of Pensions & Benefits at Hitachi Energy, contributing to making us ‘the place to be' and to our purpose of advancing a sustainable energy future for all
• Flexible working, including hybrid/remote working opportunities
• A competitive compensation and benefits package
Hitachi Energy is able to offer you an interesting role within a highly motivated team, together with open communication structures. On the basis of a personal, practice-oriented introduction program, you will be given the opportunity to acquire the confidence needed to work independently as well as be a constructive member of an inclusive team within your assigned area. Hitachi Energy is also able to provide a wealth of opportunities for personal development once you have completed your introduction period, the aim being to assist you in attaining your career goals. Personalized development programs with targeted training measures will help you to enhance your skills on a continuous basis.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'opportunité
En tant que responsable des ventes sur place, vous favoriserez la pénétration du marché et la croissance rentable de notre portefeuille de services de commutateurs à gaz isolants (GIS) et de disjoncteurs de générateurs (GCB). • Fortes compétences en matière de négociation et d'exercice de l'activité commerciale, avec des résultats déjà obtenus
• Une approche axée sur le client et la capacité d'établir des relations de confiance entre différents marchés et cultures

• Fortes compétences en communication, présentation et gestion des intervenants
• Automotivé, résilient et poussé à créer des débouchés commerciaux
• Fluent en anglais; d'autres langues comme l'espagnol sont un plus

descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity

Are you passionate about driving operational excellence and creating measurable impact on the shop floor? As Continuous Improvement Manager, you will partner with factory and operations leaders to identify improvement opportunities, remove bottlenecks, and implement Lean Six Sigma initiatives across the value chain. This is a highly visible role where you will coach teams, lead transformational projects, and help shape a culture of continuous improvement across our manufacturing operations.

Please submit your CV and a cover letter outlining your motivation and relevant experience in English.

How you'll make an impact

• Act as a trusted Continuous Improvement advisor and sparring partner for Factory Managers, Operations Managers, and leadership teams, driving data-driven analyses, optimization initiatives, and operational excellence programs
• Work across the entire value chain to identify bottlenecks, remove constraints, improve flow, and maximize overall business performance
• Maintain a strong shop-floor presence through regular Gemba activities, working side-by-side with operators, supervisors, and managers to identify opportunities, solve problems, and sustain improvements where value is created
• Drive and promote Kaizen Events and Rapid Improvement Workshops to accelerate problem-solving, eliminate waste, and deliver fast, sustainable results
• Train, coach, and mentor employees and leaders in Lean Six Sigma methodologies, supporting certification programs and building continuous improvement capabilities throughout the organization
• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to map, analyze, redesign, and optimize end-to-end business processes
• Lead the deployment of Lean principles, standardization, best practices, and benchmarking activities across manufacturing sites
• Monitor, track, and communicate improvement program results through KPIs, ensuring sustainable implementation and measurable business impact
• Travel regularly to support factories, conduct workshops, coach teams, and drive improvement initiatives across the organization (minimum 20% travel required)
Your background

• Bachelor's or master's degree in engineering, Operations Management, or a related technical field
• Minimum 5 years of experience in Continuous Improvement, Operational Excellence, or Process Engineering, with proven hands-on experience in a manufacturing environment. Factory experience is mandatory
• Strong understanding and practical application of Lean Six Sigma methodologies (Green Belt required, Black Belt preferred)
• Proven experience leading Kaizen Events, Gemba activities, process mapping, value stream analysis, root cause analysis, and change management initiatives
• Demonstrated ability to identify bottlenecks, remove constraints, and improve end-to-end value stream performance
• Strong communication, facilitation, training, and presentation skills, with experience delivering workshops and Lean Six Sigma certification programs
• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and data-driven decision-making skills
• Self-driven, hands-on, and comfortable working on the shop floor alongside production teams to deliver sustainable improvements
• Willingness to travel regularly to support factories and improvement initiatives across the region (minimum 20% travel required)
• Fluent in English; German or Swedish is considered an advantage
More about us

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

Vous ferez rapport au responsable mondial de la durabilité et de l'intégration du réseau HSE et travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec des dirigeants et des équipes interfonctionnelles pour suivre les progrès, gérer la gouvernance, mesurer les performances et stimuler l'excellence dans l'exécution d'un portefeuille mondial d'initiatives. • Conduire l'exécution de la stratégie et de la feuille de route mondiales HSE & Durabilité.
• Traduire les priorités stratégiques en actions structurées, jalons et produits livrables.

• Préparer des analyses de rentabilisation et appuyer les demandes de financement pour les initiatives clés.
• Favoriser la collaboration entre les fonctions pour assurer l'alignement entre la stratégie et l'exécution.

Vos antécédents

You will ensure that supply chain considerations are integrated into the product development process, enabling optimized sourcing decisions, cost competitiveness, material availability, and successful product launches.

• Collaborate with Category Managers and Supplier Quality teams to identify, evaluate, and develop suppliers and sourcing concepts.
• Translate engineering requirements into SCM requirements and drive the necessary sourcing activities.
• Support the implementation of regional and global sourcing strategies.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità

Il settore energetico sta subendo una rapida trasformazione, sollecitando la domanda di sistemi elettronici di potenza più efficienti e affidabili. I semiconduttori di potenza in carburo di silicio (SiC) consentono la prossima generazione di applicazioni per la distribuzione di energia rinnovabile, il trasporto, l'industria e la distribuzione di energia. Tuttavia, le sfide relative all'affidabilità dei MOSFETs di SiC devono ancora essere affrontate per sostenere la loro diffusa adozione. Il team di ricerca di Semiconductor Packaging and Reliability Engineering cerca uno stage per supportare lo sviluppo di una piattaforma di test innovativa per le indagini sull'affidabilità. Lo stage si concentrerà sulla stabilità della tensione di soglia di SiC MOSFETs in un ampio ciclismo dinamico e condizioni di invecchiamento accelerato. Eseguire misurazioni sperimentali su un 3.3 kV / 150 Un sistema di test a doppia spinta, acquisisce e analizza i dati di misura e contribuisce allo sviluppo di strumenti di monitoraggio e analisi dei dati automatizzati. Il lavoro combina prove sperimentali, analisi dei dati e indagini di affidabilità dei semiconduttori, collegando osservazioni sperimentali alla fisica dei dispositivi e contribuendo alla derivazione delle relazioni empiriche di stress-vita. La durata dello stage è di sei mesi.

Come farai ad avere un impatto

• Condurre campagne di misura e analizzare i dati sperimentali utilizzando metodologie all'avanguardia dell'accademia e dell'industria
• Indagare l'impatto dello stress elettrico e termico sulle prestazioni e sull'affidabilità di SiC MOSFETs
• Sviluppare soluzioni innovative per migliorare le capacità di monitoraggio, compresi i sistemi di sensori, l'acquisizione automatica dei dati e gli strumenti di analisi dei dati
• Supporta l'ottimizzazione di una piattaforma di convertitore a mezzo ponte per il test di affidabilità dinamica a lungo termine di SiC MOSFETs
• Contribuire allo sviluppo e al miglioramento dell'elettronica di misura e del software necessario per eseguire test ad alta precisione nei periodi operativi prolungati
• Documentare e comunicare i risultati all'interno del team di ricerca, collaboratori accademici e stakeholder aziendali rilevanti
Il tuo sfondo

• Attualmente perseguire un Master in Ingegneria Elettrica, Ingegneria Elettronica, Fisica, Scienza dei Materiali, o una disciplina correlata (si richiede l'iscrizione ufficiale)
• Familiarità con le impostazioni di misura elettrica e strumentazione di laboratorio, come oscilloscopi, generatori di funzione, alimentatori e sistemi di acquisizione dati
• Forte interesse per l'elettronica di potenza, i dispositivi semiconduttori e l'ingegneria dell'affidabilità; l'esperienza precedente nella caratterizzazione dei semiconduttori, il test ad alta tensione o il design di PCB è considerato un vantaggio
• Buone competenze di programmazione in Python, MATLAB, C/C++, o linguaggi simili per l'analisi e l'automazione dei dati
• Fluency in inglese scritto e parlato
• Forte capacità analitiche e di problem solving combinato con un atteggiamento pratico
• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e all'interno di un team di ricerca multidisciplinare
• Buone capacità di comunicazione e scrittura tecnica
Ulteriori informazioni su di noi

Offriamo condizioni di lavoro flessibili, una mentorship dedicata, e un ambiente di supporto e inclusivo in cui si può crescere personalmente e professionalmente - consentendo di prosperare mentre bilanciare la vita e il lavoro.
descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity

The energy sector is undergoing a rapid transformation, driving demand for more efficient and reliable power electronic systems. Silicon carbide (SiC) power semiconductors are enabling the next generation of renewable energy, transportation, industrial, and power distribution applications. However, challenges related to the reliability of SiC MOSFETs must still be addressed to support their widespread adoption. The Semiconductor Packaging and Reliability Engineering research team is seeking an intern to support the development of an innovative test platform for reliability investigations. The internship will focus on the threshold voltage stability of SiC MOSFETs under extensive dynamic cycling and accelerated aging conditions. You will perform experimental measurements on a 3.3 kV / 150 A double-pulse test system, acquire and analyze measurement data, and contribute to the development of automated monitoring and data analysis tools. The work will combine experimental testing, data analysis, and semiconductor reliability investigations, linking experimental observations to device physics and contributing to the derivation of empirical stress-lifetime relationships. The internship duration is six months.

How you'll make an impact

• Conduct measurement campaigns and analyze experimental data using state-of-the-art methodologies from academia and industry
• Investigate the impact of electrical and thermal stress on the performance and reliability of SiC MOSFETs
• Develop innovative solutions to improve monitoring capabilities, including sensor systems, automated data acquisition, and data analysis tools
• Support the optimization of a half-bridge converter platform for long-term dynamic reliability testing of SiC MOSFETs
• Contribute to the development and improvement of measurement electronics and software needed to perform high-precision testing over extended operating periods
• Document and communicate results within the research team, academic collaborators, and relevant business stakeholders
Your background

• Currently pursuing a Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, or a related discipline (official enrolment is required)
• Familiarity with electrical measurement setups and laboratory instrumentation, such as oscilloscopes, function generators, power supplies, and data acquisition systems
• Strong interest in power electronics, semiconductor devices, and reliability engineering; previous experience in semiconductor characterization, high-voltage testing, or PCB design is considered an advantage
• Good programming skills in Python, MATLAB, C/C++, or similar languages for data analysis and automation
• Fluency in written and spoken English
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills combined with a hands-on attitude
• Ability to work independently as well as within a multidisciplinary research team
• Good communication and technical writing skills
More about us

We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Chance

Der Energiesektor befindet sich in einer rasanten Transformation und treibt die Nachfrage nach effizienteren und zuverlässigeren leistungselektronischen Systemen voran. Leistungshalbleiter aus Siliziumkarbid (SiC) ermöglichen die nächste Generation von Anwendungen für erneuerbare Energien, Transport, Industrie und Energieverteilung. Die Herausforderungen im Zusammenhang mit der Zuverlässigkeit von SiC-MOSFETs müssen jedoch noch angegangen werden, um ihre breite Akzeptanz zu unterstützen. Das Forschungsteam von Semiconductor Packaging and Reliability Engineering sucht einen Praktikanten, der die Entwicklung einer innovativen Testplattform für Zuverlässigkeitsuntersuchungen unterstützt. Das Praktikum wird sich auf die Schwellenspannungsstabilität von SiC-MOSFETs unter umfangreichen dynamischen Zyklen und beschleunigten Alterungsbedingungen konzentrieren. Sie führen experimentelle Messungen an einem 3,3 kV / 150 durch Ein Doppelpuls-Testsystem, das Messdaten erfasst und analysiert und zur Entwicklung automatisierter Überwachungs- und Datenanalyse-Tools beiträgt. Die Arbeit wird experimentelle Tests, Datenanalysen und Zuverlässigkeitsuntersuchungen von Halbleitern kombinieren, experimentelle Beobachtungen mit der Gerätephysik verbinden und zur Ableitung empirischer Stress-Lebensdauer-Beziehungen beitragen. Die Praktikumsdauer beträgt sechs Monate.

Wie Sie einen Einfluss machen werden

• Durchführung von Messkampagnen und Analyse experimenteller Daten mit modernsten Methoden aus Wissenschaft und Industrie
• Untersuchen Sie die Auswirkungen elektrischer und thermischer Belastungen auf die Leistung und Zuverlässigkeit von SiC-MOSFETs
• Entwicklung innovativer Lösungen zur Verbesserung der Überwachungsfähigkeiten, einschließlich Sensorsystemen, automatisierter Datenerfassung und Datenanalysetools
• Unterstützung der Optimierung einer Halbbrücken-Konverterplattform für langfristige dynamische Zuverlässigkeitstests von SiC-MOSFETs
• Beitrag zur Entwicklung und Verbesserung von Messelektronik und -software, die für hochpräzise Tests über längere Betriebszeiten erforderlich sind
• Dokumentieren und kommunizieren Sie die Ergebnisse innerhalb des Forschungsteams, der akademischen Mitarbeiter und der relevanten geschäftlichen Stakeholder
Dein Hintergrund

• Derzeit verfolgen einen Master-Abschluss in Elektrotechnik, Elektroniktechnik, Physik, Materialwissenschaften oder einer verwandten Disziplin (offizielle Einschreibung ist erforderlich)
• Vertrautheit mit elektrischen Messanordnungen und Laborinstrumenten wie Oszilloskopen, Funktionsgeneratoren, Stromversorgungen und Datenerfassungssystemen
• Starkes Interesse an Leistungselektronik, Halbleiterbauelementen und Zuverlässigkeitstechnik; frühere Erfahrung in der Halbleitercharakterisierung, Hochspannungsprüfung oder Leiterplattenkonstruktion wird als Vorteil angesehen
• Gute Programmierkenntnisse in Python, MATLAB, C/C++ oder ähnlichen Sprachen für Datenanalyse und Automatisierung
• Fließend in schriftlichem und gesprochenem Englisch
• Starke analytische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten kombiniert mit einer praktischen Einstellung
• Fähigkeit, sowohl unabhängig als auch in einem multidisziplinären Forschungsteam zu arbeiten
• Gute Kommunikation und technische Schreibfähigkeiten
Mehr über uns

Wir sind ein technologiegetriebenes Unternehmen mit einem starken Fokus auf Innovation, kontinuierliche Verbesserung und nachhaltige Fertigung. Wir bieten flexible Arbeitsbedingungen, engagierte Mentorenschaft und ein unterstützendes, integratives Umfeld, in dem Sie persönlich und beruflich wachsen können - und ermöglichen Ihnen, zu gedeihen und gleichzeitig Leben und Arbeit in Einklang zu bringen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'opportunité

Le secteur de l'énergie subit une transformation rapide, ce qui stimule la demande de systèmes électroniques plus efficaces et plus fiables. Les semi-conducteurs de carbure de silicium (SiC) permettent la prochaine génération d'applications d'énergie renouvelable, de transport, d'industrie et de distribution d'électricité. Toutefois, les défis liés à la fiabilité des MOSFET SiC doivent encore être relevés pour appuyer leur adoption généralisée. L'équipe de recherche en génie de l'emballage et de la fiabilité des semi-conducteurs cherche un stagiaire pour soutenir le développement d'une plateforme d'essai innovante pour les enquêtes de fiabilité. Le stage se concentrera sur la stabilité du seuil de tension des MOSFET SiC dans des conditions de vélo dynamique et de vieillissement accéléré. Vous effectuerez des mesures expérimentales sur un 3.3 kV / 150 Un système d'essai à double pression, qui permet d'acquérir et d'analyser des données de mesure et de contribuer au développement d'outils automatisés de surveillance et d'analyse des données. Les travaux combineront des essais expérimentaux, des analyses de données et des études de fiabilité des semi-conducteurs, reliant les observations expérimentales à la physique des appareils et contribuant à l'établissement de relations empiriques stress-vie. La durée du stage est de six mois.

Comment vous ferez un impact

• Mener des campagnes de mesure et analyser des données expérimentales à l'aide de méthodologies de pointe provenant du milieu universitaire et de l'industrie
• Étudier l'impact des contraintes électriques et thermiques sur les performances et la fiabilité des MOSFET SiC
• Mettre au point des solutions novatrices pour améliorer les capacités de surveillance, y compris les systèmes de détection, l'acquisition automatisée de données et les outils d'analyse de données
• Soutenir l'optimisation d'une plate-forme de convertisseur demi-pont pour les tests de fiabilité dynamique à long terme des MOSFET SiC
• Contribuer au développement et à l'amélioration de l'électronique de mesure et des logiciels nécessaires pour effectuer des essais de haute précision sur des périodes d'exploitation prolongées
• Documenter et communiquer les résultats au sein de l'équipe de recherche, des collaborateurs universitaires et des intervenants commerciaux pertinents
Vos antécédents

• Poursuivant actuellement une maîtrise en génie électrique, électronique, physique, sciences des matériaux ou une discipline connexe (une inscription officielle est requise)
• Familiarité avec les installations de mesure électrique et les instruments de laboratoire, comme les oscilloscopes, les générateurs de fonction, les alimentations électriques et les systèmes d'acquisition de données
• Un vif intérêt pour l'électronique de puissance, les dispositifs à semi-conducteurs et l'ingénierie de la fiabilité; l'expérience antérieure dans la caractérisation des semi-conducteurs, les essais à haute tension ou la conception des PCB est considérée comme un avantage
• Bonnes compétences en programmation en Python, MATLAB, C/C++ ou langages similaires pour l'analyse et l'automatisation des données
• Connaissance de l'anglais écrit et parlé
• Forte capacité d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes associée à une attitude pratique
• Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante et au sein d'une équipe de recherche multidisciplinaire
• Bonnes compétences en communication et écriture technique
Plus sur nous

Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie, qui met fortement l'accent sur l'innovation, l'amélioration continue et la fabrication durable. Nous offrons des conditions de travail flexibles, un mentorat dédié et un environnement favorable et inclusif où vous pouvez vous développer personnellement et professionnellement – vous autonomisant à prospérer tout en conciliant vie et travail.

descriptionByLocale.en:
About the position
As a quality technician, you ensure the quality of our manufactured products and make an important contribution to the continuous improvement of our production processes. You carry out intermediate and outgoing inspections, evaluate quality deviations and initiate appropriate measures in cooperation with the relevant interfaces. In addition, you support with quality projects, internal training and audits. With your careful and solution-oriented way of working, you help to meet the high quality requirements of our customers.

You can do that.

• Performance of intermediate and exit checks on manufactured products and testing and evaluation of results against the applicable quality requirements
• Testing and evaluation of non-conformity reports (NKM, NMR) and taking appropriate measures in cooperation with the relevant interfaces
• Support in the evaluation and processing of quality reports as well as lot-on-hold reports
• Independent assessment of tolerances and manufacturing defects and decision on the introduction of appropriate measures
• Planning and implementation of internal quality training as well as active participation in the further development of quality assurance, CAR and 4Q activities and projects to improve yield
• Support for CAR projects related to customer complaints as well as participation in internal and external audits and the implementation of improvement measures
• Introduction and documentation of continuous improvements (CIP) as well as management of the internal shift 6S activities in cooperation with the OpEx team and shift management
• Ensure customer quality requirements, carry out shift transfer and report on the quality situation in line briefings as well as compliance with occupational safety, health and environmental regulations; in case of personnel bottlenecks and according to the instructions of shift management, you also provide operational support in the production process

You bring that with you

• Basic knowledge of quality testing and production processes acquired through professional experience; vocational or technical training is advantageous
• Experience in testing and evaluating products and in detecting and assessing quality deviations
• Structured, careful and solution-oriented working methods and the ability to derive appropriate measures in the event of deviations
• Communication ability and the ability to communicate quality information in an understandable way and to work with different interfaces
• Willingness to take responsibility for quality, continuous improvement and compliance with safety and environmental regulations
• Awareness of the confidential handling of sensitive quality and customer information

More about us
Hitachi Energy is shaping the energy future with innovative technologies for a sustainable and reliable energy supply. With us, you can expect a modern working environment, a strong team and the opportunity to actively participate in future-oriented solutions.

• Capacité de communication et capacité de communiquer des informations de qualité de manière compréhensible et de travailler avec différentes interfaces
• Volonté d'assumer la responsabilité de la qualité, de l'amélioration continue et du respect des règlements en matière de sécurité et d'environnement
• Connaissance du traitement confidentiel des informations sensibles sur la qualité et les clients

Plus sur nous
Hitachi Energy façonne l'avenir énergétique avec des technologies innovantes pour un approvisionnement énergétique durable et fiable. Avec nous, vous pouvez vous attendre à un environnement de travail moderne, une équipe forte et la possibilité de participer activement à des solutions orientées vers l'avenir.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity
As Global Implementation Manager for High Voltage Products, you will be responsible for leading the deployment of product, process, and system changes across our Global High Voltage manufacturing network.
This role requires a deep understanding of High Voltage Products, engineering change processes, and their impact on manufacturing, quality, product compliance, and customer commitments. Success in this position depends on the ability to assess and manage the operational implications of product and process changes within a complex High Voltage environment.
Working closely with Operations, R&D, Product Management, PLM, and Master Data Management, you will ensure that High Voltage product-related changes are implemented consistently and efficiently across Production Units and Feeder Factories worldwide.

Experienced in High Voltage Products?
This role requires proven experience in the High Voltage industry and a solid understanding of how engineering and process changes impact manufacturing, quality, compliance, and customer delivery. If this describes your background, we'd love to hear from you.

How you'll make an impact

Global Implementation & Change Management

• Lead end-to-end implementation initiatives across Production Units and Feeder Factories worldwide
• Manage the implementation of change notifications from assessment and Change Review Board (CRB) decisions through communication, deployment, and successful completion
• Develop and maintain standardized implementation processes, governance structures, and documentation
• Establish and further develop the global Landscape Implementation Management (LIM) setup and organization
Project & Stakeholder Management

• Drive global implementation roadmaps, deployment strategies, and project plans
• Coordinate cross-functional projects involving Operations, R&D, Global Master Data, GPS, and the HVPLM Core Team
• Monitor project progress, manage risks, and ensure delivery on time, within scope, and in line with quality expectations
• Provide transparent reporting through defined KPIs, milestones, and governance frameworks
Operational Excellence & Capability Building

• Promote standardization, continuous improvement, and best practices across the global organization
• Support the implementation of global operating standards, processes, and digital solutions
• Define training requirements and coordinate capability-building initiatives for local teams and site leadership
• Facilitate knowledge transfer and ensure long-term adoption of new processes and systems
Your background
• Several years of experience in implementation management, transformation projects, or change management within an industrial environment
• Strong knowledge of operational master data management and related business processes
• Hands-on experience with PLM systems and SAP
• Solid understanding of High Voltage Products and associated manufacturing processes
• Strong expertise in process management, process definition, and standardization
• Experience working in global manufacturing organizations and matrix structures
• Project management experience and familiarity with established project management methodologies
• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken
More about us
This is a unique opportunity to shape global implementation standards and drive industrial transformation on an international scale. You will work with diverse teams worldwide, contribute to strategic business initiatives, and play a critical role in advancing operational excellence across our global manufacturing network.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità
Sei appassionato di guidare iniziative strategiche dal concetto all'esecuzione? Come Salute, Sicurezza, Ambiente (HSE) & Sostenibilità Roadmap Esecuzione Lead, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nel trasformare il nostro piano d'azione globale HSE e sostenibilità in risultati aziendali misurabili. Essendo il coordinatore centrale tra più parti interessate, ti assicurerai che le iniziative vengano consegnate in tempo, nel budget e con chiara responsabilitÃ .
Ti riferirai al Global Head of Sustainability & HSE - Grid Integration e lavorerai a stretto contatto con i leader senior e i team interfunzionali per monitorare i progressi, gestire la governance, misurare le prestazioni e guidare l'eccellenza dell'esecuzione in un portafoglio globale di iniziative. Questa posizione offre un'opportunità unica per influenzare le priorità strategiche, mentre la costruzione di partnership forti in tutto il business.

Come si fa un impatto

• Guidare l'esecuzione della strategia globale HSE & Sustainability e roadmap.
• Traduci priorità strategiche in azioni strutturate, pietre miliari e consegnabili.
• Mantenere la supervisione del portafoglio HSE & Sustainability e garantire una chiara proprietà delle iniziative.
• Monitorare i progressi, identificare i rischi e le dipendenze, e guidare proattivamente le azioni di mitigazione.
• Sviluppare strumenti, dashboard, schede di punteggio e rapporti esecutivi per misurare e monitorare le prestazioni.
• Supporta sessioni di revisione e facilita il processo decisionale efficace.
• Coordinate con i leader di iniziativa e le parti interessate per garantire la consegna contro gli impegni.
• Supporto budgeting, previsione e monitoraggio finanziario di programmi strategici.
• Preparare i casi aziendali e sostenere le richieste di finanziamento per iniziative chiave.
• Promuovere la collaborazione tra le funzioni per garantire l'allineamento tra strategia ed esecuzione.

Il tuo sfondo

• Laurea in Sostenibilità HSE, Business Administration, Ingegneria, o un campo relativo.
• 3+ anni di esperienza nella gestione dei programmi, PMO, operazioni aziendali, esecuzione di strategia o iniziative di trasformazione.
• Esperienza di gestione di progetti interfunzionali all'interno di un'organizzazione globale e matrice.
• Forte capacità di gestione e comunicazione degli stakeholder.
• Prove capacità di guidare l'esecuzione attraverso l'influenza e la collaborazione.
• Forte capacità analitiche con esperienza nel reporting e nel monitoraggio delle prestazioni.
• Proficienza in PowerPoint, Excel, Power BI e strumenti di collaborazione.
• Esperienza con gestione del bilancio e rendicontazione finanziaria.

Ulteriori informazioni su di noi
Crediamo che il grande lavoro prosperi in un ambiente in cui le persone si sentono sinceramente sostenute e abbastanza ricompensate. I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per creare valore reale per ogni individuo – il rifornimento di impegno, le prestazioni e la crescita. Con la priorità del benessere, costruiamo un posto di lavoro dove il successo personale e organizzativo crescono insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
The Opportunity
Are you passionate about driving strategic initiatives from concept to execution? As Health, Safety, Environment (HSE) & Sustainability Roadmap Execution Lead, you will play a key role in turning our global HSE and Sustainability action plan into measurable business outcomes. Acting as the central coordinator across multiple stakeholders, you will ensure initiatives are delivered on time, within budget, and with clear accountability.
You will report to the Global Head of Sustainability & HSE - Grid Integration and work closely with senior leaders and cross-functional teams to track progress, manage governance, measure performance, and drive execution excellence across a global portfolio of initiatives. This position offers a unique opportunity to influence strategic priorities while building strong partnerships across the business.

How You'll Make an Impact

• Drive execution of the global HSE & Sustainability strategy and roadmap.
• Translate strategic priorities into structured actions, milestones, and deliverables.
• Maintain oversight of the HSE & Sustainability portfolio and ensure clear ownership of initiatives.
• Monitor progress, identify risks and dependencies, and proactively drive mitigation actions.
• Develop tools, dashboards, scorecards, and executive reports to measure and track performance.
• Support review sessions and facilitate effective decision-making.
• Coordinate with initiative leaders and stakeholders to ensure delivery against commitments.
• Support budgeting, forecasting, and financial tracking of strategic programs.
• Prepare business cases and support funding requests for key initiatives.
• Foster collaboration across functions to ensure alignment between strategy and execution.

Your Background

• Bachelor's degree in HSE Sustainability, Business Administration, Engineering,, or a related field.
• 3+ years of experience in program management, PMO, business operations, strategy execution, or transformation initiatives.
• Experience managing cross-functional projects within a global and matrix organization.
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
• Proven ability to drive execution through influence and collaboration.
• Strong analytical skills with experience in reporting and performance tracking.
• Proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel, Power BI, and collaboration tools.
• Experience with budget management and financial reporting.

More about us
We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Chance
Sind Sie leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, strategische Initiativen vom Konzept bis zur Umsetzung voranzutreiben? Als Gesundheit, Sicherheit, Umwelt (HSE) & Nachhaltigkeit Roadmap Ausführung Lead, Sie werden eine Schlüsselrolle dabei spielen, unseren globalen HSE- und Nachhaltigkeits-Aktionsplan in messbare Geschäftsergebnisse umzuwandeln. Als zentraler Koordinator für mehrere Interessengruppen stellen Sie sicher, dass die Initiativen pünktlich, innerhalb des Budgets und mit klarer Rechenschaftspflicht durchgeführt werden.
Sie berichten an den Global Head of Sustainability & HSE - Grid Integration und arbeiten eng mit leitenden Führungskräften und funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammen, um den Fortschritt zu verfolgen, die Governance zu verwalten, die Leistung zu messen und die Ausführungsqualität in einem globalen Portfolio von Initiativen voranzutreiben. Diese Position bietet eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, strategische Prioritäten zu beeinflussen und gleichzeitig starke Partnerschaften im gesamten Unternehmen aufzubauen.

Wie Sie einen Einfluss machen werden

• Die Umsetzung der globalen HSE & Sustainability Strategie und Roadmap vorantreiben.
• Übersetzen Sie strategische Prioritäten in strukturierte Maßnahmen, Meilensteine und Ergebnisse.
• Beaufsichtigen Sie das HSE & Sustainability-Portfolio und gewährleisten Sie eine klare Eigenverantwortung für Initiativen.
• Überwachen Sie den Fortschritt, identifizieren Sie Risiken und Abhängigkeiten und fördern Sie proaktiv Minderungsmaßnahmen.
• Entwickeln Sie Tools, Dashboards, Scorecards und Executive Reports, um die Leistung zu messen und zu verfolgen.
• Unterstützen Sie Review-Sitzungen und erleichtern Sie eine effektive Entscheidungsfindung.
• Koordination mit Initiativführern und Interessengruppen, um die Einhaltung der Verpflichtungen sicherzustellen.
• Unterstützung der Budgetierung, Prognose und finanziellen Verfolgung von strategischen Programmen.
• Bereiten Sie Geschäftsfälle vor und unterstützen Sie Finanzierungsanfragen für wichtige Initiativen.
• Förderung der funktionsübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit, um die Abstimmung zwischen Strategie und Ausführung sicherzustellen.

Dein Hintergrund

• Bachelor-Abschluss in HSE Nachhaltigkeit, Business Administration, Engineering oder einem verwandten Bereich.
• 3+ Jahre Erfahrung in Programmmanagement, PMO, Geschäftsbetrieb, Strategieausführung oder Transformationsinitiativen.
• Erfahrung im Management funktionsübergreifender Projekte innerhalb einer globalen und Matrixorganisation.
• Starke Stakeholder-Management- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.
• Bewährte Fähigkeit, die Ausführung durch Einfluss und Zusammenarbeit voranzutreiben.
• Starke analytische Fähigkeiten mit Erfahrung in Reporting und Performance Tracking.
• Kenntnisse in PowerPoint, Excel, Power BI und Collaboration-Tools.
• Erfahrung mit Budgetmanagement und Finanzberichterstattung.

Mehr über uns
Wir glauben, dass großartige Arbeit in einem Umfeld gedeiht, in dem sich die Menschen wirklich unterstützt und fair belohnt fühlen. Unsere Vorteile sind so konzipiert, dass sie für jeden Einzelnen einen echten Mehrwert schaffen – und so Engagement, Leistung und Wachstum fördern. Durch die Priorisierung des Wohlbefindens schaffen wir einen Arbeitsplatz, an dem persönlicher und organisatorischer Erfolg zusammenwachsen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'opportunité
Êtes-vous passionné par la conduite d'initiatives stratégiques du concept à l'exécution? En tant que santé, sécurité, environnement (HSE) et exécution de la feuille de route sur la durabilité Dirigez-vous, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la transformation de notre plan d'action mondial en SSE et durabilité en résultats mesurables. En tant que coordonnateur central auprès de multiples intervenants, vous veillerez à ce que les initiatives soient mises en oeuvre à temps, dans les limites du budget et avec une reddition de comptes claire.
Vous ferez rapport au responsable mondial de la durabilité et de l'intégration du réseau HSE et travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les dirigeants et les équipes interfonctionnelles pour suivre les progrès, gérer la gouvernance, mesurer les performances et stimuler l'excellence dans l'exécution d'un portefeuille mondial d'initiatives. Ce poste offre une occasion unique d'influencer les priorités stratégiques tout en établissant de solides partenariats dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise.

Comment vous ferez un impact

• Conduire l'exécution de la stratégie et de la feuille de route mondiales HSE & Durabilité.
• Traduire les priorités stratégiques en actions structurées, jalons et produits livrables.
• Maintenir la surveillance du portefeuille de SST et de durabilité et assurer une appropriation claire des initiatives.
• Surveiller les progrès, cerner les risques et les dépendances et diriger de façon proactive les mesures d'atténuation.
• Élaborer des outils, des tableaux de bord, des cartes de pointage et des rapports de direction pour mesurer et suivre le rendement.
• Appuyer les séances d'examen et faciliter la prise de décisions efficaces.
• Coordonner avec les chefs d'initiative et les intervenants afin d'assurer l'exécution des engagements.
• Appuyer la budgétisation, les prévisions et le suivi financier des programmes stratégiques.
• Préparer des analyses de rentabilisation et appuyer les demandes de financement pour les initiatives clés.
• Favoriser la collaboration entre les fonctions pour assurer l'alignement entre la stratégie et l'exécution.

Vos antécédents

• Baccalauréat en développement durable, administration des affaires, ingénierie, ou un domaine connexe.
• 3 ans et plus d'expérience dans la gestion de programme, le BGP, les opérations opérationnelles, l'exécution de stratégie ou les initiatives de transformation.
• Expérience de la gestion de projets interfonctionnels au sein d'une organisation mondiale et matricielle.
• Fortes compétences en gestion des intervenants et en communication.
• Capacité éprouvée de conduire l'exécution par l'influence et la collaboration.
• Fortes compétences analytiques avec expérience en matière de rapports et de suivi du rendement.
• Compétence en PowerPoint, Excel, Power BI et outils de collaboration.
• Expérience de la gestion budgétaire et de l'information financière.

Plus sur nous
Nous croyons que le grand travail prospère dans un environnement où les gens se sentent véritablement soutenus et équitablement récompensés. Nos avantages sont conçus pour créer une valeur réelle pour chaque individu – alimenter l'engagement, la performance et la croissance. En priorisant le bien-être, nous construisons un milieu de travail où la réussite personnelle et organisationnelle se développe ensemble.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulla posizione
Come ingegnere di prova, testa e documenta i nostri prodotti prima della consegna ai clienti in tutto il mondo. Eseguire i test di accettazione di fabbrica (FAT) presso il nostro sito di produzione a Zurigo, analizzare gli errori e garantire che i nostri interruttori di circuito generatore soddisfano i più elevati requisiti di qualità e sicurezza.

Puoi farlo.

• Preparazione e costruzione di oggetti di prova per effettuare test
• Esecuzione di controlli di routine e test di accettazione di fabbrica (FAT) con i clienti internazionali
• Valutazione e documentazione dei risultati dei test
• Rilevazione e correzione di errori meccanici ed elettrici
Lo porti con te.

• Formazione elettrotecnica di base completata (ad esempio ingegnere automatico EFZ, installatore elettrico EFZ)
• Esperienza nella lettura e nella comprensione degli schemi elettrici
• Buona conoscenza della lingua tedesca e inglese
• Godere di problemi pratici e sfide tecniche
Ulteriori informazioni su di noi
Essendo l’unico sito di produzione mondiale per gli interruttori a circuito generatore di Hitachi Energy, il nostro business cresce continuamente. Questo è il motivo per cui investiamo specificamente nella nostra infrastruttura, tecnologia di test e dipendenti nei prossimi anni. Vi aspettano sfide tecniche entusiasmanti, contatti internazionali con i clienti e l'opportunità di plasmare attivamente un ambiente in crescita e in futuro.
descriptionByLocale.en:
About the position
As a test engineer, you test and document our products before delivery to customers worldwide. You perform Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) at our production site in Zurich, analyze errors and ensure that our generator circuit breakers meet the highest quality and safety requirements.

You can do that.

• Preparation and construction of test objects for conducting tests
• Execution of routine checks and factory acceptance tests (FAT) with international customers
• Assessment and documentation of test results
• Detection and correction of mechanical and electrical errors
You bring that with you

• Basic electrotechnical training completed (e.g. automatic engineer EFZ, electrical installer EFZ)
• Experience in reading and understanding electrical schemes
• Good knowledge of German and English
• Enjoying practical troubleshooting and technical challenges
More about us
As the world’s only production site for generator circuit breakers at Hitachi Energy, our business is continuously growing. That is why we are investing specifically in our infrastructure, testing technology and employees in the coming years. Exciting technical challenges, international customer contacts and the opportunity to actively shape a growing and future-proof environment await you.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Über die Position
Als Test Engineer prüfst und dokumentierst du unsere Produkte vor der Auslieferung an Kunden weltweit. Du führst Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) an unserem Produktionsstandort in Zürich durch, analysierst Fehler und stellst sicher, dass unsere Generatorleistungsschalter höchste Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsanforderungen erfüllen.

Das kannst du bewirken

• Vorbereitung und Aufbau von Prüfobjekten für die Durchführung von Prüfungen
• Durchführung von Routineprüfungen und Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) mit internationalen Kunden
• Bewertung und Dokumentation von Prüfergebnissen
• Erkennen und Beheben von mechanischen und elektrischen Fehlern
Das bringst du mit

• Abgeschlossene elektrotechnische Grundausbildung (z. B. Automatiker EFZ, Elektroinstallateur EFZ)
• Erfahrung im Lesen und Verstehen von elektrischen Schemas
• Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
• Freude an praktischer Fehlersuche und technischen Herausforderungen
Mehr über uns
Als weltweit einziger Produktionsstandort für Generatorleistungsschalter bei Hitachi Energy wächst unser Geschäft kontinuierlich. Deshalb investieren wir in den kommenden Jahren gezielt in unsere Infrastruktur, Prüftechnik und Mitarbeitenden. Dich erwarten spannende technische Herausforderungen, internationale Kundenkontakte sowie die Möglichkeit, in einem wachsenden und zukunftssicheren Umfeld aktiv mitzugestalten.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sur la position
En tant qu'ingénieur de test, vous testez et documentez nos produits avant de les livrer à des clients du monde entier. Vous effectuez des tests d'acceptation de l'usine (FAT) sur notre site de production à Zurich, analysez les erreurs et assurez-vous que nos disjoncteurs répondent aux exigences de qualité et de sécurité les plus élevées.

Tu peux le faire.

• Préparation et construction d ' objets d ' essai pour les essais
• Exécution de contrôles de routine et de tests d'acceptation en usine (FAT) avec des clients internationaux
• Évaluation et documentation des résultats des essais

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità
Hitachi Energy è alla ricerca di un HUB Material Planner per la linea di prodotti isolanti e componenti per unire un team innovativo e avanzato.

In questo ruolo, collaborerai a stretto contatto con sei fabbriche in tutta Europa per garantire un flusso materiale fluido ed efficiente in tutta la filiera.

Si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nello sviluppo e nell'attuazione di forti routine di previsione a livello di linea di prodotto, rafforzare le capacità di pianificazione dei materiali a livello di fabbrica, e sostenere il processo S&OP. Applicando metodi di previsione best-practice e ottimizzando i processi di rifornimento, si contribuirà a guidare la coerenza, l'affidabilità e le prestazioni in tutta la rete.

Si tratta di un'opportunità per avere un impatto reale guidando l'eccellenza operativa, sostenendo gli obiettivi di sostenibilità e contribuendo al continuo successo di Hitachi Energy nell'industria energetica globale.

Come si farà un impatto

• Sviluppare e standardizzare i processi di previsione e pianificazione dei materiali a livello di linea di prodotto, bilanciando la domanda e l'offerta attraverso orizzonti a breve, medio e lungo termine.
• Agire come il principale supporto operativo al processo S&OP, traducendo i piani di domanda in possibili piani di approvvigionamento e rifornimento dei materiali, valutando i rischi e i vincoli.
• Rafforzare le capacità di pianificazione dei materiali nelle fabbriche attraverso un uso efficace dei sistemi MRP per garantire la disponibilità dei materiali per la produzione e la domanda dei clienti.
• Sostenere le fabbriche nel mantenimento dei parametri di acquisto nei sistemi ERP e migliorare i metodi di rifornimento interni per aumentare l'efficienza.
• Stabilire e standardizzare i processi di pianificazione del materiale di routine da eseguire regolarmente a livello di fabbrica.
• Sviluppare e posizionare i progettisti di materiali locali come contributori chiave alla collaborazione interna S&OP e interfunzionale.
• Guidare la collaborazione proattiva con Class Manager, team di approvvigionamento, CSS e pianificatori locali per ottimizzare il flusso dei materiali e le prestazioni operative.
• Definire indicatori di performance, guidare la digitalizzazione e l'automazione del report KPI (ad esempio POWERBI), e sviluppare iniziative di formazione per migliorare continuamente la gestione e la competenza dei materiali.
Il tuo sfondo

• Laurea in Gestione della Supply Chain, Business Administration, Ingegneria, o un campo relativo.
• Minimo di 5 anni di esperienza nella gestione dei materiali, nel rifornimento o nelle operazioni della supply chain.
• Forte competenza in SAP ed eccellere con competenza avanzata nella pianificazione e pianificazione dei materiali.
• Prova capacità di standardizzare i processi e guidare iniziative di miglioramento continuo.
• Forte capacità di comunicazione e collaborazione, con esperienza di lavoro interfunzionale con i team di approvvigionamento, operazioni e supply chain, meglio se nelle organizzazioni multinazionali
• Capacità di viaggiare fino al 30%
Più su di noi
​
Crediamo che il grande lavoro prosperi in un ambiente in cui le persone si sentono sinceramente sostenute e abbastanza ricompensate. I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per creare valore reale per ogni individuo – il rifornimento di impegno, le prestazioni e la crescita. Con la priorità del benessere, costruiamo un posto di lavoro dove il successo personale e organizzativo crescono insieme.
​
La nostra offerta di benefici è su misura in base al vostro paese di lavoro e in genere include:

• Competitività e incentivi
• Benessere e cura
• congedo pagato e non pagato
• Opzioni di lavoro flessibili
• Vantaggi che supportano la vostra sicurezza finanziaria
Riceverai informazioni più specifiche durante il processo di reclutamento.

Le domande saranno esaminate su base continuativa, quindi vi invitiamo a presentare la vostra domanda già oggi.

The Opportunity
Hitachi Energy is seeking a HUB Material Planner for the insulation and components product line to join an innovative and forward‑thinking team.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with six factories across Europe to ensure a smooth and efficient material flow throughout the supply chain.

You will play a key role in developing and implementing strong forecasting routines at product line level, strengthening material planning capabilities at factory level, and supporting the S&OP process. By applying best‑practice forecasting methods and optimizing replenishment processes, you will help drive consistency, reliability, and performance across the network.

This is an opportunity to make a real impact by driving operational excellence, supporting sustainability goals, and contributing to the continued success of Hitachi Energy in the global energy industry.

How you will make an impact

• Develop and standardize forecasting and material planning processes at product line level, balancing demand and supply across short‑, mid‑ and long‑term horizons.
• Act as the key operational support to the S&OP process, translating demand plans into feasible material supply and replenishment plans while assessing risks and constraints.
• Strengthen material planning capabilities in factories through effective use of MRP systems to secure material availability for production and customer demand.
• Support factories in maintaining purchasing parameters in ERP systems and improving internal replenishment methods to increase efficiency.
• Establish and standardize routine material planning processes to be performed regularly at factory level.
• Develop and position local material planners as key contributors to internal S&OP and cross‑functional collaboration.
• Drive proactive collaboration with Category Managers, procurement teams, CSS and local planners to optimize material flow and operational performance.
• Define performance indicators, drive digitalization and automation of KPI reporting (e.g. POWERBI), and develop training initiatives to continuously improve material management and competence.
Your background

• Degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
• Minimum of 5 years of experience in material management, replenishment, or supply chain operations.
• Strong expertise in SAP and excel with advanced proficiency in materials planning and scheduling.
• Proven ability to standardize processes and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience working cross-functionally with procurement, operations, and supply chain teams, better if in multinational organizations
• Ability to travel up to 30%
More About Us​
​
We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together. ​
​
Our benefit offering is tailored based on your country of employment and generally includes:​

• Competitive salary and incentives​
• Well-being and care ​
• Paid and unpaid leave​
• Flexible work options ​
• Benefits that support your financial security​
You will receive more specific information during the recruitment process.​

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application already today. ​

Collabora con il team della supply chain per garantire che i progetti siano manufacturable e convenienti, selezionando materiali e componenti ottimali. Valuta e seleziona materiali e processi produttivi appropriati. Condurre approfondite recensioni e verifiche di progettazione, implementando modifiche per elevare la qualità del progetto. Prendere le responsabilità della leadership del progetto o svolgere un ruolo chiave all'interno di team di progetto, mentre sostenere e mentoring colleghi junior Act come esperto di materia tema, sostenere i colleghi e condividere le conoscenze per promuovere la collaborazione e l'innovazione all'interno del team Il vostro background Master in Ingegneria Meccanica, Fisica, o un campo correlato Minimo 3 anni di esperienza in R&D o ingegneria, preferibilmente in attrezzature ad alta tensione o componenti Solida conoscenza meccanica, idealmente nel campo di insulatori elettrici Esperienza nell'analisi degli elementi finiti e nell'uso del software ANSYS Eccellente analitica e capacità di problem solving. Capacità di parlare e lavorare insieme con i team tecnici in diverse parti del mondo. Atteggiamento proattivo, automotivato e con un forte senso di proprietà. Aperto a cambiamento, feedback e miglioramento continuo. A Hitachi Energy, riconosciamo che il nostro popolo è al centro del nostro successo. Ci impegniamo a fornire un lavoro di supporto e inclusivo, premi competitivi e opportunità di crescita professionale e personale. Il nostro pacchetto benefici è progettato per aiutare i dipendenti a prosperare sia al lavoro che nella loro vita personale.
