Dein Hintergrund

• Eingeschrieben in einem MSc-Programm in Elektrotechnik, Informatik, Angewandte Mathematik oder einem verwandten Bereich

• Starker Hintergrund in der numerischen Optimierung. Power System Wissen ist ein Plus

• Gute Kenntnisse über maschinelles Lernen und Deep Learning. Die Exposition gegenüber neuronalen Graphennetzwerken, Foundation-Modellen oder Anpassungsstrategien für maschinelles Lernen ist ein Plus

• Erfahrung in Python oder C++ Programmierung und MATLAB

• Erfahrung mit PyTorch oder ähnlichen Deep Learning Frameworks

• Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, Teamplayer-Einstellung, Initiative und Kreativität

Mehr über uns

Nicht-EU-/EFTA-Bürger, bitte beachten Sie, dass ein offizielles Universitätszertifikat erforderlich ist, aus dem hervorgeht, dass ein Praktikum ein obligatorischer Bestandteil Ihres Studiums ist.
descriptionByLocale.fr:

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità
Unisciti a noi come Planning & Fulfillment Manager e diventare un driver chiave del nostro successo operativo. In questo ruolo di leadership altamente visibile, supervisionerai e continuerai a migliorare le nostre attività di pianificazione e realizzazione end-to-end, traducendo la domanda del cliente in un'esecuzione efficiente e redditizia. Collegando la strategia con le operazioni, guiderai i processi di pianificazione, promuoverai la collaborazione tra la catena del valore e garantirai l'equilibrio ottimale del servizio, dell'inventario, della capacità e dei costi. La vostra esperienza contribuirà a rafforzare la resilienza operativa, accelerare le iniziative di trasformazione, e sostenere il raggiungimento dei nostri impegni commerciali e clienti.

Come farai ad avere un impatto

• Possedere e guidare i processi di pianificazione della fabbrica, a partire dai processi di pianificazione della domanda a lungo termine, ingegneria delle vendite e pianificazione delle operazioni (SE&OP), pianificazione delle capacità, pianificazione della produzione master, pianificazione dettagliata, pianificazione dei materiali e processi di esecuzione delle vendite e operazioni (S&OE).
• Guidando il processo locale SE&OP e allineando con il team di Product Line Planning, valutare la capacità della fabbrica di sostenere il piano di domanda a lungo termine e garantire l'allineamento tra i requisiti del cliente, capacità di produzione, disponibilità dei materiali, strategia di inventario e obiettivi finanziari.
• Traduci le previsioni della domanda, gli ordini del cliente e i requisiti del progetto in termini di fornitura, produzione, materiali e piani di consegna fattibile e monitora costantemente l'accuratezza delle previsioni e lo sviluppo del backlog.
• Gestire la produzione a breve, a medio e lungo termine e coordinare le priorità e le capacità di produzione e di fornitura, ottimizzare l'utilizzo della capacità installata e maneggiata, mantenendo al contempo la flessibilità operativa e l'affidabile consegna dei clienti.
• Stabilire, monitorare e migliorare continuamente i principali indicatori di performance di pianificazione e di completamento (Customer On-Time Delivery, Schedule Adherence (Internal OTD), Delivery Total ThroughPut Time and TPT, Forecast Accuracy, Material Availability, Capacity Usezation, Inventory Turns, Fornitore Delivery Performance) per fornire visibilità in tempo reale delle prestazioni di fabbrica.
• Guidare la distribuzione, l'adozione e l'ottimizzazione di ERP (SAP 4/Hana), Advanced Planning and Scheduling, analisi e soluzioni di supply chain digitali.
• Condurre iniziative di miglioramento continuo e di eccellenza operativa attraverso la pianificazione, l'approvvigionamento, l'inventario, la realizzazione, i processi logistici.
• Lead, coach e sviluppare un'organizzazione di pianificazione e adempimento altamente performante, tra cui pianificazione, gestione dei materiali, acquisto operativo, adempimento e professionisti della logistica.
Il tuo sfondo

• Laurea in Ingegneria, Business Administration, Gestione della Supply Chain, Gestione Operazioni o un campo relativo. Master's Degree (MBA o specializzazione Supply Chain) preferito.
• Minimo 8-10 anni di esperienza progressiva nella Supply Chain, pianificazione, adempimento, pianificazione della produzione, logistica o gestione delle operazioni.
• Minimo 5 anni di esperienza di leadership nella pianificazione di Sales Engineering & Operations (preferibilmente in un'impresa ETO).
• La competenza nei sistemi ERP e nel software di gestione della supply chain; la conoscenza degli strumenti di pianificazione avanzata (come Drummer o Cyberplan è un plus).
• Eccellente analitica e problem solving competenze, con un approccio data-driven al processo decisionale (Lean Manufacturing o Six Sigma certificazione è un plus).
• Forte capacità di comunicazione con la capacità di trasmettere informazioni in modo efficace. L'italiano è obbligatorio; fluente in inglese.
• Dimostrata capacità di guidare e team di mentore, promuovendo una cultura di miglioramento continuo e apprendimento.
• L'esperienza in trasformatori o apparecchiature elettriche è un plus ma non obbligatorio.
Ulteriori informazioni su di noi:
Hitachi Energy è dedicata a promuovere un posto di lavoro inclusivo dove ogni membro del team può prosperare e contribuire alle loro prospettive e competenze uniche. Forniamo stipendi competitivi, orari di lavoro flessibili, opportunità di sviluppo professionale e un ambiente di lavoro di supporto che incoraggia la crescita e l'innovazione attraverso programmi di sviluppo della carriera e gruppi di risorse dei dipendenti (ERG).
descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity
Join us as a Planning & Fulfillment Manager and become a key driver of our operational success. In this highly visible leadership role, you will oversee and continuously enhance our end-to-end planning and fulfillment activities, translating customer demand into efficient and profitable execution. By connecting strategy with operations, you will lead planning processes, foster collaboration across the value chain, and ensure the optimal balance of service, inventory, capacity, and cost. Your expertise will help strengthen operational resilience, accelerate transformation initiatives, and support the achievement of our business and customer commitments.

How you'll make an impact

• Own and lead the factory Planning processes, starting from long-term Demand Planning, Sales Engineering & Operations Planning (SE&OP), Capacity Planning, Master Production Planning, Detailed Scheduling, Material Planning, and Sales & Operations Execution (S&OE) processes.
• Leading the local SE&OP process and aligning with Product Line Planning team, assess the factory's ability to support the long-term demand plan and ensure alignment between customer requirements, production capacity, material availability, inventory strategy, and financial objectives.
• Translate demand forecasts, customer orders, and project requirements into feasible supply, production, material, and delivery plans and constantly monitor forecast accuracy and backlog development.
• Managing short-, medium-, and long-term production and coordinating production and supply priorities and capacity, optimize the utilization of installed and manned capacity while maintaining operational flexibility and reliable customer delivery.
• Establish, monitor, and continuously improve the principal Planning & Fulfillment performance indicators (Customer On-Time Delivery, Schedule Adherence (Internal OTD), Delivery Total ThroughPut Time and TPT, Forecast Accuracy, Material Availability, Capacity Utilization, Inventory Turns, Supplier Delivery Performance) to provide real-time visibility of factory performance.
• Drive the deployment, adoption, and optimization of ERP (SAP 4/Hana), Advanced Planning and Scheduling, analytics, and digital supply chain solutions.
• Lead continuous improvement and operational excellence initiatives across planning, procurement, inventory, fulfillment, logistics processes.
• Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing Planning & Fulfillment organization, including planning, material management, operative purchasing, fulfillment, and logistics professionals.
Your background

• Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management or a related field. Master's Degree (MBA or Supply Chain specialization) preferred.
• Minimum 8-10 years of progressive experience in Supply Chain, Planning, Fulfillment, Production Planning, Logistics, or Operations Management.
• Minimum of 5 years of people leadership experience in Sales Engineering & Operations planning (preferably in an ETO business).
• Proficiency in ERP systems and supply chain management software; knowledge of Advanced Planning Tools (like Drummer or Cyberplan is a plus).
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven approach to decision-making (Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma certification is a plus).
• Strong communication skills with the ability to convey information effectively. Italian is Mandatory; Fluent in English.
• Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor teams, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and learning.
• Experience in transformers or electrical equipment is a plus but not mandatory.
More about us:
Hitachi Energy is dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where every team member can thrive and contribute their unique perspectives and skills. We provide competitive salaries, flexible working hours, professional development opportunities, and a supportive work environment that encourages growth and innovation through career development programs and Employee Resource Groups (ERGs).

descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity

Hitachi Energy is a global leader in power and renewable technologies that enable utility and industry customers to improve their performance while lowering environmental impact. CHSEM provides high‑power semiconductor devices to Hitachi Energy internal customers (e.g. HVDC, GPQSS) as well as to external customers.
The Senior Material Quality Engineer ensures the quality, robustness, and long‑term reliability of critical raw materials used in BiMOS semiconductor device production at the Lenzburg fabrication facility. Acting as a technical authority, the role independently manages complex material‑ and supplier‑related quality topics, contributes to supplier quality strategy, and supports both supplier and team capability development to enable stable and scalable operations.

How you'll make an impact

• Drive the material quality approach for critical raw materials used in BiMOS operations

• Define and continuously improve CTQ concepts and control strategies

• Lead complex material quality investigations related to deviations, yield, and reliability issues

• Monitor & develop supplier performance and ensure effective implementation of corrective actions

• Lead material qualification, requalification, and change management activities

• Support production with technical expertise during production, troubleshooting, and ramp-up phases

• Drive cross-functional improvement initiatives to enhance quality, reliability, and cost efficiency

• Act as a technical reference, supporting or mentoring engineers and strengthening supplier and team capabilities

Your background

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics, or a related field

• Minimum 5 years of experience in material quality, supplier quality, or semiconductor manufacturing

• Certified auditor (VDA 6.3, ISO 19011, or equivalent)

• Strong knowledge of material quality, process control, and risk management in a manufacturing environment

• Proven ability to independently manage complex material and supplier quality issues

• Experience with structured quality methods such as 8D, Six Sigma, or equivalent

descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity

Are you passionate about driving operational excellence and creating measurable impact on the shop floor? As Continuous Improvement Manager, you will partner with factory and operations leaders to identify improvement opportunities, remove bottlenecks, and implement Lean Six Sigma initiatives across the value chain. This is a highly visible role where you will coach teams, lead transformational projects, and help shape a culture of continuous improvement across our manufacturing operations.

Please submit your CV and a cover letter outlining your motivation and relevant experience in English.

How you'll make an impact

• Act as a trusted Continuous Improvement advisor and sparring partner for Factory Managers, Operations Managers, and leadership teams, driving data-driven analyses, optimization initiatives, and operational excellence programs
• Work across the entire value chain to identify bottlenecks, remove constraints, improve flow, and maximize overall business performance
• Maintain a strong shop-floor presence through regular Gemba activities, working side-by-side with operators, supervisors, and managers to identify opportunities, solve problems, and sustain improvements where value is created
• Drive and promote Kaizen Events and Rapid Improvement Workshops to accelerate problem-solving, eliminate waste, and deliver fast, sustainable results
• Train, coach, and mentor employees and leaders in Lean Six Sigma methodologies, supporting certification programs and building continuous improvement capabilities throughout the organization
• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to map, analyze, redesign, and optimize end-to-end business processes
• Lead the deployment of Lean principles, standardization, best practices, and benchmarking activities across manufacturing sites
• Monitor, track, and communicate improvement program results through KPIs, ensuring sustainable implementation and measurable business impact
• Travel regularly to support factories, conduct workshops, coach teams, and drive improvement initiatives across the organization (minimum 20% travel required)
Your background

• Bachelor's or master's degree in engineering, Operations Management, or a related technical field
• Minimum 5 years of experience in Continuous Improvement, Operational Excellence, or Process Engineering, with proven hands-on experience in a manufacturing environment. Factory experience is mandatory
• Strong understanding and practical application of Lean Six Sigma methodologies (Green Belt required, Black Belt preferred)
• Proven experience leading Kaizen Events, Gemba activities, process mapping, value stream analysis, root cause analysis, and change management initiatives
• Demonstrated ability to identify bottlenecks, remove constraints, and improve end-to-end value stream performance
• Strong communication, facilitation, training, and presentation skills, with experience delivering workshops and Lean Six Sigma certification programs
• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and data-driven decision-making skills
• Self-driven, hands-on, and comfortable working on the shop floor alongside production teams to deliver sustainable improvements
• Willingness to travel regularly to support factories and improvement initiatives across the region (minimum 20% travel required)
• Fluent in English; German or Swedish is considered an advantage
More about us

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The Opportunity
We are looking for an Engineering Manager within the Operating Unit, Substation Automation Systems Europe. In this role, you will provide the professional engineering resources required for the design, engineering, testing, and commissioning of systems delivered through commercial projects under the responsibility of the Operating Unit.
You will drive operational and execution excellence through effective engineering management while fostering collaboration across the engineering community within the Operating Unit's countries to share solutions, balance workloads, and leverage lessons learned.
Key responsibilities include:

• Allocating the right engineering resources to project teams in accordance with S&OP processes.

• Establishing efficient interfaces between engineering teams and OPCs while increasing OPC utilization.

• Managing customer relationships with respect to technical requirements.

In this role, you will report to the Operating Unit Manager, Substation Automation Systems Europe.

How You'll Make an Impact

• Lead the engineering teams and own the performance management of engineering deliverables across the Operating Unit in Europe.

• Serve as the Business Process Owner for engineering and testing processes.

• Mentor and develop engineering function leaders and team members, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, as well as internal and external stakeholders.

• Coordinate the implementation of and adherence to global engineering processes, standards, practices, procedures, tools, and digitalization initiatives in collaboration with the Global Product Group and other Operating Units across the Business Unit.

• Define and lead the implementation of continuous improvement initiatives across engineering processes and tools, aligned with Business Unit and Global Product Group strategies.

• Monitor KPIs and performance metrics to ensure operational excellence and strategic alignment.

• Participate in the budgeting process together with the Operating Unit Manager and Controller.

• Ensure that the area of responsibility is structured to support the business model, adequately staffed with skilled resources, and effectively managed. Guide, motivate, and develop direct and indirect reports in accordance with HR policies. Oversee competency assessments and ensure engineering personnel hold the appropriate licenses and certifications.

• Champion Hitachi Energy's core values of safety, integrity, and quality by taking responsibility for your actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.
Your Background

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, or a related field.

• More than 15 years of engineering experience in the energy sector, including at least 5 years in a global leadership role.

• A results-oriented leader with a strong passion for people development, leadership, stakeholder engagement, and collaboration.

• An excellent communicator with the ability to influence beyond your direct organizational responsibilities and think strategically.

• Experience working within a multinational corporation and a global engineering environment.

• Strong knowledge of energy systems, grid infrastructure, renewable technologies, and regulatory frameworks within the utility and/or industrial infrastructure project business, combined with a solid understanding of engineering principles and a proven track record of delivering complex engineering projects across multiple geographies.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità

Il Research Team Semiconductor Packaging and Reliability Engineering presso il nostro Swiss Power Grids Research Center è alla ricerca di uno studente di tirocinanti con competenze in ingegneria elettrica, fisica, materiali e metodi analitici per contribuire allo sviluppo di nuovi moduli di potenza semiconduttore per applicazioni di e-mobilità e griglia. Lo stage interagirà con un team dinamico e multidisciplinare che supervisionerà e guiderà il progetto. Se avete un forte background tecnico, motivazione per sviluppare soluzioni innovative, e siete orientati verso l'obiettivo, questa è la vostra opportunità di contribuire a costruire un futuro energetico più forte e sostenibile. La durata dello stage è di sei mesi.

Le tue responsabilità

• Sostenere lo sviluppo tecnologico e le attività di ricerca nello sviluppo di moduli di potenza semiconduttore, cioè lo sviluppo di processo e la produzione di prototipi in una camera pulita all'avanguardia

• Eseguire test a vita accelerati, caratterizzare i moduli prima e dopo l'invecchiamento, supervisionare la configurazione del test

• Eseguire i primi passi dell'analisi della causa principale (X-ray, SAM, sezione trasversale ecc.) e documentare concisamente i risultati del test

• Eseguire simulazioni di elementi elettromagnetici e termiche infinite per convalidare le caratteristiche di progettazione

• Crea progetti CAD di moduli di potenza in stretta collaborazione con il team, trova soluzioni creative ed efficienti per soddisfare requisiti esigenti e talvolta contrastanti

Il tuo sfondo

• Attualmente persegue un M.Sc. laurea in scienze materiali, ingegneria elettrica, fisica, chimica o disciplina simile (grado avanzato B.Sc o M.Sc).

• Esperienza nel lavoro di laboratorio e know-how nei metodi sperimentali utilizzando una vasta gamma di tecniche di caratterizzazione dei materiali avanzati

• Competenze di programmazione solide (ad esempio LabVIEW, Python, Matlab ecc.)

• Esperienza con elemento finito modellante vantaggiosa (ANSYS Q3D, COMSOL)

The intern will interact with a dynamic and multidisciplinary team that will supervise and guide the project. Your background

descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity

We are seeking a highly motivated Industrial Engineer in our Production with a high focus on Lean Production and Process flow optimization to further develop our Generator Circuit-Breaker (GCB) production environment in Zurich. In this role, you will apply industrial engineering principles, automation, and digital manufacturing approaches to improve productivity, safety, quality, cost efficiency, and delivery performance in a high-variety, low-volume, engineering-to-order manufacturing environment.
You will play a key role in analyzing and improving complex GCB assembly, testing, material flow, and workstation concepts, while supporting the continuous development of a lean, digital, and future-ready factory.

How you'll make an impact

• Analyze current GCB production layouts, assembly workflows, testing processes, material flows, and operational procedures to identify improvement potential in efficiency, safety, quality, cost, and lead time, with a strong focus on automation and digitalization opportunities.

• Design and implement optimized production processes, workstation concepts, automation solutions, equipment utilization concepts, and improved material flow for GCB assembly and testing.

• Conduct time and motion studies, process mapping, value stream analysis, layout planning, capacity analysis, and bottleneck assessments to eliminate non-value-added activities and increase operational performance.

• Develop, standardize, and improve work instructions, standard operating procedures, manufacturing documentation, and digital shopfloor processes for GCB assembly, testing, and logistics operations.

• Evaluate, specify, and implement new manufacturing technologies such as automated handling systems, smart tools, digital work instructions, MES-related solutions, and data-driven improvement applications.

• Support industrialization activities, new product implementation, series ramp-ups, CAPEX initiatives, equipment procurement, PFMEA activities, and the introduction of new tools, jigs, fixtures, and testing equipment.

• Collaborate closely with production, testing, engineering, industrialization, quality, supply chain, planning, HSE, project management, and product management teams to ensure robust and sustainable process improvements.

• Lead and participate in continuous improvement initiatives, Lean Manufacturing projects, Kaizen activities, Six Sigma-related improvements, shopfloor optimization, and digital factory initiatives.

• Maintain and improve manufacturing master data, production standards, routing information, and KPI-based performance transparency to support efficient planning and execution.

• Contribute to the long-term development of the GCB factory by identifying future automation potential, improving ergonomics, strengthening safety, and enabling scalable production capabilities.

Your background

• Master's degree in Automation Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Professional experience in industrial engineering, production engineering, automation, industrialization, or manufacturing process improvement is preferred.

• Strong understanding of process optimization, Lean Manufacturing, continuous improvement methods, Kaizen, Six Sigma, value stream mapping, time studies, and statistical process control.

• Experience in complex assembly environments, high-voltage products, electrical equipment manufacturing, engineering-to-order production, or high-variety/low-volume manufacturing is highly desirable.

• Good knowledge of workstation design, layout planning, tooling concepts, ergonomics, equipment specification, manufacturing documentation, and structured problem solving.

• Familiarity with SAP, MES, digital work instructions, data analysis tools, or production KPI dashboards is an advantage.

• Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across operations, engineering, supply chain, quality, HSE, and project teams.

• Structured, analytical, hands-on, and solution-oriented mindset with the ability to manage several improvement projects simultaneously.

• Business fluent in English and German.

More about us

Our Generator Circuit-Breaker business in Zurich is a technology leader with a state-of-the-art factory based on lean manufacturing, flow production, and continuous improvement. We offer you the opportunity to shape the future of GCB production by combining industrial engineering, automation, digitalization, process flow optimization, and operational excellence in a dynamic and technically demanding manufacturing environment.

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills, grow, and contribute to advancing a sustainable energy future.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Chance

Wir suchen einen hochmotivierten Wirtschaftsingenieur in unserer Produktion mit hohem Fokus auf Lean Production und Prozessflussoptimierung, um unsere Generator Circuit-Breaker (GCB) Produktionsumgebung in Zürich weiterzuentwickeln. In dieser Rolle wenden Sie Industrial Engineering-Prinzipien, Automatisierung und digitale Fertigungsansätze an, um Produktivität, Sicherheit, Qualität, Kosteneffizienz und Lieferleistung in einer hochvarianten, kleinvolumigen Fertigungsumgebung zu verbessern.
Sie spielen eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Analyse und Verbesserung komplexer GCB-Montage-, Test-, Materialfluss- und Arbeitsplatzkonzepte und unterstützen gleichzeitig die kontinuierliche Entwicklung einer schlanken, digitalen und zukunftsfähigen Fabrik.

Wie Sie eine Wirkung erzielen werden

• Analysieren Sie aktuelle GCB-Produktionslayouts, Montage-Workflows, Testprozesse, Materialflüsse und Betriebsverfahren, um Verbesserungspotenziale in Bezug auf Effizienz, Sicherheit, Qualität, Kosten und Durchlaufzeit zu identifizieren, wobei der Schwerpunkt auf Automatisierungs- und Digitalisierungsmöglichkeiten liegt.

• Konzipieren und implementieren Sie optimierte Produktionsprozesse, Arbeitsplatzkonzepte, Automatisierungslösungen, Geräteauslastungskonzepte und einen verbesserten Materialfluss für die GCB-Montage und -Prüfung.

• Entwickeln, standardisieren und verbessern Sie Arbeitsanweisungen, Standardbetriebsverfahren, Fertigungsdokumentation und digitale Shopfloor-Prozesse für GCB-Montage-, Test- und Logistikvorgänge.

• Bewerten, spezifizieren und implementieren Sie neue Fertigungstechnologien wie automatisierte Handhabungssysteme, intelligente Werkzeuge, digitale Arbeitsanweisungen, MES-bezogene Lösungen und datengesteuerte Verbesserungsanwendungen.

• Unterstützen Sie Industrialisierungsaktivitäten, die Implementierung neuer Produkte, Serien-Ramp-ups, CAPEX-Initiativen, die Beschaffung von Ausrüstung, PFMEA-Aktivitäten und die Einführung neuer Werkzeuge, Vorrichtungen und Prüfgeräte.

• Führen und beteiligen Sie sich an kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsinitiativen, Lean Manufacturing-Projekten, Kaizen-Aktivitäten, Six Sigma-bezogenen Verbesserungen, Shopfloor-Optimierung und digitalen Fabrikinitiativen.

• Tragen Sie zur langfristigen Entwicklung der GCB-Fabrik bei, indem Sie zukünftige Automatisierungspotenziale identifizieren, die Ergonomie verbessern, die Sicherheit erhöhen und skalierbare Produktionskapazitäten ermöglichen.

Dein Hintergrund

• Master-Abschluss in Automation Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich.

• Berufserfahrung in der Industrietechnik, Produktionstechnik, Automatisierung, Industrialisierung oder Herstellungsprozessverbesserung wird bevorzugt.

• Starkes Verständnis für Prozessoptimierung, Lean Manufacturing, kontinuierliche Verbesserungsmethoden, Kaizen, Six Sigma, Value Stream Mapping, Zeitstudien und statistische Prozesskontrolle.

• Erfahrung in komplexen Montageumgebungen, Hochspannungsprodukten, Herstellung von Elektrogeräten, Auftragsfertigung oder Fertigung mit hoher Vielfalt / geringem Volumen ist sehr wünschenswert.

• Gute Kenntnisse der Arbeitsplatzgestaltung, Layoutplanung, Werkzeugkonzepte, Ergonomie, Gerätespezifikation, Fertigungsdokumentation und strukturierte Problemlösung.

• Die Vertrautheit mit SAP, MES, digitalen Arbeitsanweisungen, Datenanalysetools oder Produktions-KPI-Dashboards ist von Vorteil.

• Starke Kommunikation, Zusammenarbeit und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, effektiv über Operationen, Engineering, Supply Chain, Qualität, HSE und Projektteams zu arbeiten.

• Strukturierte, analytische, praktische und lösungsorientierte Denkweise mit der Fähigkeit, mehrere Verbesserungsprojekte gleichzeitig zu verwalten.

• Business fließend in Englisch und Deutsch.

Mehr über uns

Unser Generator Circuit-Breaker-Geschäft in Zürich ist ein Technologieführer mit einer hochmodernen Fabrik, die auf schlanker Fertigung, Durchflussproduktion und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung basiert. Wir bieten Ihnen die Möglichkeit, die Zukunft der GCB-Produktion durch die Kombination von Industrietechnik, Automatisierung, Digitalisierung, Prozessflussoptimierung und operativer Exzellenz in einer dynamischen und technisch anspruchsvollen Fertigungsumgebung zu gestalten.

Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsweisen helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln, wachsen und zur Förderung einer nachhaltigen Energiezukunft beitragen können.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità

Stiamo cercando uno sviluppatore di software R&D esperto focalizzato sullo sviluppo di applicazioni C++ per aderire alla nostra organizzazione tecnologica.

In questo ruolo, si svilupperà, ad alte prestazioni e sistemi software sicuri costruiti con C++ (C++17/20), con un forte focus sul comportamento in tempo reale, l'affidabilità e il supporto lungo ciclo di vita del prodotto.

Come sviluppatore di software R&D all'interno del dominio Grid Automation, aiuterete a modellare soluzioni innovative per i sistemi di potenza di domani.
Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con i team tecnologici globali che portano competenze di nicchia e capacità all'avanguardia. Il vostro lavoro supporterà direttamente lo sviluppo di software in tempo reale utilizzato in infrastrutture critiche software in tutto il mondo progettato per l'affidabilità a lungo termine, l'alta efficienza e la sicurezza senza compromessi.

Apprezziamo diverse esperienze e prospettive fresche. Anche se non soddisfa ogni requisito elencato, vi incoraggiamo ad applicare. Siamo entusiasti di saperne di più su di te e le forze uniche che puoi portare alla nostra squadra.

Come farete un impatto:

• Sviluppare la progettazione del sistema in aree come la multithreading, la sincronizzazione, I/O e i requisiti di latenza per il funzionamento in tempo reale.
• Sviluppa core C++ ad alte prestazioni per gestire i servizi runtime (.NET, RUST) con una minima overhead di latenza.
• Ottimizzazione delle prestazioni di implementazione e scalabilità: comportamento di threading del profilo, minimizzazione della soddisfazione di blocco, riduzione delle allocazioni di memoria in percorsi critici, e garantire la latenza prevedibile in scala.
• Mantenere alta qualità di codice attraverso le recensioni di codice, test di unità e l'adesione a SOLID, KISS, DRY e le migliori pratiche del settore.
• Partecipare alla progettazione del sistema, alle migliori pratiche e mantenere la qualità del codice nelle sezioni critiche alle prestazioni.
• Partecipare a revisioni di architettura tecnica, documentazione di progettazione e roadmap per lo sviluppo di funzionalità, le iniziative di refactoring e la modernizzazione del codice legacy, collaborare con l'ingegneria, il prodotto e gli stakeholder aziendali per trasformare i requisiti in progetti architettonici chiari.
• Sostenere le decisioni strategiche della tecnologia sulle dipendenze, costruire strumenti, gestione della dipendenza e garantire pratiche della supply chain del software, mantenere il supporto cross-platform: guidare l'ammodernamento dei sistemi di costruzione, garantire la coerenza tra più ambienti di distribuzione e supportare la compatibilità Linux/Windows.
• Pratiche strategie di sviluppo e di distribuzione Linux.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity

We are seeking an experienced R&D Software Developer focused on C++ application development to join our technology organization.

In this role, you will develop, high-performance, and secure software systems built with modern C++ (C++17/20), with a strong focus on real-time behavior, reliability, and long product lifecycle support.

As an R&D Software Developer within the Grid Automation domain, you will help shape innovative solutions for the power systems of tomorrow.
You will work closely with global technology teams that bring niche expertise and cutting-edge capabilities. Your work will directly support the development of real-time software used in critical infrastructure worldwide software designed for long-term reliability, high efficiency, and uncompromising security.

We value diverse experience and fresh perspectives. Even if you do not meet every listed requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are excited to learn more about you and the unique strengths you can bring to our team.

How you'll make an impact:

• Develop system design in areas like multithreading, synchronization, I/O, and latency requirements for real-time operation.
• Develop high-performance C++ cores to managed runtime services (.NET, RUST) with minimal latency overhead.
• Implement performance optimization and scalability: profile threading behavior, minimizing lock contention, reducing memory allocations in critical paths, and ensure predictable latency at scale.
• Maintain high code quality through code reviews, unit testing, and adherence to SOLID, KISS, DRY and industry best practices.
• Participate in system design, best practices and maintaining code quality in performance-critical sections.
• Participate in technical architecture reviews, design documentation, and roadmaps for feature development, refactoring initiatives, and legacy code modernization, collaborate with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to transform requirements into clear architectural designs.
• Support strategic technology decisions on dependencies, build tooling, dependency management, and secure software supply chain practices, maintain cross-platform support: drive modernization of build systems, ensure consistency across multiple deployment environments, and support Linux/Windows compatibility.
• Practical Linux development and deployment strategies.
• Contribute to achieving business goals by designing, developing, and delivering high-quality software solutions.
• Continuously enhance existing systems and contribute to the creation of new features.
• Work effectively within an agile environment, continually expanding your technical expertise and understanding of the business domain, actively participate in a cross-disciplinary team and contribute to shared objectives.
Your Background:

• University degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field.
• 8+ years of experience in senior technical roles.
• Advanced proficiency in modern C++ (C++17/20) with deep understanding of RAII, smart pointers, STL, concurrency, and memory management.
• Practical knowledge of C# development in plus.
• Strong experience with multithreading, synchronization primitives, asynchronous I/O and real-time system design.
• Proficiency with building systems (CMake, Visual Studio) and cross-platform development for Windows and Linux.
• Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and microservices architecture patterns.
• Demonstrated experience with performance profiling, optimization, and low-latency systems.
• Understanding of software architecture principles and secure, scalable system design.
• Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to tackle complex technical challenges.
• Good understanding of unit and integration testing techniques and testing frameworks.
• Knowledge of non-functional requirements (performance, scalability, security).
• Practical experience developing systems for power grid management and monitoring.
• Understanding of power grid operations and applicable standards.
• Experience with industrial automation systems (SCADA, IED, RTU) in plus.
• Experience with industrial protocols and standards (IEC-60870-5-104, DNP3, OPC UA, IEEE C37.118) in plus.
• Practical experience working directly with power grid industry clients.
• Proven ability to translate customer requirements into clear technical designs.
• Effective team player with strong communication skills and willingness to learn.
• Excellent command of English (written and spoken).
More about us

At Hitachi Energy, we recognize that our people are at the heart of our success. We are committed to providing a supportive and inclusive workplace, competitive rewards, and opportunities for professional and personal growth. Our benefits package is designed to help employees thrive both at work and in their personal lives.

Our benefits offering for this role generally includes:

• Employee Capital Plans (PPK)​

• Company events and team‑building activities​

• Free parking available

Wir suchen einen erfahrenen R&D-Softwareentwickler, der sich auf die Entwicklung von C++-Anwendungen konzentriert, um unserer Technologieorganisation beizutreten.

In dieser Funktion entwickeln Sie leistungsstarke und sichere Softwaresysteme, die mit modernem C++ (C++17/20) erstellt wurden, mit einem starken Fokus auf Echtzeitverhalten, Zuverlässigkeit und langer Produktlebenszyklusunterstützung.

Als F&E-Softwareentwickler im Bereich Grid Automation gestalten Sie innovative Lösungen für die Energiesysteme von morgen mit.

Ihre Arbeit unterstützt direkt die Entwicklung von Echtzeit-Software, die in weltweiter kritischer Infrastruktur für langfristige Zuverlässigkeit, hohe Effizienz und kompromisslose Sicherheit verwendet wird.

Wir schätzen vielfältige Erfahrungen und frische Perspektiven. Auch wenn Sie nicht alle aufgeführten Anforderungen erfüllen, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich zu bewerben. Wir freuen uns, mehr über Sie und die einzigartigen Stärken zu erfahren, die Sie in unser Team einbringen können.

Wie Sie eine Wirkung erzielen:

• Praktische Kenntnisse der C # -Entwicklung in Plus.
• Starke Erfahrung mit Multithreading, Synchronisationsprimitiven, asynchronem I/O und Echtzeit-Systemdesign.
• Kenntnisse in Gebäudesystemen (CMake, Visual Studio) und plattformübergreifender Entwicklung für Windows und Linux.
• Erfahrung mit Containerisierungstechnologien (Docker, Kubernetes) und Microservices-Architekturmustern.
• Demonstrierte Erfahrung mit Performance-Profiling, Optimierung und Systemen mit niedriger Latenz.

L'opportunité

Nous recherchons un développeur de logiciels de R & D expérimenté axé sur le développement d'applications C++ pour rejoindre notre organisation technologique.

Dans ce rôle, vous développerez, des systèmes logiciels performants et sécurisés construits avec le C++ moderne (C++17/20), en mettant fortement l'accent sur le comportement en temps réel, la fiabilité et la longue durée de vie des produits.

En tant que développeur logiciel de R & D dans le domaine de l'automatisation du réseau, vous aiderez à façonner des solutions innovantes pour les systèmes d'alimentation de demain.
Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec des équipes technologiques mondiales qui apportent une expertise de niche et des capacités de pointe. Votre travail soutiendra directement le développement de logiciels en temps réel utilisés dans les infrastructures critiques dans le monde entier, conçus pour une fiabilité à long terme, une efficacité élevée et une sécurité sans compromis.

Nous apprécions l'expérience diversifiée et les nouvelles perspectives. Même si vous ne respectez pas toutes les exigences énumérées, nous vous encourageons à postuler. Nous sommes heureux d'en apprendre plus sur vous et les forces uniques que vous pouvez apporter à notre équipe.

Comment vous ferez un impact:

• Développer la conception de systèmes dans des domaines comme le multithreading, la synchronisation, les E/S et les exigences de latence pour le fonctionnement en temps réel.
• Développez des cœurs C++ haute performance pour des services d'exécution gérés (.NET, ROUST) avec un minimum de frais généraux de latence.
• Implémenter l'optimisation des performances et l'évolutivité : comportement de filetage de profil, minimiser la discorde de verrouillage, réduire les allocations de mémoire dans les chemins critiques, et assurer une latence prévisible à l'échelle.
• Maintenir une qualité de code élevée au moyen d'examens de code, de tests unitaires et de l'adhésion aux pratiques exemplaires de SOLID, KISS, DRY et de l'industrie.
• Participer à la conception des systèmes, aux pratiques exemplaires et au maintien de la qualité des codes dans les sections essentielles au rendement.
• Participer à l'examen de l'architecture technique, à la documentation de conception et aux feuilles de route pour l'élaboration de caractéristiques, les initiatives de refactoration et la modernisation du code hérité, collaborer avec les intervenants du génie, des produits et des entreprises pour transformer les exigences en conceptions architecturales claires.
• Soutenir les décisions technologiques stratégiques sur les dépendances, construire des outils, gérer la dépendance et sécuriser les pratiques de la chaîne d'approvisionnement des logiciels, maintenir un support multiplateforme : piloter la modernisation des systèmes de construction, assurer la cohérence entre plusieurs environnements de déploiement et soutenir la compatibilité Linux/Windows.
• Stratégies pratiques de développement et de déploiement Linux.
• Contribuer à la réalisation des objectifs opérationnels en concevant, développant et fournissant des solutions logicielles de haute qualité.
• Améliorer continuellement les systèmes existants et contribuer à la création de nouvelles fonctionnalités.
• Travailler efficacement dans un environnement agile, développer continuellement votre expertise technique et votre compréhension du domaine des affaires, participer activement à une équipe interdisciplinaire et contribuer à des objectifs communs.
Contexte :

• Diplôme universitaire en informatique, en génie ou dans un domaine technique connexe.
• 8 ans et plus d'expérience dans les rôles techniques supérieurs.
• Compétences avancées en C++ moderne (C++17/20) avec une compréhension approfondie de RAII, pointeurs intelligents, STL, concurrence et gestion de la mémoire.
• Connaissance pratique du développement C# en plus.
• Forte expérience avec le multithreading, la synchronisation primitive, les E/S asynchrones et la conception en temps réel du système.
• Compétence avec les systèmes de construction (CMake, Visual Studio) et développement multiplateforme pour Windows et Linux.
• Expérience des technologies de conteneurisation (Docker, Kubernetes) et des modèles d'architecture de microservices.
• Expérience démontrée avec les systèmes de profilage des performances, d'optimisation et de faible latence.
• Compréhension des principes d'architecture logicielle et conception sécurisée et évolutive du système.
• Excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes et capacité à relever des défis techniques complexes.
• Bonne compréhension des techniques d'essai de l'unité et de l'intégration et des cadres d'essai.
• Connaissance des exigences non fonctionnelles (performance, évolutivité, sécurité).
• Expérience pratique du développement de systèmes de gestion et de surveillance du réseau électrique.
• Compréhension des opérations du réseau électrique et des normes applicables.
• Expérience des systèmes d'automatisation industrielle (SCADA, IED, RTU) en plus.
• Expérience des protocoles et des normes industriels (IEC-60870-5-104, DNP3, OPC UA, IEEE C37.118) en plus.
• Expérience pratique en travaillant directement avec les clients du secteur du réseau électrique.

• Joueur d'équipe efficace avec de solides compétences de communication et la volonté d'apprendre.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity

Join Hitachi Energy's High Voltage Products business and become part of a globally recognized team delivering advanced solutions for power transmission and distribution. In this role, you will support the development and execution of customer-specific projects for Generator Circuit-Breakers used in power generation applications worldwide. Based in Zurich-Oerlikon, you will combine your electrical engineering expertise with your Mandarin Chinese language skills to support customers and business partners in China and contribute to the global energy transition.

How you'll make an impact

• Create customer-specific wiring and electrical schematics based on technical requirements and project specifications

• Develop and maintain wiring diagrams for new products and product enhancements using EPLAN P8

• Revise electrical documentation to reflect customer requirements, control system changes, and product developments

• Provide technical support to suppliers involved in control cabinet manufacturing and assembly

• Maintain and further develop component and language databases within EPLAN P8

• Collaborate closely with project managers, engineering teams, suppliers, and international customers

• Support project execution through occasional travel to customer sites and power plants, mainly in China

• Ensure compliance with internal procedures, industry standards, safety regulations, and quality requirements

Your background

• Completed apprenticeship, technical diploma, or Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related field

• Minimum of 2 years of professional experience in electrical design, engineering, or a comparable technical role

• Experience with EPLAN P8 or similar ECAD software is an advantage

• Fluent in Mandarin and English; German language skills are an advantage

• Strong attention to detail and a structured, precise way of working

• Independent, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset

• Team player with strong communication and collaboration skills

• Willingness to travel internationally as required by projects, approximately 20%

More about us

Hitachi Energy's High Voltage Products business is a global leader in power transmission and distribution technologies. Within this business, our Generator Circuit-Breaker team develops, manufactures, markets, and services high-current switching systems for power plants around the world. We offer an inclusive and collaborative work environment, flexible working models, and exciting opportunities for professional growth. Join us and help shape a more sustainable energy future for generations to come.

In diesem Geschäft entwickelt, produziert, vermarktet und betreut unser Generator Circuit-Breaker-Team Hochstromschaltsysteme für Kraftwerke auf der ganzen Welt.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'occasion de rejoindre Hitachi Energy's High Voltage Products et de faire partie d'une équipe mondialement reconnue offrant des solutions avancées pour la transmission et la distribution d'électricité. Dans ce rôle, vous soutiendrez le développement et l'exécution de projets spécifiques à la clientèle pour les générateurs de circuits utilisés dans les applications de production d'électricité dans le monde entier. Basé à Zurich-Oerlikon, vous combinerez votre expertise en génie électrique avec vos compétences en mandarin chinois pour soutenir les clients et les partenaires commerciaux en Chine et contribuer à la transition énergétique mondiale. Comment vous ferez un impact Créer des schémas de câblage et d'électricité spécifiques au client en fonction des exigences techniques et des spécifications du projet Élaborer et entretenir des diagrammes de câblage pour les nouveaux produits et les améliorations du produit en utilisant EPLAN P8 Réviser la documentation électrique pour tenir compte des exigences du client, des changements de système de contrôle et de l'évolution du produit Fournir un soutien technique aux fournisseurs qui participent à la fabrication et à l'assemblage des armoires de contrôle Maintenir et développer davantage les bases de données sur les composants et les langues au sein d'EPLAN P8 Collaborer étroitement avec les gestionnaires de projets, les équipes d'ingénierie, les fournisseurs et les clients internationaux Soutenir l'exécution de projets par des voyages occasionnels vers des sites clients et des centrales électriques, principalement en Chine Assurer le respect des procédures internes, des normes industrielles, des règlements de sécurité et des exigences de qualité Votre formation Apprentissage, diplôme technique ou baccalauréat en génie électrique, en ingénierie d'automatisation ou dans un domaine connexe Minimum de 2 ans d'expérience professionnelle en conception électrique, en ingénierie ou dans un rôle technique comparable L'expérience d'EPLAN P8 ou d'un logiciel ECAD similaire est un avantage Fluent en mandarin et en anglais; les compétences en langue allemande sont un avantage Une grande attention aux détails et une façon structurée et précise de travailler Un état d'esprit indépendant, proactif et axé sur la solution Joueur d'équipe possédant de solides compétences en communication et en collaboration Volonté de voyager à l'étranger comme l'exigent les projets, environ 20% En savoir plus sur nous Hitachi Energy High Voltage Products business est un leader mondial dans les technologies de transmission et de distribution d'électricité. Au sein de cette entreprise, notre équipe de générateurs de circuits-bréakers développe, fabrique, commercialise et fournit des systèmes de commutation à courant élevé pour les centrales électriques du monde entier.
• Nous offrons un environnement de travail inclusif et collaboratif, des modèles de travail flexibles et des possibilités passionnantes de croissance professionnelle. Rejoignez-nous et contribuez à façonner un avenir énergétique plus durable pour les générations à venir.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulla posizione
Come team leader / in assemblaggio elettrico presso la fabbrica GI Valves a Seon o Turgi conduce un team di circa 15 dipendenti. Si assume un ruolo centrale nel controllo quotidiano della produzione. Coordinate le attività operative all'interno del team e assicurate che i processi di assemblaggio, collaudo e logistica siano efficienti, sicuri e di qualità. Sei la persona di contatto diretto per i dipendenti e lavorare a stretto contatto con la gestione della produzione e altre interfacce. Il vostro impegno contribuisce in modo significativo al raggiungimento dei nostri obiettivi di produzione e al continuo miglioramento. Oltre alle attività coordinate, siete attivamente coinvolti nel processo di assemblaggio (circa il 50%).

Puoi farlo.

• Gestione del team sia tecnicamente che operativamente sia in termini di personale

• Organizzazione e monitoraggio dei processi produttivi (assembly, testing, logistics)

• Rispetto dei requisiti di sicurezza, qualità e ambiente

• Assistenza nella formazione di nuovi dipendenti e nell'esecuzione della formazione di sicurezza

• Cooperazione con interfacce come la pianificazione, la qualità e la logistica, nonché la documentazione delle prestazioni di produzione

• Attuazione e applicazione degli obiettivi organizzativi generali

Lo porti con te.

• Formazione professionale tecnica (ad esempio ingegneria elettrica, installazione elettrica, meccatronica)

• Un'ulteriore formazione come tecnico HF è un vantaggio

• Diversi anni di esperienza nel montaggio di componenti elettrici

• Esperienza come leader di squadra e buone capacità di comunicazione

• Tedesco in parola e scrittura, Inglese competenze di vantaggio

• La conoscenza e l'esperienza SAP con i sistemi di produzione digitali (MES) sono un vantaggio

Ulteriori informazioni su di noi
I nostri metodi di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le tue prestazioni personali e professionali e a creare un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare e crescere le loro competenze.
descriptionByLocale.en:
About the position
As team leader/in electrical assembly at the GI Valves factory in Seon or Turgi leads a team of about 15 employees. You take on a central role in daily production control. You coordinate operational activities within the team and ensure that assembly, testing and logistics processes are efficient, safe and quality-appropriate. You are the direct contact person for the employees and work closely with production management and other interfaces. Your commitment contributes significantly to achieving our production goals and continuously improving. In addition to coordinative activities, you are actively involved in the assembly process (about 50%).

You can do that.

• Management of the team both technically and operationally as well as in terms of personnel

• Organisation and monitoring of production processes (assembly, testing, logistics)

• Compliance with safety, quality and environmental requirements

• Assistance in the training of new employees and carrying out safety training

• Cooperation with interfaces such as planning, quality and logistics as well as documentation of production performance

• Implementation and enforcement of the overall organisational objectives

You bring that with you

• Technical vocational training (e.g. electrical engineering, electrical installation, mechatronics)

• Further education as a technician HF is an advantage

• Several years of experience in the assembly of electrical components

• Experience as a team leader and good communication skills

• German in word and writing, English skills of advantage

• SAP knowledge and experience with digital production systems (MES) are a plus

More about us
Our flexible working methods help you optimize your personal and professional performance and create an environment where all employees can develop and grow their skills.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità

Hitachi Energy è alla ricerca di un ingegnere meccanico R&D – Alta Tensione per unirsi al nostro team innovativo e avanzato. In questo ruolo, si assumerà una responsabilità significativa per lo sviluppo e la consegna di prodotti e tecnologie innovative. Potrai sfruttare la tua esperienza tecnica per portare aspetti chiave dei progetti, assicurando che le soluzioni soddisfino i più elevati standard di qualità e prestazioni, rispettando le rigorose scadenze e budget. Questo è un ruolo di alto impatto con eccellenti opportunità per la crescita e lo sviluppo della carriera.

Come si farà un impatto

• Applica la tua esperienza in tecnologie, strumenti e metodi per risolvere complesse sfide industriali e sviluppare prodotti e soluzioni innovative

• Contribuire a modellare strategie tecnologiche e portafogli di progetto, aiutando a guidare la direzione dell'organizzazione

• Lavorare su complessi compiti di ingegneria utilizzando tecniche avanzate e innovative per fornire risultati R&D efficaci

• Prendere le responsabilità della leadership del progetto o svolgere un ruolo chiave all'interno dei team di progetto, mentre sostenere e sostenere i colleghi junior

• Rimani aggiornato con le tendenze e le tecnologie chiave nel tuo campo e proattivi miglioramenti nelle operazioni e nella soddisfazione del cliente

• Agire come esperto di materia, sostenere i colleghi e condividere le conoscenze per promuovere la collaborazione e l'innovazione all'interno del team

• Sostenere le operazioni aziendali e i clienti come esperto tecnico e rappresentare il team in forum di ingegneria interni ed esterni

• Contribuire alla strategia di proprietà intellettuale, identificare i rischi e sostenere una gestione efficace dei rischi nei progetti R&D

Il tuo sfondo

• Laurea magistrale in Ingegneria Meccanica, Fisica, o un campo correlato

• 5-10 anni di esperienza in R&D o ingegneria, preferibilmente in apparecchiature o componenti ad alta tensione

• Forte competenza nella progettazione e nello sviluppo di componenti ad alta tensione (l'esperienza con boccole è un vantaggio)

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione in inglese, scritto e parlato

• Solida comprensione dei processi aziendali e degli ambienti R&D

• Esperienza comprovata nella gestione del progetto e collaborazione interfunzionale

• Conoscenza di base delle considerazioni di proprietà intellettuale in R&D

Ulteriori informazioni su di noi
In Hitachi Energy lavorerai in un ambiente internazionale e collaborativo, contribuendo a tecnologie innovative che modellano il futuro dei sistemi energetici.
Questo ruolo offre l'opportunità di affrontare le sfide del mondo reale nelle reti elettriche e nella sostenibilità, combinando ingegneria avanzata con applicazioni di impatto.
Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.
descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity

Hitachi Energy is seeking a Senior R&D Mechanical Engineer – High Voltage to join our innovative and forward-thinking team. In this role, you will take on significant responsibility for the development and delivery of innovative products and technologies. You will leverage your technical expertise to lead key aspects of projects, ensuring that solutions meet the highest standards of quality and performance while adhering to strict deadlines and budgets. This is a high-impact role with excellent opportunities for career growth and development.

How you will make an impact

• Apply your expertise in technologies, tools, and methods to solve complex industrial challenges and develop innovative products and solutions

• Contribute to shaping technology strategies and project portfolios, helping guide the direction of the organization

• Work on complex engineering tasks using advanced and innovative techniques to deliver impactful R&D results

• Take on project leadership responsibilities or play a key role within project teams, while supporting and mentoring junior colleagues

• Stay up to date with key trends and technologies in your field and proactively drive improvements in operations and customer satisfaction

• Act as a subject matter expert, supporting colleagues and sharing knowledge to foster collaboration and innovation within the team

• Support business operations and customers as a technical expert and represent the team in internal and external engineering forums

• Contribute to intellectual property strategy, identify risks, and support effective risk management in R&D projects

Your background

• Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Physics, or a related field

• 5–10 years of experience in R&D or engineering, preferably in high voltage equipment or components

• Strong expertise in the design and development of high voltage components (experience with bushings is an advantage)

• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken

• Solid understanding of business processes and R&D environments

• Proven experience in project management and cross-functional collaboration

• Basic understanding of intellectual property considerations in R&D

More about us
At Hitachi Energy, you will work in an international and collaborative environment, contributing to innovative technologies that shape the future of energy systems.
This role offers the opportunity to address real-world challenges in power grids and sustainability, combining advanced engineering with impactful applications.
Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Chance

Hitachi Energy sucht einen Senior R&D Mechanical Engineer – High Voltage, der sich unserem innovativen und zukunftsweisenden Team anschließt. In dieser Funktion übernehmen Sie erhebliche Verantwortung für die Entwicklung und Lieferung innovativer Produkte und Technologien. Sie werden Ihr technisches Fachwissen nutzen, um wichtige Aspekte von Projekten zu leiten und sicherzustellen, dass Lösungen die höchsten Qualitäts- und Leistungsstandards erfüllen und gleichzeitig strenge Fristen und Budgets einhalten. Dies ist eine wichtige Rolle mit hervorragenden Möglichkeiten für berufliches Wachstum und Entwicklung.

Wie Sie eine Wirkung erzielen werden

• Wenden Sie Ihre Expertise in Technologien, Tools und Methoden an, um komplexe industrielle Herausforderungen zu lösen und innovative Produkte und Lösungen zu entwickeln

• Tragen Sie zur Gestaltung von Technologiestrategien und Projektportfolios bei und unterstützen Sie die Ausrichtung der Organisation

• Arbeiten an komplexen technischen Aufgaben mit fortschrittlichen und innovativen Techniken, um wirkungsvolle F&E-Ergebnisse zu liefern

• Übernehmen Sie Projektleitungsverantwortung oder spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle in Projektteams und unterstützen und betreuen Sie Juniorkollegen

• Bleiben Sie auf dem Laufenden mit den wichtigsten Trends und Technologien in Ihrem Bereich und fördern Sie proaktiv Verbesserungen im Betrieb und der Kundenzufriedenheit

• Handeln Sie als Fachexperte, unterstützen Sie Kollegen und teilen Sie Wissen, um die Zusammenarbeit und Innovation innerhalb des Teams zu fördern

• Unterstützen Sie den Geschäftsbetrieb und Kunden als technischer Experte und vertreten Sie das Team in internen und externen Engineering-Foren

• Beitrag zur Strategie für geistiges Eigentum, Identifizierung von Risiken und Unterstützung eines effektiven Risikomanagements in F&E-Projekten

Dein Hintergrund

• Master-Abschluss in Maschinenbau, Physik oder einem verwandten Bereich

• 5-10 Jahre Erfahrung in R&D oder Engineering, vorzugsweise in Hochspannungsgeräten oder -komponenten

• Starkes Know-how in der Konstruktion und Entwicklung von Hochspannungskomponenten (Erfahrung mit Durchführungen ist von Vorteil)

• Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch, sowohl geschrieben als auch gesprochen

• Solides Verständnis von Geschäftsprozessen und R&D-Umgebungen

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und in der funktionsübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit

• Grundlegendes Verständnis von Überlegungen zum geistigen Eigentum in F&E

Mehr über uns
Bei Hitachi Energy arbeiten Sie in einem internationalen und kollaborativen Umfeld und tragen zu innovativen Technologien bei, die die Zukunft der Energiesysteme gestalten.
Diese Rolle bietet die Möglichkeit, reale Herausforderungen in Bezug auf Stromnetze und Nachhaltigkeit anzugehen und fortschrittliches Engineering mit wirkungsvollen Anwendungen zu kombinieren.
Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.

This role is ideal for a commercially driven professional with strong technical understanding, structured thinking, and the confidence to lead complex sales and tender processes end‑to‑end. How you'll make an impact Define and execute the sales strategy for Rolling Stock within Dry Type Transformers Develop and maintain an effective channel strategy to drive market growth Manage customer requests, tenders, and bid processes end‑to‑end Prepare cost calculations and develop complete, competitive offers Lead commercial negotiations with internal and external stakeholders Ensure compliance with internal policies and external regulations Hand over awarded projects to project management teams Build strong customer relationships through regular visits and engagement Analyze lost bids and drive actions to improve future competitiveness Your background Degree in Engineering or equivalent technical discipline 5+ years of experience in sales, tendering, or bid management Proven ability to manage complex commercial and tender processes Strong analytical, communication, and negotiation skills High attention to detail and structured way of working Comfortable operating in cross‑functional, deadline‑driven environments Fluent in English and Italian; additional languages are a plus More about us

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità Sei appassionato di trasformare gli ambienti produttivi attraverso soluzioni digitali intelligenti e basate sui dati? Come analista IT Business per MES e sistemi di produzione all'interno del BST Grid Integration Application Delivery Team, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nella modellazione della spina dorsale digitale delle nostre fabbriche globali. descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity Are you passionate about transforming manufacturing environments through smart, data‑driven digital solutions? As an IT Business Analyst for MES and Manufacturing Systems within the BST Grid Integration Application Delivery Team, you will play a key role in shaping the digital backbone of our global factories. You will bridge operational needs with modern technology, enabling efficient, safe, and reliable production processes that support our Grid Integration business. You will work closely with stakeholders, development, and operations to ensure our application landscape delivers maximum business value, innovation, and user satisfaction. This position is based in Lenzburg with the option for hybrid work. This role offers the opportunity to influence how our manufacturing sites evolve, standardize, and innovate. Even if you do not meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply—your mindset and potential are equally important. A team with great cooperation and with diverse backgrounds is waiting for you to join! How you'll make an impact Act as the primary Business Analyst for manufacturing applications , ensuring they meet evolving operational and strategic requirements Collaborate closely with production teams, process engineers, application owners, and global GI stakeholders to collect requirements , define solutions, and secure alignment across all sites Analyze and model processes (e.g., production workflows, quality checkpoints, traceability, data collection), translating them into clear functional and technical requirements for system enhancements or new Manufacturing capabilities Support the full lifecycle of manufacturing applications, ensuring security, compliance, reliability, and integration with critical systems Facilitate workshops, perform gap analyses, lead stakeholder meetings, and create clear documentation to ensure shared understanding and effective decision‑making Identify opportunities to streamline system landscapes , improve data quality, reduce manual work, and strengthen harmonization across factories Drive continuous improvement by monitoring system performance, gathering feedback from users, and proposing enhancements to increase value and efficiency Your Background Proven experience as an IT Business Analyst, Management Consultant, IT Consultant, or Manufacturing IT Analyst within complex industrial or production environments Strong analytical skills with the ability to understand and model business and manufacturing processes and translate them into actionable requirements Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across diverse teams and cultures Demonstrate experience working with IT\/OT teams, development, operations teams and vendors to deliver high-quality application support and enhancements Experience with MES platforms, industrial data systems, or integration technologies is an advantage, but not mandatory Fluency in English is required More about us
• We offer a competitive Swiss benefits package designed to support your professional growth and well‑being. Depending on experience and role, this may include: Pension and insurance plans Performance‑based bonus Flexible working arrangements Learning and development opportunities
descriptionByLocale.de:

Diese Rolle bietet die Möglichkeit zu beeinflussen, wie sich unsere Fertigungsstätten entwickeln, vereinheitlichen und innovativ entwickeln. Auch wenn Sie nicht jede Anforderung erfüllen, ermutigen wir Sie, sich zu bewerben – Ihre Denkweise und Potenziale sind ebenso wichtig. descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'opportunité Êtes-vous passionné par la transformation des environnements de fabrication au moyen de solutions numériques intelligentes et axées sur les données? En tant qu'analyste IT pour le MES et les systèmes de fabrication au sein de l'équipe de livraison des applications d'intégration du réseau BST, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la formation de l'épine dorsale numérique de nos usines mondiales. Vous relierez les besoins opérationnels avec la technologie moderne, permettant des processus de production efficaces, sûrs et fiables qui soutiennent notre activité d'intégration du réseau. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les intervenants, le développement et les opérations pour vous assurer que notre environnement d'application offre une valeur commerciale maximale, de l'innovation et de la satisfaction des utilisateurs. Cette position est basée à Lenzburg avec l'option pour le travail hybride. Ce rôle offre l'occasion d'influencer l'évolution, la normalisation et l'innovation de nos sites de fabrication. Même si vous ne répondez pas à toutes les exigences, nous vous encourageons à postuler – votre état d'esprit et votre potentiel sont tout aussi importants. Une équipe avec une grande coopération et des antécédents variés vous attend pour rejoindre! Comment vous allez faire un impact Act en tant qu'analyste principal pour les applications de fabrication , en s'assurant qu'ils répondent aux exigences opérationnelles et stratégiques en évolution Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de production, les ingénieurs de processus, les propriétaires d'applications et les intervenants mondiaux de l'IG pour recueillir les exigences , définir des solutions et assurer l'alignement sur tous les sites Analyser et modéliser les processus (p. ex., flux de production, contrôles de qualité, traçabilité, collecte de données), les traduire en exigences fonctionnelles et techniques claires pour les améliorations du système ou les nouvelles capacités de fabrication Soutenir le cycle de vie complet des applications de fabrication, assurer la sécurité, la conformité, la fiabilité et l'intégration aux systèmes critiques Faciliter les ateliers, effectuer des analyses d'écarts, diriger les réunions des intervenants et créer une documentation claire pour assurer une compréhension partagée et une prise de décision efficace Identifier les possibilités de rationaliser les paysages du système, améliorer la qualité des données, réduire le travail manuel et renforcer l'harmonisation entre les usines Favoriser l'amélioration continue par la surveillance du rendement du système, recueillir les commentaires des utilisateurs et proposer des améliorations pour ne pas accroître la valeur et l'efficacité Votre expérience acquise en tant en tant
• Nous offrons un package d'avantages concurrentiel suisse conçu pour soutenir votre croissance professionnelle et votre bien-être. descriptionByLocale.it: The Opportunity: As a part of Global Product Group Distribution & Traction Transformers team, you will be responsible for business analysis for core digitalization projects including Digital TrafoSignature, ECS, IBA and Matterport within 25 factories in the portfolio scope. You will contribute cross-functionally by collaborating with IT function and business domains, as well as being responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the GPG DT Power BI reports to monitor KPIs and performance metrics How you'll make an impact Ensure adherence to data governance standards and maintain comprehensive documentation for all reports and processes within GPG DT Operations Digital area. Collect and design business requirements into required documentation format and templates. Identify opportunities to enhance reporting processes, tools, and methodologies for greater efficiency and scalability. Implement best practices and leverage emerging technologies to improve data analytics capabilities. Provide training and guidance to business teams on the analytics reports, core digital tools, TrafoSignature tool. Collaborate with global teams, HUBs, and factories to gather requirements and deliver tailored reporting solutions. Act as a key liaison between technical teams and business stakeholders to ensure alignment and transparency. Lead functional and business analysis for core projects: Digital TrafoSignature, ECS, IBA, Matterport from business perspective. Perform user acceptance tests and validation together with key-users and IT. Provide digital updates on GPG DT website content with the usage of CMS.   Your background Degree in Engineering, Data Science, IT or a related technical field. Minimum 5 years of experience in end-to-end data analytics, preferably within manufacturing or industrial environments. Proficiency in Power BI, including advanced DAX functions, Power Query, and report scheduling. Good knowledge of data modeling, visualization, and integration from multiple sources (e.g., SAP, SQL, Azure, Power Automate). Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with global technical teams and stakeholders. Strong understanding of functional and business analysis. Strong problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and ability to work independently in a global team environment. We are committed to full transparency and compliance with all legal requirements, ensuring that every candidate knows exactly what to expect at each stage of the recruitment process. Once the process is successfully completed, we will share detailed information about financial conditions and benefits with the selected candidate. Before signing the employment contract, you will receive all remaining details of the offer, giving you the time and space to review everything carefully .* * A pplicable   only for Poland location align with local law regulations

descriptionByLocale.it: Über die Position Als Vorarbeiter in der GI Valves Fabrik in Turgi bzw. Seon übernimmst Du eine zentrale Rolle in der täglichen Produktionssteuerung. Du koordinierst operative Tätigkeiten innerhalb des Teams und sorgst dafür, dass Montage-, Prüf- und Logistikprozesse effizient, sicher und qualitätsgerecht ablaufen. Dabei bist Du die direkte Ansprechperson für die Mitarbeiter und arbeitest eng mit der Produktionsleitung und anderen Schnittstellen zusammen. Dein Einsatz trägt wesentlich dazu bei, dass wir unsere Produktionsziele erreichen und uns kontinuierlich verbessern. Neben koordinativen Tätigkeiten arbeitest Du aktiv im Montageprozess mit. Das kannst du bewirken Organisation und Überwachung der Produktionsabläufe (Montage, Prüfung, Logistik) Unterstützung des Teams sowohl fachlich als auch operativ Einhaltung von Sicherheits-, Qualitäts- und Umweltvorgaben Unterstützung bei der Einarbeitung neuer Mitarbeitender und Durchführung von Sicherheitsunterweisungen Zusammenarbeit mit Schnittstellen wie Planung, Qualität und Logistik sowie Dokumentation der Produktionsleistung Das bringst du mit Technische Berufsausbildung (z. B. descriptionByLocale.it: The Opportunity At Hitachi Energy, our purpose is advancing a sustainable energy future for all. We bring power to our homes, schools, hospitals, and factories. Join us and work with fantastic people, while learning and developing yourself on projects that have a real impact to our communities and society. Bring your passion, bring your energy, and be part of a global team that appreciates a simple truth: Diversity + Collaboration = Great Innovation. We are currently seeking a skilled and highly motivated candidate to join our CDSe (Common Design System Electrical) team as a CDSe Domain Expert for Liquid and Dry Transformers. The successful candidate will play a crucial role in the development and enhancement of the distribution transformer electrical design platform , ensuring it meets the highest standards of performance, reliability, and efficiency. How You'll Make An Impact Support CDSe development and maintenance by aligning with technical standards and technological advancements. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, design solutions, and implement new features. Prepare software specifications, collaborate with developers on implementation, and verify the accuracy of implemented features.Develop test cases to ensure the sustainable quality of the CDS platform and lead test sessions with end users. Conduct thorough testing and validation of the design platform to ensure accuracy and reliability.Perform comparative analysis of calculated and tested transformer parameters, identify root causes of discrepancies, and propose effective solutions. Provide technical support, prepare training materials, and deliver training sessions to end users.Monitor hotline requests and act on user feedback to improve the platform's performance.Work closely with Hub Engineering teams to accelerate CDS implementation in factories. Stay up to date with industry trends and emerging technologies and incorporate them into the platform. Be part of a multicultural, globally distributed CDS community and propose innovative solutions. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external & internal regulations, procedures & guidelines. Your Background Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field. Proven experience in the design of dry-type or liquid transformers. Strong knowledge of design principles, materials, manufacturing, and testing of transformers.Awareness of different transformer technologies. Experience in or interest in software development (e.g., macro development, Excel automation tools). Proactive, self-motivated, with a strong sense of ownership.Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills & Ability to work independently as well as within a multidisciplinary team. Strong communication skills, with good verbal and written English proficiency. More about us We pride ourselves on offering a holistic range of competitive benefit programs to support your financial, physical and mental wellbeing and personal development. We want you to truly thrive with us in work and out.
