descriptionByLocale.it: Über die Position Als Mitarbeiter Endprüfung bei Hitachi Energy bist du ein entscheidendes Bindeglied zwischen Produktion und Auslieferung. Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Produkte vor der Freigabe höchsten Qualitäts-, Sicherheits- und Dokumentationsanforderungen entsprechen. Mit deinem Qualitätsbewusstsein und deinem strukturierten Vorgehen trägst du maßgeblich zur Zuverlässigkeit unserer Produkte und zur Zufriedenheit unserer Kunden bei. Das kannst du bewirken Testen von Generatorleistungsschaltern im Prüffeld (80%): Prüfen der Generator Leistungsschalter gemäss vorgegebenem Prüfplan Bewertung der Messergebnisse Durchführung von Kundenabnahmen in Englischer Sprache Erkennen von mechanischen und elektrischen Fehlern Analyse und Korrektur von Verdrahtungsfehlern im Steuerschrank Übernahme der Verantwortung für das Prüfen der zugeteilten Schalter (zeitlicher Ablauf sowie Qualität der Prüfung) Mitarbeit bei der Verbesserung des Messequipments sowie der Prüfprozesse Montage- und Verdrahtungsarbeiten (20%): Selbstständige Verdrahtung von Baugruppen und Schaltersystemen gemäss Arbeitspapieren wie Kundenauftrag, Elektroschema, Checkliste und Arbeits­plan Montage von PGHV-Produkten entsprechend der in den Qualitätssicherungsverfahren und Arbeitsanweisungen festgehaltenen Vorgaben und Zielsetzungen Lesen und verstehen von technischen Zeichnungen und Stücklisten Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene elektrotechnische Grundausbildung (Automatiker EFZ, o.ä.) Erfahrung im lesen und verstehen von elektrischen Schemas, Montagezeichnungen und Arbeitsanweisungen Kenntnisse der Prüfung elektrischer Maschinen und von Steuerschränken sind von Vorteil Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mündlich, schriftlich) Affinität zu Computern (Messequipment, diverse Softwaretools, Dokumentation erstellen und pflegen) Gutes Verständnis für Arbeitssicherheit, hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein sowie kundenorientiertes Denken und professioneller Umgang mit Kunden Mehr über uns Hitachi Energy steht für innovative Technologien und nachhaltige Energielösungen weltweit. Bei uns erwartet dich ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen, spannende Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, ein kollegiales und wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld sowie attraktive Sozialleistungen.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Come Consigliere Legale, svolgerai un ruolo chiave nel nostro team legale fornendo un supporto legale completo a diverse unità aziendali e funzioni centrali. Come generalista si copre tutti i settori del contratto e del diritto commerciale, con un ulteriore focus sulla legge sugli appalti pubblici, R&D, diritto del lavoro e privacy dei dati.
• Le vostre responsabilità comprenderanno la gestione e l'esecuzione di tutti i tipi di contratti, la supervisione di potenziali controversie e la gestione di varie operazioni aziendali quotidiane. Se possiedi competenze legali raffinate, puoi affrontare questioni complesse all'interno di un contesto aziendale internazionale, e sei determinato, energico, e in grado di influenzare a tutti i livelli, ti invitiamo a unirti al nostro team! Come farete un impatto: Supporto legale completo per le Business Unit di Hitachi Energy e le Funzioni centrali in tutte le questioni legali nazionali e internazionali, in particolare nel campo del contratto e del diritto commerciale, con un ulteriore focus sugli appalti pubblici, R&D, Diritto del lavoro e Privacy Offrire consulenza legale mirata per sostenere obiettivi strategici chiave, salvaguardare la reputazione e gli interessi dell'azienda, e garantire il rispetto di leggi, regolamenti e politiche interne Il tuo background: Laurea magistrale in diritto, preferibilmente con ulteriori titoli acquisiti negli Stati Uniti o nel Regno Unito Ammissione al Bar in Svizzera Generalista legale con esperienza come consulente in-house o avvocato-at-law in contratto e diritto commerciale. Conoscenza in R&D, diritto del lavoro e privacy dei dati è un approccio più orientato al business e alla soluzione, ma la capacità di fornire consigli legali accurati e di alta qualità e un giudizio valido nello sviluppo e nell'attuazione di soluzioni legali Responsabilità e alto grado di responsabilità con la volontà di pensare “fuori dalla scatola” Capacità di lavorare sotto pressione e in un ambiente cross-funzionale e interculturale che sta cambiando e può essere sfidante I nostri team sono costituiti da persone provenienti da una vasta gamma di sfondi, esperienze e prospettive, lavorando insieme attraverso confini e discipline per plasmare un futuro energetico più sostenibile. Ci impegniamo a promuovere un ambiente inclusivo in cui tutti si sentono rispettati, valutati e abilitati a contribuire al meglio.
descriptionByLocale.en:
As Legal Counsel, you will play a key role in our legal team by providing comprehensive legal support to several Business Units and central Functions. As a generalist you cover all fields of contract and commercial law, with an additional focus on public procurement law, R&D, labour law, and data privacy.
• Your responsibilities will encompass the management and execution of all types of contracts, overseeing potential disputes, and handling various day-to-day business operations. If you possess refined legal skills, can tackle complex issues within an international corporate setting, and are determined, energetic, and capable of influencing at all levels, we invite you to join our team! How you will make an impact: Comprehensive legal support to Hitachi Energy's Business Units and central Functions in all domestic and international legal matters, in particular in the field of contract and commercial law, with an additional focus on public procurement, R&D, Labour Law, and Data Privacy Offer targeted legal advice to support key strategic goals, safeguard the company's reputation and interests, and ensure compliance with relevant laws, regulations and internal policies Communicate and work cross-functionally with other legal counsels, and your stakeholders namely in Sales, SCM, Research, and Management ﻿﻿Provide training to internal clients on relevant legal and contractual topics ﻿﻿Develop and implement standards, policies, and procedures related to your function Advise on the resolution of pre-litigation claims and disputes and handle complex commercial litigation mat-ters, including selecting, engaging, and managing outside counsel, and collaborating with Hitachi Energy local counsels Your background: Master's degree in law, preferably with additional qualifications acquired in the US or UK Admission to the Bar in Switzerland Legal generalist with experience as in-house counsel or attorney-at-law in contract and commercial law. Knowledge in R&D, Labour Law, and Data Privacy is a plus Business- and solution-driven approach with yet the ability to provide accurate, high-quality legal advice and a sound judgment in developing and implementing legal solutions Responsiveness and high degree of responsibility with the willingness to think “out of the box” Ability to work under pressure and in a cross-functional and cross-cultural environment that is changing and may be challenging Well-developed oral and written communication skills in German and English; French and Italian are an advantage More about us : At Hitachi Energy, we believe that diversity powers innovation and collaboration. Our teams are made up of individuals from a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, working together across borders and disciplines to shape a more sustainable energy future. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to contribute their best.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Als Legal Counsel spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle in unserem Rechtsteam, indem Sie mehrere Business Units und zentrale Funktionen umfassend legal unterstützen. Als Generalist erfassen Sie alle Bereiche des Vertrags- und Handelsrecht, mit einem zusätzlichen Fokus auf öffentliches Beschaffungsrecht, F&D, Arbeitsrecht und Datenschutz.
• Ihre Verantwortung umfasst die Verwaltung und Durchführung aller Arten von Verträgen, die Überwachung potenzieller Streitigkeiten und die Abwicklung verschiedener Tagesgeschäfte. Wenn Sie über verfeinerte juristische Fähigkeiten verfügen, komplexe Probleme in einem internationalen Unternehmensumfeld lösen können und entschlossen, energisch und in der Lage sind, auf allen Ebenen zu beeinflussen, laden wir Sie zu unserem Team ein! Wie Sie Auswirkungen haben: Umfassende rechtliche Unterstützung der Geschäftsbereiche von Hitachi Energy und zentrale Funktionen in allen nationalen und internationalen Rechtsfragen, insbesondere im Bereich des Vertrags- und Handelsrechts, mit einem zusätzlichen Fokus auf öffentliche Beschaffung, R&D, Arbeitsrecht und Datenschutzangebot gezielte rechtliche Beratung zur Unterstützung strategischer Ziele, die Wahrung des Rufs und der Interessen des Unternehmens und die Einhaltung relevanter Gesetze, Vorschriften und interner Richtlinien Ihr Hintergrund: Master-Abschluss im Recht, vorzugsweise mit zusätzlichen Qualifikationen erworben in den USA oder UK Zulassung zur Bar in der Schweiz Legal Generalist mit Erfahrung als hauseigene Beratung oder Anwalt-at-law im Vertrags- und Handelsrecht. Wissen in R&D, Arbeitsrecht und Datenschutz ist ein Plus Business-und Lösungs-orientierter Ansatz mit noch die Fähigkeit, eine genaue, qualitativ hochwertige Rechtsberatung und ein fundiertes Urteil in der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Rechtslösungen Reaktionsfähigkeit und hohe Verantwortung mit der Bereitschaft, "out of the box" Fähigkeit, unter Druck zu arbeiten und in einem funktions- und kulturübergreifenden Umfeld, das sich verändert und möglicherweise herausfordernd sein kann. Unsere Teams bestehen aus Individuen aus einer Vielzahl von Hintergründen, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven, die Zusammenarbeit über Grenzen und Disziplinen hinweg, um eine nachhaltigere Energie Zukunft zu gestalten. Wir sind verpflichtet, ein integratives Umfeld zu fördern, in dem jeder sich respektiert, geschätzt und befähigt fühlt, sein Bestes beizutragen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
En tant que conseiller juridique, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans notre équipe juridique en fournissant un soutien juridique complet à plusieurs unités commerciales et fonctions centrales. En tant que généraliste, vous couvrez tous les domaines du droit des contrats et du droit commercial, en mettant davantage l'accent sur le droit des marchés publics, la R-D, le droit du travail et la protection des données.
• Vos responsabilités comprendront la gestion et l'exécution de tous les types de contrats, la surveillance des différends potentiels et le traitement de diverses activités courantes. Si vous possédez des compétences juridiques raffinées, pouvez aborder des questions complexes au sein d'une entreprise internationale, et sont déterminés, énergiques et capables d'influencer à tous les niveaux, nous vous invitons à rejoindre notre équipe! Comment vous allez avoir un impact : Un soutien juridique complet aux unités d'affaires et aux fonctions centrales d'Hitachi Energy dans toutes les affaires juridiques nationales et internationales, en particulier dans le domaine du droit des contrats et du droit commercial, en mettant davantage l'accent sur les marchés publics, la R-D, le droit du travail et la protection des données. Offrir des conseils juridiques ciblés pour appuyer les principaux objectifs stratégiques, protéger la réputation et les intérêts de l'entreprise, et assurer le respect des lois, règlements et politiques internes pertinents. Communiquer et travailler de façon interfonctionnelle avec d'autres conseillers juridiques, et vos parties prenantes, notamment dans les domaines des ventes, de la MSC, de la recherche et de la gestion. Votre formation: Maîtrise en droit, de préférence avec des qualifications supplémentaires acquises aux États-Unis ou au Royaume-Uni Admission au barreau en Suisse Généraliste juridique ayant une expérience en tant qu'avocat ou avocat en droit contractuel et commercial. La connaissance en R-D, en droit du travail et en protection des données est une approche plus axée sur l'entreprise et la solution, avec pourtant la capacité de fournir des conseils juridiques précis et de haute qualité et un jugement solide dans l'élaboration et la mise en oeuvre de solutions juridiques. Réceptivité et haut degré de responsabilité avec la volonté de penser hors de l'encadré.Capacité de travailler sous pression et dans un environnement interfonctionnel et interculturel qui change et peut être difficile. Nos équipes sont composées de personnes issues d'un large éventail de milieux, d'expériences et de perspectives, travaillant ensemble au-delà des frontières et des disciplines pour façonner un avenir énergétique plus durable. Nous sommes déterminés à favoriser un environnement inclusif où chacun se sent respecté, valorisé et habilité à contribuer au mieux.

descriptionByLocale.it: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is seeking a Global Data, Analytics and Artificial Intelligence Manager for the Business Unit Transformers to join our team shaping the future of energy through digital innovation, data‑driven insights, and AI‑enabled solutions. In this role, you will drive data‑ and AI‑enabled value creation by converting business strategy into prioritized AI initiatives, ensuring measurable impact across operations, decision‑making, and innovation. This position offers the opportunity to grow your career within the newly established Digital Transformation Organization, collaborate with global stakeholders, and shape the future of Transformer solutions. How you will make an impact Shape the future of data, analytics, and AI by setting a clear strategic direction that drives meaningful business outcomes at scale. Turn real business challenges into AI opportunities that improve decisions, performance, and competitive advantage. Build and lead a high‑impact AI portfolio, taking ideas from early concepts to scaled solutions that create measurable value. Champion responsible and trusted AI by embedding strong governance, ethics, and data standards into everything delivered. Elevate data as a strategic asset by improving quality, consistency, and access to enable powerful insights and AI solutions. Lead diverse, cross‑functional teams to deliver AI initiatives that are practical, scalable, and business‑ready. Learn from results to continuously refine approaches, scale successes, and amplify business impact. Build strong partnerships with business and digital leaders to align priorities and accelerate AI adoption. Strengthen organizational capabilities through targeted learning, clear messaging, and a strong data‑driven mindset. Drive change with confidence by guiding stakeholders through transformation and ensuring responsible adoption of new solutions. Inspire, develop, and grow high‑performing Data, Analytics, and AI teams aligned behind a shared vision. Your background Master's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field. Relevant certifications (e.g., CAIP, advanced AI\/ML certifications) highly valued. Minimum 15+ years of experience in roles related to business process management or program implementation in the manufacturing industry. Effective communication skills with a proven ability to engage diverse stakeholders at all levels, fostering a collaborative environment to drive initiatives. Demonstrated competence in influencing and motivating teams to adopt new processes, reduce resistance, and achieve successful transitions to globally harmonized practices. Deep understanding of data, analytics, AI\/GenAI technologies, machine learning and analytics platforms. Strong analytical skills to tackle complex data and\/or AI challenges. Awareness of ethical considerations in AI development and deployment. Ability to bridge strategy, governance, and execution.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità The GPG Standardization Lead sarà responsabile della definizione e della guida della strategia di standardizzazione in tutto il Global Product Group (GPG). Il GPG Standardization Lead lavorerà a stretto contatto con diverse unità di business, team di ingegneria e dipartimenti della supply chain per garantire l'implementazione efficiente delle pratiche di standardizzazione, che sono fondamentali per migliorare la disponibilità dei materiali, accelerare i processi di approvvigionamento e sfruttare le economie di scala in un mercato in rapida crescita. Sviluppare e guidare una strategia di standardizzazione completa a livello GPG, in collaborazione con business unit (BU) e HUB regionali. Assicurarsi che la strategia si allinei con obiettivi organizzativi e richieste di mercato. Migliorare la standardizzazione delle parti, quantificare la standardizzazione e i costi associati. Definire i criteri per la standardizzazione e i criteri per la creazione di nuove parti in collaborazione con team di ingegneria e supply chain Sviluppare dashboard visivi per metriche di ingegneria come Value Stream Mapping (VSM), capacità, qualità, metriche Sviluppo di strumenti di ricerca, per migliorare il riutilizzo di parti e componenti esistenti; implementare la piattaforma di progettazione di funzionalità relative alla standardizzazione Creare e mantenere una libreria di specifiche e regole basata sui profili dei clienti per guidare la standardizzazione tra le fabbriche. Accetto su quali elementi da PLM (windchill) per connettersi a strumenti di progettazione. Stabilire metodi per quantificare, misurare e migliorare le pratiche di standardizzazione. Responsabile per garantire il rispetto delle normative, procedure e linee guida esterne e interne applicabili. Vivere i valori fondamentali di Hitachi Energy di sicurezza e integrità, il che significa assumersi la responsabilità per le proprie azioni, mentre la cura per i vostri colleghi e il business Il vostro background Bachelor \ / Master in Ingegneria è preferito. Minimo di 5 anni di esperienza in ingegneria con un focus sulla standardizzazione. Provato record di traccia nello sviluppo e nell'implementazione di strategie di standardizzazione. Forte comprensione dei processi di approvvigionamento e della gestione dei materiali. Esperienza con dashboard di ingegneria e metriche. Ottima capacità di comunicazione e collaborazione per lavorare con team interfunzionali. Forte capacità analitiche e di problem solving. Il pensiero strategico e la pianificazione. Familiarità con il software PLM (PTC Windchill è preferito) La competenza nei principi e nelle pratiche di standardizzazione. Conoscenza della mappatura del flusso di valore (VSM) e altre metriche di ingegneria. Familiarità con GMR\/Windchill e altri strumenti di progettazione. Forte capacità organizzative e di gestione del progetto. È richiesta la competenza in lingua inglese parlata e scritta
descriptionByLocale.en: The opportunity The GPG Standardization Lead will be responsible for defining and driving the standardization strategy across the Global Product Group (GPG). The GPG Standardization Lead will work closely with various business units, engineering teams, and supply chain departments to ensure the efficient implementation of standardization practices, which are critical to enhancing material availability, speeding up procurement processes, and leveraging economies of scale in a rapidly growing market. How you'll make an impact Develop and drive a comprehensive standardization strategy at the GPG level, in collaboration with business unit (BU) and regional HUBs. Ensure the strategy aligns with organizational goals and market demands. Enhance the standardization of parts by quantifying standardization and associated costs. Define criteria for standardization and criteria for new part creation in collaboration with engineering and supply chain teams Develop visual dashboards for engineering metrics such as Value Stream Mapping (VSM), capacity, quality, metrics Drive development of search tools, to improve reuse of existing parts and components; drive implementation in design platform of features related to standardization Create and maintain a specification and rules library based on customer profiles to drive standardization among factories. Agree on which items from PLM (windchill) to connect to design tools. Establish methods for quantifying, measuring, and improving standardization practices. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business Your background Bachelor's \/ Master's degree in Engineering is preferred. Minimum of 5 years of experience in engineering with a focus on standardization. Proven track record in developing and implementing standardization strategies. Strong understanding of procurement processes and material management. Experience with engineering dashboards and metrics. Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Strategic thinking and planning. Familiarity with PLM software (PTC Windchill is preferred) Proficiency in standardization principles and practices. Knowledge of Value Stream Mapping (VSM) and other engineering metrics. Familiarity with GMR\/Windchill and other design tools. Strong organizational and project management skills. Proficiency in both spoken & written English language is required
descriptionByLocale.de: Die Möglichkeit Die GPG-Standardisierung Lead wird für die Definition und Steuerung der Standardisierungsstrategie in der Global Product Group (GPG) verantwortlich sein. Der GPG Standardization Lead wird eng mit verschiedenen Geschäftsbereichen, Ingenieurteams und Supply Chain Abteilungen zusammenarbeiten, um die effiziente Umsetzung von Standardisierungspraktiken zu gewährleisten, die für die Verbesserung der Materialverfügbarkeit, die Beschleunigung der Beschaffungsprozesse und die Nutzung von Skaleneffekten in einem schnell wachsenden Markt entscheidend sind. Wie Sie eine Wirkung entfalten und eine umfassende Standardisierungsstrategie auf der GPG-Ebene in Zusammenarbeit mit Business Unit (BU) und regionalen HUBs vorantreiben. Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Strategie auf organisatorische Ziele und Marktanforderungen ausgerichtet ist. Verbessern Sie die Standardisierung von Teilen durch Quantifizierung von Standardisierung und damit verbundenen Kosten. Definieren Sie Kriterien für die Standardisierung und Kriterien für die Neugründung in Zusammenarbeit mit Ingenieur- und Lieferkettenteams Entwickeln Sie visuelle Dashboards für Engineering Metriken wie Value Stream Mapping (VSM), Kapazität, Qualität, Metriken Die Entwicklung von Suchwerkzeugen, die Wiederverwendung bestehender Teile und Komponenten zu verbessern; die Umsetzung in der Designplattform von Features im Zusammenhang mit Standardisierung Erstellen und Aufrechterhaltung einer Spezifikations- und Regeln-Bibliothek basierend auf Kundenprofilen, um die Standardisierung unter den Fabriken zu steuern Geben Sie an, auf welchen Artikeln von PLM (windchill) zur Verbindung mit Design-Tools stehen. Methoden zur Quantifizierung, Messung und Verbesserung der Standardisierungspraktiken. Verantwortlich für die Einhaltung geltender externer und interner Vorschriften, Verfahren und Richtlinien. Living Hitachi Energy's Kernwerte von Sicherheit und Integrität, was bedeutet, Verantwortung für Ihre eigenen Aktionen zu übernehmen, während Pflege für Ihre Kollegen und das Geschäft Ihr Hintergrund Bachelor \ / Master-Abschluss in Engineering ist bevorzugt. Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Ingenieurwesen mit Schwerpunkt Standardisierung. Erprobter Erfolg bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Standardisierungsstrategien. Starkes Verständnis von Beschaffungsprozessen und Materialmanagement. Erfahrung mit Engineering Dashboards und Metriken. Ausgezeichnete Kommunikations- und Kollaborationsfähigkeiten, um mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zu arbeiten. Starke analytische und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten. Strategisches Denken und Planen. Vertraulichkeit mit PLM-Software (PTC Windchill ist bevorzugt) Vorteile bei Normungsprinzipien und -praktiken. Wissen über Value Stream Mapping (VSM) und andere Engineering Metriken. Vertraut mit GMR\/Windchill und anderen Design-Tools. Starke organisatorische und Projektmanagementfähigkeiten. Kenntnisse in gesprochener und geschriebener englischer Sprache sind erforderlich
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'occasion Le responsable de la normalisation des GPG sera chargé de définir et de piloter la stratégie de normalisation dans l'ensemble du Groupe mondial des produits (GPG). Le responsable de la normalisation des GPG travaillera en étroite collaboration avec diverses unités opérationnelles, les équipes d'ingénierie et les départements de la chaîne d'approvisionnement pour assurer la mise en oeuvre efficace des pratiques de normalisation, qui sont essentielles pour améliorer la disponibilité des matériaux, accélérer les processus d'approvisionnement et tirer parti des économies d'échelle dans un marché en croissance rapide. Comment vous aurez un impact Élaborer et piloter une stratégie de normalisation globale au niveau des GPG, en collaboration avec les unités d'affaires (BU) et les HUB régionaux. Veiller à ce que la stratégie soit conforme aux objectifs organisationnels et aux exigences du marché. Améliorer la normalisation des pièces en quantifiant la normalisation et les coûts connexes. Définir des critères de normalisation et des critères pour la création de nouvelles pièces en collaboration avec les équipes de l'ingénierie et de la chaîne d'approvisionnement Élaborer des tableaux de bord visuels pour les mesures d'ingénierie telles que la cartographie du flux de valeur (VSM), la capacité, la qualité, les mesures Conduire le développement d'outils de recherche, pour améliorer la réutilisation des pièces et composants existants; Conduire la mise en oeuvre dans la plate-forme de conception de caractéristiques liées à la normalisation Créer et maintenir une bibliothèque de spécifications et de règles basée sur les profils de clients pour conduire la normalisation entre les usines. D'accord sur les éléments de PLM (windchill) à connecter aux outils de conception. Établir des méthodes pour quantifier, mesurer et améliorer les pratiques de normalisation. Responsabilité de veiller au respect des règlements, procédures et lignes directrices externes et internes applicables. Vivre les valeurs fondamentales de Hitachi Energy en matière de sécurité et d'intégrité, ce qui signifie prendre la responsabilité de vos propres actions tout en prenant soin de vos collègues et de l'entreprise. Au moins 5 ans d'expérience en ingénierie avec un accent sur la normalisation. Expérience éprouvée dans l'élaboration et la mise en oeuvre de stratégies de normalisation. Une bonne compréhension des processus d'approvisionnement et de la gestion du matériel. Expérience des tableaux de bord et des mesures techniques. Excellentes compétences en communication et collaboration pour travailler avec des équipes interfonctionnelles. Forte capacité d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes. Pensée stratégique et planification. Familiarité avec le logiciel PLM (PTC Windchill est préféré) Compétence en principes et pratiques de normalisation. Connaissance de la cartographie du flux de valeur (VSM) et d'autres paramètres techniques. Familiarité avec GMR\/Windchill et d'autres outils de conception. Fortes compétences en gestion organisationnelle et de projet. Une compétence en anglais parlé et écrit est requise

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'OPPORTUNITÀ
• Stiamo cercando un Business Development & Sales Enablement Manager lungimirante per PCS (Power Conversion Systems) per accelerare la nostra crescita in tutto il mercato europeo. In questo ruolo strategico, collegherai i nostri team di vendita GPG, i responsabili del mercato regionale e l'organizzazione delle vendite front-end (FES), garantendo il pieno allineamento sulla nostra strategia Go-to-Market e rafforzando al contempo la nostra impronta commerciale. Se sei appassionato di guidare l'espansione del mercato, abilitare team di vendita ad alte prestazioni e costruire un solido ecosistema di partner per soluzioni innovative di conversione di potenza, questo ruolo ti offre l'opportunità di avere un impatto significativo in tutta Europa. Come avere un impatto Guidare ed eseguire la strategia Go‑to‑Market per i PC in tutta Europa Allineare le priorità tra GPG, Market Manager HUB e FES per garantire un approccio commerciale unificato Tradurre le tendenze di mercato e le intuizioni competitive in strategie commerciali attuabili Agire come connettore centrale tra i team di vendita e abilitarli con esperienza di prodotto e strumenti di vendita di valore Generare lead qualificati ed espandere la pipeline dei PC attraverso campagne e coinvolgimento dei partner Identificare, integrare e consentire ai partner ad alto potenziale di scalare le soluzioni dei PC in tutta Europa Controllare la gestione della pipeline, l'accuratezza delle previsioni e le revisioni mensili delle prestazioni Fornire approfondimenti commerciali basati sui dati per supportare il processodecisionale strategico a livello di leadership GPG Il tuo background Comprovato track record in Business
descriptionByLocale.en: The opportunity We are looking for a forward‑thinking Business Development & Sales Enablement Manager for PCS (Power Conversion Systems) to accelerate our growth across the European market. In this strategic role, you will connect our GPG sales teams, Regional Market Managers, and Front‑End Sales (FES) organization - ensuring full alignment on our Go‑to‑Market strategy while strengthening our commercial footprint. If you are passionate about driving market expansion, enabling high‑performing sales teams, and building a strong partner ecosystem for innovative power conversion solutions, this role offers you the opportunity to make a significant impact across Europe. How you'll make an impact Lead and execute the Go‑to‑Market strategy for PCS across Europe Align priorities across GPG, HUB Market Managers, and FES to ensure a unified commercial approach Translate market trends and competitive insights into actionable commercial strategies Act as the central connector across sales teams and enable them with product expertise and value‑selling tools Generate qualified leads and expand the PCS pipeline through campaigns and partner engagement Identify, onboard, and enable high‑potential partners to scale PCS solutions across Europe Oversee pipeline management, forecasting accuracy, and monthly performance reviews Provide data‑driven commercial insights to support strategic decision‑making at GPG leadership level Your background Proven track record in Business Development, Sales Enablement, or Commercial Management, ideally in a technical or industrial environment Strong understanding of Go‑to‑Market models, channel\/partner ecosystems, and value‑based selling Experienced in building relationships with cross‑functional teams and external stakeholders Confident in market analysis, sales forecasting, and managing complex commercial pipelines Fluent in English; additional European languages are an advantage A strategic thinker with hands‑on execution capability and a strong sense of ownership Customer‑centric mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast‑moving, international environment More about us We pride ourselves on offering a holistic range of competitive benefits to support your financial, physical and mental wellbeing and personal development. We want you to truly thrive with us, in work and out.
descriptionByLocale.de: Die Gelegenheit Wir suchen einen zukunftsorientierten Business Development & Sales Enablement Manager für PCS (Power Conversion Systems), um unser Wachstum auf dem europäischen Markt zu beschleunigen. In dieser strategischen Rolle verbinden Sie unsere GPG-Vertriebsteams, regionalen Marktmanager und die Front-End-Vertriebsorganisation (FES) und stellen so eine vollständige Ausrichtung auf unsere Markteinführungsstrategie sicher und stärken gleichzeitig unsere kommerzielle Präsenz. Wenn Sie leidenschaftlich daran interessiert sind, die Marktexpansion voranzutreiben, leistungsstarke Vertriebsteams zu unterstützen und ein starkes Partner-Ökosystem für innovative Energieumwandlungslösungen aufzubauen, bietet Ihnen diese Rolle die Möglichkeit, einen erheblichen Einfluss in ganz Europa zu nehmen. Wie Sie eine Wirkung erzielen Führen und die Markteinführungsstrategie für PCS in ganz Europa umsetzen Richten Sie Prioritäten für GPG, HUB Market Manager und FES aus, um einen einheitlichen kommerziellen Ansatz zu gewährleisten Übersetzen Sie Markttrends und Wettbewerbseinblicke in umsetzbare kommerzielle Strategien Handeln Sie als zentraler Konnektor für Vertriebsteams und ermöglichen Sie ihnen mit Produktkompetenz und Value-Selling-Tools Generieren Sie qualifizierte Leads und erweitern Sie die PCS-Pipeline durch Kampagnen und Partner-Engagement Identifizieren, integrieren und ermöglichen Sie potenziellen Partnern, PCs-Lösungen in ganz Europa zu skalieren Überwachen Sie das Pipeline-Management, die Prognosegenauigkeit und die monatlichen Leistungsüberprüfungen Stellen Sie datengesteuerte kommerzielle Erkenntnisse bereit, um strategische Entscheidungen auf GPG-Führungsebene zu unterstützen Ihr Hintergrund Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz im Geschäft
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Nous sommes à la recherche d'un Business Development & Sales Activement Manager pour PCS (Power Conversion Systems) pour accélérer notre croissance sur le marché européen. Dans ce rôle stratégique, vous connecterez nos équipes de vente GPG, les gestionnaires régionaux du marché et l'organisation des ventes de première ligne (FES) afin de s'aligner pleinement sur notre stratégie Go‐to‐Market tout en renforçant notre empreinte commerciale. Si vous êtes passionné par l'expansion du marché, la création d'équipes de vente performantes et la construction d'un écosystème partenaire solide pour des solutions innovantes de conversion de puissance, ce rôle vous offre l'occasion d'avoir un impact significatif dans toute l'Europe. Comment vous ferez un impact Dirigez et exécutez la stratégie Go-to-Market pour les SCP en Europe Alignez les priorités à l'échelle de GPG, HUB Market Managers et FES pour assurer une approche commerciale unifiée Traduire les tendances du marché et les perspectives concurrentielles en stratégies commerciales réalisables Agir en tant que connecteur central à l'échelle des équipes de vente et leur permettre d'avoir une expertise produit et des outils de vente de valeur Générer des pistes qualifiées et élargir le pipeline PCS par le biais de campagnes et de l'engagement des partenaires Identifier, à bord, et permettre aux partenaires à haut potentiel d'évaluer les solutions PCS à l'échelle de l'Europe Superviser la gestion des pipelines, la prévision de l'exactitude et les évaluations mensuelles des performances Fournir des informations commerciales fondées sur les données pour appuyer la prise de décisions stratégiques au niveau des GPG Votre contexte Expérience éprouvée en matière d'analyse des marchés, de prévision des ventes et de gestion commerciale, idéalement dans un environnement technique ou industriel Une bonne compréhension des modèles Go-to-Market, des écosystèmes de canaux/partenaires et des ventes fondées sur la valeur Expérience de l'établissement de relations avec des équipes Nous voulons que vous prospérez vraiment avec nous, dans le travail et dehors.

descriptionByLocale.it: The Opportunity As the Operating Unit Manager for Substation Automation Systems HUB Europe, you will play a pivotal leadership role in shaping the strategic direction, performance, and growth of our Substation Automation portfolio across the region. You will oversee all commercial, operational, and technical aspects of the HUB, ensuring excellence in project execution, customer satisfaction, and business results. This role reports to the HUB Leader and collaborates closely with global Product Management, R&D, and cross‑regional teams. Location is flexible within Europe and will be confirmed during later stages. This role requires frequent travel within Europe and occasional international travel. How You'll Make an Impact Drive Strategic Direction & Business Growth: Develop and execute the HUB's strategy in alignment with global objectives. Identify market opportunities, expand customer relationships, and grow sales in substation automation solutions including protection relays, SCADA, control systems, and communication technologies. Lead Operational Excellence: Oversee engineering, project delivery, sales support, and service execution. Define and track KPIs to secure efficient operations, on‑time delivery, customer satisfaction, and strong financial performance. Strengthen Customer & Market Presence: Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, partners, and stakeholders across Europe. Represent Hitachi Energy as a subject matter expert at industry forums and customer engagements. Ensure Financial Performance: Manage budgets, forecasts, and resource allocation to achieve revenue, margin, and profitability targets. Identify improvement opportunities to enhance efficiency and reduce cost. Advance Technical Expertise & Innovation: Stay at the forefront of substation automation technologies, industry trends, competitor movements, and regulatory changes. Promote innovation and technology adoption across the HUB. Champion Quality, Safety & Compliance: Ensure operations comply with internal policies, industry standards, and European regulations. Promote a strong safety and quality culture across all teams and activities. Collaborate Across Functions: Partner with global product management, R&D, and other regional business units to share best practices, align strategies, and maximize value from the full Hitachi Energy portfolio. Lead & Develop High‑Performing Teams: Recruit, mentor, and empower a strong team of engineers, project managers, and commercial professionals. Foster a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and operational excellence. Your Background Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related field; a Master's degree or MBA is an advantage. 10–15 years of experience in the power transmission and distribution industry, with deep expertise in substation automation systems, of which 5–7 years in a leadership role managing a business unit, department, or similar organization within a multinational environment. Strong technical knowledge across substation automation architectures, protective relaying, SCADA, control systems, IEC 61850, and cybersecurity for critical infrastructure. Proven success in business strategy execution, P&L management, contract negotiation, and complex project delivery and strong understanding of the European energy market, customer landscape, and regulatory environment. Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder‑management skills with the ability to influence across a matrix environment. Fluency in English is required; additional European languages are an asset.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione L'occasione The Grid Automation Business Unit di Hitachi Energy è alla ricerca di un Global IT Leader dinamico per il ruolo di Global BST Manager, Grid Automation, per guidare un team esistente di oltre quaranta professionisti IT nel sostenere e promuovere le attività globali di Grid Automation e le iniziative di trasformazione IT digitale. Business Solution Teams (BSTs) in ogni Business Unit (BU) hanno la completa responsabilità per la gestione delle applicazioni specifiche BU e dei servizi di infrastruttura, compresa la consegna dei servizi. Essi supervisionano e controllano queste applicazioni e servizi, rispettando gli standard di governance e sicurezza globali. BST progetta e implementa la Roadmap IT e Application Landscape per i rispettivi BU per allineare con i requisiti aziendali. Collaborano strettamente con i dipartimenti globali per aiutare a fornire applicazioni e piattaforme aziendali a livello di funzionalità. Mansioni - Gestione delle relazioni aziendali con i BU, tra cui Leadership BST e guida attraverso BU/HUB/GPG/Functions. - Lead IT Demand Mgt per soddisfare i requisiti aziendali. - Gestione e governance dell'organizzazione BST IT per sostenere e fornire le priorità della domanda. - Contabile per la gestione delle applicazioni per applicazioni specifiche BU, Infrastructure/ Onsite Service Delivery Operational Management dei Siti assegnati BST. - Supporto IT/OT Cybersecurity Insite Service Delivery Gestione Operativa dei Siti assegnati BST. - Digital Transformation IT Build Deployments per sostenere la crescita del business. - Contabile per l'offerta IT totale al business e fornire l'interfaccia ai partner IT rilevanti, articolando le esigenze del business ai partner IT rilevanti per garantire un supporto efficace al business. - Assicurare l'allineamento della roadmap IT alle esigenze aziendali attraverso la comunicazione e i loop di feedback attivi tra gli stakeholder e l'organizzazione IT. - Definire e implementare le priorità IT strategiche nell'organizzazione in linea con le iniziative di strategia BU e Strategic Business, coprendo il panorama delle applicazioni delle funzioni aziendali, utilizzando il portafoglio soluzioni IT esistente o garantendo nuove soluzioni, se del caso. - Comprendere le esigenze aziendali, la strategia aziendale attuale e a lungo termine e tradurli in opportunità per l'IT per aggiungere valore al business. - Implementare e garantire il rispetto di standard globali e locali, strumenti, processi relativi all'esecuzione di operazioni/progetti. - Analizzare i risultati degli audit interni ed esterni e identificare le aree comuni di miglioramento all'interno dell'organizzazione. - Fornire il punto di escalation BU per tutti i problemi relativi all'IT. - Responsabile del bilancio BST e degli investimenti e della trasparenza dei costi dell'unità aziendale IT. - Impostare la documentazione standard per gli audit e i loro record, risultati e report. - Sviluppare e condividere le migliori pratiche nella comunità BST. - Promuovere la comunicazione tra BU e l'organizzazione IT. - Assicurare (con il supporto HR) che l'area di responsabilità sia adeguatamente organizzata, personale, qualificata e diretta. - Guide, motiva e sviluppa subalterni diretti e indiretti all'interno delle politiche HR, a beneficio sia dell'azienda che del dipendente.
• Requisiti - Minimo 15+ anni di esperienza professionale in IT. - 10+ anni di esperienza lavorando in organizzazioni globali e diverse con la comprensione di Infrastrutture, Applicazioni e piattaforme. - È richiesto un diploma di laurea; un master è preferito. - Forte capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale. - Altamente organizzato con attenzione ai dettagli. - E' stato un successo a lavorare in organizzazioni matrici. - Capacità di condurre con successo squadre remote in più fusi orari Chi siamo Hitachi Energy è un leader tecnologico globale che sta promuovendo un futuro energetico sostenibile per tutti. Serviamo i clienti nei settori dell'utilità, dell'industria e delle infrastrutture con soluzioni e servizi innovativi in tutta la catena del valore. Insieme a clienti e partner, pionieri delle tecnologie e consentiamo la trasformazione digitale necessaria per accelerare la transizione energetica verso
descriptionByLocale.en:
## Descrizione The opportunity The Grid Automation Business Unit of Hitachi Energy is seeking a dynamic Global IT Leader for the role of Global BST Manager, Grid Automation, to lead an existing team of over forty IT Professionals in supporting and advancing Grid Automation's global businesses and digital IT transformation initiatives. Business Solution Teams (BSTs) in each Business Unit (BU) have complete responsibility for managing BU-specific applications and Infrastructure services, including service delivery. They oversee and control these applications and services while adhering to global governance and security standards. BSTs design and implement the IT Roadmap and Application Landscape for their respective BUs to align with business requirements. They closely collaborate with global departments to help deliver function-wide applications and enterprise platforms. ## Mansioni - Lead Business relationship management with BUs including BST Leadership and guidance across BU/HUB/GPG/Functions. - Lead IT Demand Mgt to meet Business requirements. - Management and governance of the BST IT organization to support and deliver on Demand priorities. - Accountable for Application Management for BU specific applications, Infrastructure/ Onsite Service Delivery Operational Management of BST assigned Sites. - Support IT/OT Cybersecurity Onsite Service Delivery Operational Management of BST assigned Sites. - Digital Transformation IT Build Deployments to support growth of business. - Accountable for the total IT offering to the business and provide interface to relevant IT partners, articulating the needs of the business to the relevant IT partners to ensure impactful support to the business. - Ensure alignment of IT roadmap to business needs through communication and active feedback loops between stakeholders and IT organization. - Define and implement strategic IT priorities in the organization in line with BU strategy and Strategic Business initiatives, covering business functions application landscape, utilizing the existing IT solutions portfolio or ensuring to provide new solutions, where appropriate. - Understand the business demands, the current and long-term business strategy and translate them into opportunities for IT to add value to the business. - Implement and ensure compliance with global and local standards, tools, processes related to operations/projects execution. - Analyze results of internal and external audits and identify common areas of improvement within the organization. - Provide the BU escalation point for all IT related issues. - Responsible for BST budget and investments and creating transparency on business unit IT costs. - Setting standard documentation for audits and their records, findings and reports. - Develop and share best practices across BST community. - Foster communication between BU and IT organization. - Ensure (with HR support) that the area of responsibility is properly organized, staffed, skilled and directed. - Guides, motivates and develops direct and indirect subordinates within HR policies, for the benefit of both company and the employee. ##
• Requisiti - Minimum 15+ years of professional working experience in IT. - 10+ years' experience working in global and diverse organizations with understanding of Infrastructure, Applications and platforms. - A bachelor's degree is required; a master's degree is preferred. - Strong written and verbal communication skills. - Highly organized with attention to detail. - Proven success working in matrixed organizations. - Capable of successfully leading remote teams across multiple time zones ## Chi siamo Hitachi Energy is a global technology leader that is advancing a sustainable energy future for all. We serve customers in the utility, industry and infrastructure sectors with innovative solutions and services across the value chain. Together with customers and partners, we pioneer technologies and enable the digital transformation required to accelerate the energy transition toward
descriptionByLocale.de: Beschreibung Die Gelegenheit Die Grid Automation Business Unit von Hitachi Energy sucht einen dynamischen Global IT Leader für die Rolle von Global BST Manager, Grid Automation, um ein bestehendes Team von über vierzig IT-Experten bei der Unterstützung und Weiterentwicklung von Grid Automations globalen Unternehmen und digitalen IT-Transformationsinitiativen zu leiten. Business Solution Teams (BSTs) in jeder Business Unit (BU) haben die volle Verantwortung für die Verwaltung von BU-spezifischen Anwendungen und Infrastrukturdienstleistungen, einschließlich Service-Lieferung. Sie überwachen und kontrollieren diese Anwendungen und Dienstleistungen und haften dabei an globalen Governance- und Sicherheitsstandards. BSTs entwerfen und implementieren die IT Roadmap und Application Landscape für ihre jeweiligen BUs, um sich an die Geschäftsanforderungen anzupassen. Sie arbeiten eng mit globalen Abteilungen zusammen, um funktionsweite Anwendungen und Unternehmensplattformen zu liefern. Mansion - Führen Sie Business-Beziehungsmanagement mit BUs einschließlich BST Führung und Beratung über BU/HUB/GPG/Funktionen. - Führen Sie die IT-Anforderung Mgt, um die Geschäftsanforderungen zu erfüllen. - Management und Governance der BST IT-Organisation, um die Prioritäten der Nachfrage zu unterstützen und zu liefern. - Buchbar für Application Management für BU-spezifische Anwendungen, Infrastruktur / Vor-Ort-Service-Lieferung Betriebliches Management von BST zugewiesenen Websites. - Unterstützung von IT/OT Cybersecurity Onsite Service Delivery Operational Management von BST zugewiesenen Websites. - Digitale Transformation IT-Erstellung zur Unterstützung des Unternehmenswachstums. - Buchbar für das gesamte IT-Angebot für das Unternehmen und bieten Schnittstelle zu relevanten IT-Partnern und artikulieren die Bedürfnisse des Unternehmens an die relevanten IT-Partner, um eine wirkungsvolle Unterstützung für das Unternehmen zu gewährleisten. - Stellen Sie die Ausrichtung der IT-Roadmap auf die geschäftlichen Bedürfnisse durch Kommunikation und aktive Feedback-Schleifen zwischen Stakeholdern und IT-Organisation sicher. - Definieren und implementieren Sie strategische IT-Prioritäten in der Organisation im Einklang mit BU-Strategie und Strategischen Business-Initiativen, die Business-Funktionen Anwendungslandschaft abdecken, das bestehende IT-Lösungen-Portfolio nutzen oder gegebenenfalls neue Lösungen bereitstellen. - Verstehen Sie die Geschäftsanforderungen, die aktuelle und langfristige Geschäftsstrategie und übersetzen Sie sie in Möglichkeiten für IT, um Mehrwert für das Unternehmen zu schaffen. - Umsetzung und Sicherstellung der Einhaltung globaler und lokaler Standards, Werkzeuge, Prozesse im Zusammenhang mit der Ausführung von Operationen/Projekten. - Analyse der Ergebnisse interner und externer Audits und Identifizierung gemeinsamer Verbesserungsbereiche innerhalb der Organisation. - Geben Sie den BU-Eskalationspunkt für alle IT-relevanten Fragen. - Verantwortlich für den BST-Haushalt und Investitionen und die Schaffung von Transparenz auf den IT-Kosten der Geschäftseinheit. - Standarddokumentation für Audits und deren Aufzeichnungen, Ergebnisse und Berichte. - Entwickeln und teilen Sie Best Practices in der BST-Community. - Foster Kommunikation zwischen BU und IT-Organisation. - Stellen Sie sicher (mit HR-Unterstützung), dass der Zuständigkeitsbereich ordnungsgemäß organisiert, bedienstet, qualifiziert und geleitet ist. - Guides, motiviert und entwickelt direkte und indirekte Untergeben innerhalb der HR-Politik, zum Nutzen von Unternehmen und Arbeitnehmer. Voraussetzungen - Mindestens 15 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der IT. - 10 Jahre Erfahrung in der Arbeit in globalen und vielfältigen Organisationen mit dem Verständnis von Infrastruktur, Anwendungen und Plattformen. - Ein Bachelor-Abschluss ist erforderlich; ein Master-Abschluss ist bevorzugt. - Starke schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. - Hoch organisiert mit Liebe zum Detail. - Bewiesener Erfolg in Matrix-Organisationen. - Erfasst erfolgreich führende Remote-Teams in mehreren Zeitzonen Chi siamo Hitachi Energy ist ein globaler Technologieführer, der für alle eine nachhaltige Energie Zukunft vorantreibt. Wir bedienen Kunden in den Bereichen Energieversorgung, Industrie und Infrastruktur mit innovativen Lösungen und Dienstleistungen in der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette. Gemeinsam mit Kunden und Partnern sind wir Pioniertechnologien und ermöglichen die digitale Transformation, die erforderlich ist, um den Energiewandel in Richtung
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Descrizione L'occasion La Grid Automation Business Unit de Hitachi Energy cherche un leader informatique mondial dynamique pour le rôle de Global BST Manager, Grid Automation, pour diriger une équipe existante de plus de quarante professionnels de l'informatique dans le soutien et la progression des entreprises mondiales de Grid Automation et des initiatives de transformation informatique numérique. Les équipes de solutions d'affaires (ETB) de chaque unité opérationnelle (UB) sont entièrement responsables de la gestion des applications spécifiques à l'UB et des services d'infrastructure, y compris la prestation des services. Ils supervisent et contrôlent ces applications et services tout en respectant les normes mondiales de gouvernance et de sécurité. Les BST conçoivent et mettent en œuvre la feuille de route informatique et le paysage d'application pour leurs UB respectives afin de les aligner sur les exigences opérationnelles. Ils collaborent étroitement avec les départements mondiaux pour fournir des applications à l'échelle de la fonction et des plateformes d'entreprise. Mansioni - Diriger la gestion des relations d'affaires avec les BU, y compris le leadership et l'orientation en matière de BU/HUB/GPG/Functions. - Diriger la demande de TI pour répondre aux exigences de l'entreprise. - La gestion et la gouvernance de l'organisation IT de la BST pour appuyer et réaliser les priorités de la demande. - Responsable de la gestion des applications pour des applications spécifiques à l'UB, Infrastructure/ Prestation de services sur place Gestion opérationnelle des sites assignés à la TVB. - Soutenir la cybersécurité informatique/OT sur place Prestation des services Gestion opérationnelle des sites assignés à la TVB. - Transformation numérique Construction des TI Déploiements pour soutenir la croissance des entreprises. - Responsable de l'offre totale de TI à l'entreprise et fournit une interface aux partenaires informatiques concernés, articulant les besoins de l'entreprise aux partenaires informatiques concernés pour assurer un soutien efficace à l'entreprise. - Veiller à ce que la feuille de route de la TI soit alignée sur les besoins opérationnels au moyen de communications et de boucles de rétroaction actives entre les intervenants et l'organisation de la TI. - Définir et mettre en œuvre les priorités stratégiques en matière de TI dans l'organisation, conformément à la stratégie de l'UB et aux initiatives stratégiques en matière d'affaires, couvrant le paysage des applications des fonctions opérationnelles, en utilisant le portefeuille de solutions informatiques existant ou en veillant à fournir de nouvelles solutions, le cas échéant. - Comprendre les exigences de l'entreprise, la stratégie d'affaires actuelle et à long terme et les traduire en opportunités pour que l'informatique ajoute de la valeur à l'entreprise. - Mettre en œuvre et assurer le respect des normes, outils et processus mondiaux et locaux relatifs à l'exécution des opérations/projets. - Analyser les résultats des audits internes et externes et identifier les domaines communs d'amélioration au sein de l'organisation. - Fournir le point d'escalade BU pour toutes les questions liées aux TI. - Élaborer et partager des pratiques exemplaires dans la collectivité de la TVB. - Favoriser la communication entre BU et l'organisation informatique. - Veiller (avec le soutien des RH) à ce que le domaine de responsabilité soit bien organisé, doté de personnel, qualifié et dirigé. - Guider, motiver et développer des subordonnés directs et indirects dans le cadre des politiques RH, au profit de l'entreprise et de l'employé.

descriptionByLocale.it: The opportunity Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) are emerging as critical infrastructure for modern data centers, particularly AI facilities, by providing high efficiency (up to 98.5%), compact, and intelligent power management. Unlike conventional transformers, SSTs utilize power electronics to convert medium-voltage grid power directly to 800V DC, significantly reducing footprint, increasing efficiency, and easing grid interconnection. Join us as a Global Product Specialist – Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of data center supply infrastructure, guiding both Hitachi Energy and clients toward smarter, greener, and more resilient operations. If you combine a solid understanding of relevant technologies with insight into customer value drivers—and can translate customer needs into actionable requirements that keep our solutions both innovative and aligned with client expectations—then this role is an excellent fit for you. How you´ll make an impact Conduct market evaluations, competitor analyses, and identify gaps in product, solutions, and services, while assessing Hitachi Energy's positioning Gather and analyze global standards, market requirements, customer needs, and values to contribute to the product roadmap Support the Global Product Manager in creating business cases for product, solutions, and service development projects Support global and local marketing teams in creating market communication materials, including assistance with new product launches Provide sales support, participate in customer meetings, and attend trade shows as required, ensuring the availability of appropriate training materials for internal and external use Drive technical solutions across Hitachi Energy's global footprint, following an annual cycle of activities to govern Global Product Management Your background Bachelor's degree in engineering, along with 10+ years of related experience preferred Prior experience in Product Management or Product Ownership within data centre domain, and knowledge of Solid-State Transformer (SST) technology Possess a technical mindset to serve as a technical expert, instilling customer confidence in the product and contributing to product design Ability to simplify and present the value proposition of a complex offering Strong expertise in qualitative and quantitative business analysis Proficient in analyzing market potential through product segmentation, go-to-market channels, and developing business cases. Willingness to travel domestically and internationally (20%) More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is looking for a Global Product Specialist for mainstream business of Dry-type transformers to join our innovative team in any of these locations: Raleigh\/USA, Bland\/USA, Savli\/India, Vadodara\/India, Cheonan\/South Korea, Zaragoza\/Spain, Shanghai\/China. In this role, you will play a key part in supporting the global product manager in managing the dry-type transformer product portfolio, conducting comprehensive market\/segment technical analysis, and supporting the development of cutting-edge products. This position not only provides a chance to expand your skills and knowledge in the energy industry but also offers the opportunity to contribute to transformative solutions that promote sustainability and advance your career in a rapidly evolving market. How you will make an impact Conduct comprehensive market\/segment technical analysis to identify trends and assess their impact on the transformer portfolio. Evaluate technical requirements and perform competitive assessments to pinpoint product gaps and improvement opportunities. Manage and update technical specifications for existing products to ensure market competitiveness and value. Oversee performance improvement initiatives through benchmarking and quality feedback on dry type transformers. Ensure compliance with international regulations and industry standards throughout the product lifecycle. Support new product development by translating market requirements into actionable inputs for the product roadmap and technical requirement specifications. Prepare and present technical communication materials to support product launches and enhance market positioning. Develop and deliver engaging training sessions to empower cross-functional teams with the latest product knowledge and market insights. Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Your background Degree in Electrical\/Mechanical Engineering. Minimum of 7 years of experience in R&D, product\/technology development or engineering in dry type transformers, or a similar role within the transformers or energy industry. Strong technical understanding of dry type transformers, energy solutions and industry technologies to effectively communicate product benefits and differentiate offerings. Proven ability to conduct market analysis and competitive assessments to drive product developments. Excellent communication and presentation skills for both technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously. Fluent English

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità
• Stiamo cercando un leader di qualità esperto per guidare l'agenda di Qualità e miglioramento continuo (CI) in tutto il nostro Hub Europe. In questo ruolo chiave di leadership, si possiede la strategia di qualità, rafforzare i nostri sistemi di gestione della qualità, garantire la soddisfazione del cliente, e lead certificazione, audit e iniziative di miglioramento continuo in tutte le entità del Hub. Dove CI è in ambito, si distribuirà anche una cultura CI sostenibile e una struttura di miglioramento. La posizione di questo ruolo è flessibile in Europa e sarà determinata nelle fasi successive. Come farete un impatto Qualità & Leadership CI Definire e implementare la strategia Hub Quality e CI. Assicurare l'allineamento con le direttive globali, i requisiti normativi e le esigenze aziendali. Guidare la costruzione e la governance attraverso i team Hub Quality e CI. Customer Focus Incorpora la Voce del Cliente in tutte le iniziative di Qualità. Rappresentare l'azienda nelle discussioni dei clienti su questioni di qualità. Valutare i rischi e implementare soluzioni per garantire un'elevata soddisfazione del cliente. Sistema di Gestione della Qualità & Certificazione Condurre lo sviluppo e la manutenzione del Sistema di Gestione della Qualità. Controllare gli audit interni/esterni e garantire la chiusura tempestiva delle azioni. Certificazioni richieste sicure in tutte le unità Hub. Performance & Miglioramento Monitor processo e offrire prestazioni; analizzare le tendenze e guidare azioni correttive. Identificare opportunità di miglioramento e collaborare con gli stakeholder per implementare i cambiamenti. Escalare i problemi di qualità dei fornitori e garantire la risoluzione. Gestione non conformità Gestisci NCR di alto profilo e interventi dei clienti. Assicurare un contenimento efficace, misure correttive e preventive per proteggere la fiducia dei clienti. Rilevamento continuo del quadro di miglioramento continuo (Lighthouse, L6S, Lessons Learned, ecc.). Supporto e priorità progetti di miglioramento che elevano qualità e prestazioni operative. Il tuo corso di laurea in un campo correlato; un master o MBA è un vantaggio. 10-15 anni di esperienza in un ruolo simile in un ambiente multinazionale. Una forte esperienza di leadership nella gestione della qualità; la leadership CI è un vantaggio. Capacità di analizzare le prestazioni, risolvere i problemi sistematicamente e gestire i rischi. Solida influenza, comunicazione, gestione dei cambiamenti e capacità di risoluzione dei conflitti. mentalità orientata al cliente e comprovata capacità di collaborare attraverso le funzioni.
descriptionByLocale.en: The Opportunity We are looking for an experienced Quality leader to drive the Quality and Continuous Improvement (CI) agenda across our Hub Europe. In this key leadership role, you will own the Quality strategy, strengthen our Quality Management Systems, ensure customer satisfaction, and lead certification, audits, and continuous improvement initiatives across all entities in the Hub. Where CI is in scope, you will also deploy a sustainable CI culture and improvement structure. The location of this role is flexible within Europe, and will be determined in later stages. How you will make an impact Quality & CI Leadership Define and implement the Hub Quality and CI strategy. Ensure alignment with global directives, regulatory requirements, and business needs. Drive capability building and governance across Hub Quality and CI teams. Customer Focus Embed the Voice of the Customer in all Quality initiatives. Represent the company in customer discussions on quality matters. Evaluate risks and implement solutions to secure high customer satisfaction. Quality Management System & Certification Lead the development and maintenance of the Quality Management System. Oversee internal\/external audits and ensure timely closure of actions. Secure required certifications across all Hub units. Performance & Improvement Monitor process and offer performance; analyze trends and drive corrective actions. Identify improvement opportunities and collaborate with stakeholders to implement changes. Escalate supplier quality issues and ensure resolution. Non‑Conformance Management Manage high‑profile NCRs and customer interventions. Ensure effective containment, corrective, and preventive measures to protect customer trust. Continuous Improvement Deploy the Continuous Improvement Framework (Lighthouse, L6S, Lessons Learned, etc.). Support and prioritize improvement projects that elevate quality and operational performance. Your background Bachelor's degree in a related field; a Master's degree or MBA is an advantage. 10–15 years of experience in a similar role within a multinational environment. Strong leadership experience in Quality Management; CI leadership is a plus. Ability to analyse performance, solve problems systematically, and manage risks. Solid influencing, communication, change management, and conflict‑resolution skills. Customer‑centric mindset and proven ability to collaborate across functions.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Chance Wir sind auf der Suche nach einem erfahrenen Qualitätsführer, der die Agenda Qualität und kontinuierliche Verbesserung (CI) in ganz Europa treibt. In dieser zentralen Führungsrolle besitzen Sie die Qualitätsstrategie, stärken unsere Qualitätsmanagementsysteme, sorgen für Kundenzufriedenheit und führen Zertifizierung, Audits und kontinuierliche Verbesserungsinitiativen in allen Unternehmen des Hubs. Wenn CI in Reichweite ist, werden Sie auch eine nachhaltige CI-Kultur und Verbesserung Struktur einsetzen. Der Standort dieser Rolle ist in Europa flexibel und wird später bestimmt. Wie Sie einen Einfluss auf Qualität & CI Leadership Definieren und implementieren die Hub Quality and CI Strategie. Gewährleistung der Angleichung an globale Richtlinien, regulatorische
• Anforderungen und Geschäftsanforderungen. Antriebsfähigkeitsaufbau und Governance in Hub Quality und CI-Teams. Customer Focus Embed the Voice of the Customer in allen Qualitätsinitiativen. Vertreten Sie das Unternehmen in Kundengesprächen zu Qualitätsfragen. Risiken auswerten und Lösungen implementieren, um eine hohe Kundenzufriedenheit zu gewährleisten. Qualitätsmanagement System & Zertifizierung Führen Sie die Entwicklung und Wartung des Qualitätsmanagementsystems. descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Nous sommes à la recherche d'un leader expérimenté de la qualité pour piloter le programme Qualité et amélioration continue (IC) dans notre Hub Europe. Lorsque l'IC a une portée, vous allez également déployer une culture et une structure d'amélioration durables de l'IC. L'emplacement de ce rôle est souple en Europe et sera déterminé ultérieurement. Comment vous allez avoir un impact Qualité et leadership de l'IC Définir et mettre en œuvre la stratégie Hub Qualité et IC. Assurer l'alignement sur les directives mondiales, les exigences réglementaires et les besoins des entreprises. Favoriser le renforcement des capacités et la gouvernance au sein des équipes de la qualité du Hub et de l'IC. Focus client Intégrez la voix du client dans toutes les initiatives Qualité. Représenter l'entreprise dans les discussions des clients sur les questions de qualité. Évaluer les risques et mettre en œuvre des solutions pour garantir une satisfaction élevée de la clientèle. Système de gestion de la qualité et certification Diriger le développement et la maintenance du système de gestion de la qualité. Superviser les vérifications internes/externes et assurer la clôture en temps opportun des actions. Sécuriser les certifications requises dans toutes les unités du Hub. Rendement et amélioration Surveiller le processus et offrir le rendement; analyser les tendances et prendre des mesures correctives. Votre licence d'études dans un domaine connexe; une maîtrise ou un MBA est un avantage. 10 à 15 ans d'expérience dans un rôle similaire au sein d'un environnement multinational. Une solide expérience de leadership en gestion de la qualité; le leadership de l'IC est un atout. Capacité d'analyser les performances, de résoudre les problèmes systématiquement et de gérer les risques. descriptionByLocale.it: The opportunity The Global Manufacturing Process Lead - GPG DT - Transformer Cores Fabrication is responsible for defining, leading, and continuously improving the end-to-end engineering and manufacturing-related processes for transformers magnetic cores within the Global Product Group (GPG), covering distribution transformers, dry-type transformers, and traction transformers. This role has a strong focus on core manufacturing processes, including lamination handling, cutting, stacking, core assembly, clamping, insulation interfaces, losses control, dimensional accuracy, and industrialization readiness, ensuring alignment between design, manufacturing, suppliers, and digital platforms. The position supports the “Design Anywhere, Manufacture Anywhere” strategy by standardizing processes, enabling digital tools, and ensuring that best practices in core manufacturing engineering are consistently deployed across factories worldwide. The role drives Lean, Digital Transformation, and Value Stream improvements, ensuring speed, quality, and robustness of magnetic core processes while reducing manual activities and variability. Close collaboration with Factory Engineering Process Managers, Digital Transformation Leads, Platform\/Tool teams, and Supply Chain is essential. How you'll make an impact You own global engineering and manufacturing processes for magnetic cores. You set clear standards that ensure quality, consistency, and efficiency. You standardize how cores are designed, built, and assembled worldwide. You ensure processes scale across factories and production volumes. You review processes regularly and drive continuous improvement. You improve efficiency, quality, and lead times through structured improvements. You identify where automation and digital tools add real value. You define requirements for tools that support design and manufacturing. You connect engineering with operations, supply chain, and suppliers. You lead a global network that applies standards safely and consistently. Your background You hold a degree in electrical, mechanical, industrial engineering, or similar. Or you bring equivalent long‑term practical experience. You have extensive experience in engineering or manufacturing environments. You bring deep exposure to magnetic cores or transformer manufacturing. You understand industrial processes for complex electromechanical products. You have a strong background in process engineering and continuous improvement. You have led complex initiatives across functions and countries. You work confidently with digital tools that support engineering and production. You communicate clearly and influence senior stakeholders effectively.​ More about us We pride ourselves on offering a holistic range of competitive benefits to support your financial, physical and mental wellbeing and personal development. We provide competitive salaries, flexible working hours, professional development opportunities, and a supportive work environment that encourages growth and innovation. Specific benefits depend on the location and will be communicated during the interview process. Applications are open until 15th of June.

title: Engineering Global Sustainability Leader
location: Remote - North Carolina, United States of America

descriptionByLocale.it:
The opportunity Sustainability starts at the design table—and this role puts you right at the center of that impact. As the Engineering Design Sustainability Lead , you will shape how sustainability is embedded into global engineering decisions across our transformer business. This is a highly visible, strategic role where engineering excellence meets environmental responsibility. You will lead the shift from downstream sustainability activities to design‑led outcomes, ensuring product‑level carbon reduction, material optimization, and environmental performance are built into every design choice from the outset. You will work across global engineering teams to translate sustainability ambitions into measurable, auditable product outcomes—balancing cost, safety, quality, and performance. With increasing expectations from customers, regulators, and stakeholders for credible product‑level data, your work will directly support compliance, ESG reporting, and long‑term business resilience. If you thrive at the intersection of engineering, data, and sustainability—and enjoy influencing without direct authority—this role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of sustainable product design at scale. How you'll make an impact Define and drive a global, design‑led sustainability strategy within Engineering. Embed sustainability into engineering standards, processes, and decision frameworks. Reduce product‑level carbon footprint through smart design, material, and architecture choices. Establish sustainability targets, KPIs, and traceable product‑level data at BOM level. Partner across engineering, R&D, supply chain, digital and operations teams globally. Strengthen governance, reporting, and audit‑ready sustainability metrics. Build capability and foster ownership of sustainable design within engineering teams. Translate regulatory and customer sustainability expectations into engineering requirements. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Your background Master's degree or PhD in Engineering or a closely related sustainability discipline. 10+ years of engineering experience, including 5+ years in sustainability‑focused roles. Proven success delivering design‑led sustainability or product carbon reduction initiatives. Strong knowledge of lifecycle assessment, sustainable materials, and carbon accounting. Experience leading global, cross‑functional initiatives and influencing senior stakeholders. Strong analytical mindset with a data‑driven approach to decision‑making. More about us At Hitachi Energy , sustainability, innovation, and safety are core to how we design the future of energy. You'll work in a global, diverse environment where ideas are valued and impact is visible.
• We offer meaningful opportunities to grow, lead, and shape industry‑leading solutions with purpose.
