descriptionByLocale.it:
Unisciti al nostro Centro Servizi Locale Svizzera come tirocinante nel team Project Management. In questo ruolo supporterai i project manager di Ginevra collaborando con i colleghi di Zurigo. Questo stage offre un'opportunità unica per contribuire allo sviluppo di un pool di strumenti, assicurando che le attrezzature e gli strumenti necessari per l'esecuzione in loco siano adeguatamente definiti, disponibili e mantenuti. Non solo definirai nuovi strumenti, ma contribuirai anche a migliorare il modo in cui prepariamo e gestiamo le risorse e i processi legati al sito. Una parte fondamentale del ruolo include visitare i siti di progetto per convalidare e capire come vengono applicati strumenti e processi in pratica, permettendo di vedere direttamente l'impatto del vostro lavoro e contribuire al miglioramento contino. Supporto per la configurazione e la strutturazione di un pool di strumenti per l'esecuzione del sito (ad esempio, appalti, monitoraggio della calibrazione e configurazione del processo) Assistenza alle attività di coordinamento con gli stakeholder interni e i fornitori esterni Documentazione di supporto e standardizzazione dei processi correlati agli strumenti Partecipazione a riunioni di progetto e attività di preparazione e follow-up Contribuire a iniziative di miglioramento del processo, tra cui mappatura e ottimizzazione dei processi di gestione del progetto Miglioramento del processo relativo alla preparazione del sito e all'efficienza dell'esecuzione
• Offriamo condizioni di lavoro flessibili, mentorship dedicata, e un ambiente di supporto e inclusivo in cui si può crescere personalmente e professionalmente - consentendo di prosperare mentre bilanciare la vita e il lavoro.
descriptionByLocale.en:
The Opportunity Join our Local Service Center Switzerland as an intern in the Project Management team. In this role you will support project managers in Geneva while collaborating closely with colleagues in Zurich. This internship offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the development of a tool pool, ensuring that the necessary equipment and tools required for on-site execution are properly defined, available and maintained. You will not only define new tools, but also contribute to improving how we prepare and manage site-related resources and processes. A key part of the role includes visiting project sites to validate and understand how tools and processes are applied in practice, allowing you to directly see the impact of your work and contribute to continous improvement. How you'll make an impact Support the setup and structuring of a tool pool for site execution (e.g., procurement, calibration tracking, and process setup) Assist in coordinating activities with internal stakeholders and external suppliers Support documentation and standardization of tool-related processes Participate in project meetings and support preparation and follow-up activities Contribute to process improvement initiatives, including mapping and optimizing project management processes Drive process improvements related to site preparation and execution efficiency Your background Ongoing studies in Engineering or a related technical field Interest in practical engineering topics, especially related to site execution, equipment, and tool handling Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to coordinate across teams and stakeholders A structured, hands-on and solution-oriented way of working as well as a proactive mindset and willingness to learn in a technical environment Interest in practical, equipment handling, site-related work and project execution Fluency in English and French; German is a strong advantage More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing.
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Gelegenheit tritt als Praktikant im Projektmanagement-Team in unser örtliches Servicecenter Schweiz ein. In dieser Rolle unterstützen Sie Projektmanager in Genf und arbeiten eng mit Kollegen in Zürich zusammen. Dieses Praktikum bietet eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, zur Entwicklung eines Werkzeugpools beizutragen, um sicherzustellen, dass die für die Vor-Ort-Ausführung erforderlichen Geräte und Werkzeuge ordnungsgemäß definiert, verfügbar und gepflegt werden. Sie werden nicht nur neue Tools definieren, sondern auch dazu beitragen, wie wir standortbezogene Ressourcen und Prozesse vorbereiten und verwalten. Ein wesentlicher Teil der Rolle umfasst den Besuch von Projektseiten, um zu validieren und zu verstehen, wie Werkzeuge und Prozesse in der Praxis angewendet werden, so dass Sie direkt die Auswirkungen Ihrer Arbeit sehen und zu einer anhaltenden Verbesserung beitragen. Wie Sie einen Einfluss auf die Einrichtung und Strukturierung eines Werkzeugpools für die Standortausführung (z.B. Beschaffung, Kalibrierungsverfolgung und Prozessaufbau) ausüben Assistenz bei der Koordination von Aktivitäten mit internen Stakeholdern und externen Lieferanten Unterstützung von Dokumentation und Standardisierung von werkzeugbezogenen Prozessen Beteiligen Sie sich an Projektsitzungen und Support-Präparations- und Folgemaßnahmen Mithilfe von Prozessverbesserungsinitiativen, einschließlich Kartierung und Optimierung von Projektmanagementprozessen
• Wir bieten flexible Arbeitsbedingungen, engagierte Mentorschaft und eine unterstützende, integrative Umgebung, in der Sie persönlich und professionell wachsen können – die Ermächtigung, das Leben und die Arbeit zu fördern.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
The Opportunity Rejoignez notre centre de service local Suisse en tant que stagiaire dans l'équipe de gestion de projet. Dans ce rôle, vous accompagnerez les responsables de projets à Genève tout en collaborant étroitement avec vos collègues à Zurich. Ce stage offre une occasion unique de contribuer au développement d'un pool d'outils, en veillant à ce que l'équipement et les outils nécessaires à l'exécution sur place soient correctement définis, disponibles et entretenus. Vous allez non seulement définir de nouveaux outils, mais aussi contribuer à améliorer la façon dont nous préparons et gérons les ressources et les processus liés au site. Un élément clé du rôle consiste à visiter les sites de projet pour valider et comprendre comment les outils et les processus sont appliqués dans la pratique, vous permettant de voir directement l'impact de votre travail et contribuer à l'amélioration continue. Comment vous ferez un impact Soutenez la configuration et la structuration d'un pool d'outils pour l'exécution du site (p. ex., achat, suivi de l'étalonnage et configuration du processus) Aider à coordonner les activités avec les intervenants internes et les fournisseurs externes Appuyer la documentation et la normalisation des processus liés aux outils Participer aux réunions de projet et soutenir les activités de préparation et de suivi Contribuer aux initiatives d'amélioration des processus, y compris la cartographie et l'optimisation des processus de gestion des projets Favoriser l'amélioration des processus liés à la préparation et à l'efficacité de l'exécution des sites Vos antécédents Études en cours en génie ou dans un domaine technique connexe Intérêt pour les sujets d'ingénierie pratique, en particulier ceux liés à l'exécution des sites, à l'équipement et à la gestion des outils Fortes compétences en matière d'organisation et de communication, avec la capacité de coordonner entre les équipes et les intervenants Un mode de travail structuré, pratique et axé sur les solutions, ainsi qu'une attitude proactive et la volonté d'apprendre dans un environnement technique Intérêt pour la pratique, la gestion des équipements, le travail lié aux sites et l'exécution des projets Fluence en anglais et en français; l'allemand est un avantage important Plus sur nous Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie qui met fortement l'accent sur l'innovation, l'amélioration continue et la fabrication durable.

titleByLocale.en: Internship in Reliability Testing for SiC-based Power Semiconductors
titleByLocale.de: Internship in Reliability Testing for SiC-based Power Semiconductors
titleByLocale.fr: Internship in Reliability Testing for SiC-based Power Semiconductors

descriptionByLocale.it:
The opportunity Join our Semiconductor Packaging and Reliability Engineering research team and contribute to next‑generation power electronics. You will work on silicon carbide semiconductor reliability in a dynamic research environment. The role focuses on developing and improving innovative testing solutions for power devices. You collaborate closely with experts and gain insights into real research challenges. You will grow by combining experimental work with data analysis and system development. This position offers hands‑on access to advanced laboratories and close cooperation with industry and academia. How you'll make an impact Conduct measurement campaigns and analyze reliability data of SiC devices Develop and improve test setups for dynamic reliability testing Design solutions for advanced sensing and automated data collection Optimize power converter systems for long-term testing Upgrade measurement electronics and data acquisition systems Support integration of monitoring systems for device aging Document and communicate results within research and business teams Your background Currently enrolled in a Master's program in physics, electr onics engineering , materials engineering or a related discipline (official enrolment is essential) Familiar with electrical measurements setup and with the design and construction of electronics systems . Previous experience with semiconductor physics and\/or power devices is a strong plus Experience with LabView programming, and knowledge of programming languages ( e . g. Python, C , Matlab ) Fluency in written and spoken English Good communication and technical writing skills Creative and able to work autonomously More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing.
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Iscriviti al nostro Centro di Servizi Locali in Svizzera per una posizione dinamica che unisce la gestione dei progetti a responsabilità pratiche sul campo. In questo ruolo, supervisionerai i progetti di assistenza dei trasformatori di potenza dall'inizio alla fine, assicurandoti che tutti gli strumenti, le attrezzature e le procedure di calibrazione siano preparati con cura per operazioni sicure ed efficienti in loco. Entrando a far parte del nostro team, contribuirai direttamente alla stabilità della rete elettrica svizzera e avrai l'opportunità di collaborare con i principali attori del mercato energetico svizzero. Se ti piace gestire gli stakeholder tanto quanto rimboccarti le maniche per assicurarti che i team sul campo siano pronti all'azione, questo è il ruolo che fa per te. Si prega di inviare i vostri documenti in inglese. Come creare un impatto Lead e coordinare progetti di servizio trasformatori cross-funzionali dall'inizio all'altro, esecuzione in loco e chiusura, con piena responsabilità su tempistiche, costi, qualità, risorse e rischi Garantire disponibilità, conformità e affidabilità di strumenti, strumenti e apparecchiature di collaudo, inclusa manutenzione, calibrazione, certificazione e prontezza per le operazioni di servizio dei trasformatori Gestire e ottimizzare la logistica degli utensili e delle attrezzature, coprendo il controllo dell'inventario, Stoccaggio, rifornimento, spedizione, preparazione del materiale specifico per progetto e condivisione delle risorse tra i progetti Supportare i team sul campo con pacchetti completi, inclusi documentazione tecnica, procedure, requisiti di sicurezza e coordinamento onsite quando necessario Agire come interfaccia primaria tra clienti, team di assistenza sul campo, workshop, fornitori e stakeholder interni, garantendo una comunicazione chiara, proattiva e orientata alla soddisfazione durante tutto il ciclo di vita del progetto Pianifico, programma, e supervisionare le attività di servizio, garantendo la piena prontezza lavorativa prima della mobilitazione del sito, inclusi ambito tecnico, documentazione, permessi, accesso, logistica e prerequisiti HSE. Preparare e coordinare le attività in loco, garantire un'esecuzione sicura, fluida ed efficiente, e fornire supporto operativo operativo operativo durante situazioni critiche o complesse. Identificare, escalare e risolvere i rischi di progetto e operativi, garantendo la rigorosa conformità alle regole HSE, Standard ISO e requisiti normativi Favoriscono il miglioramento e la standardizzazione continui, migliorando la gestione degli strumenti, i processi di preparazione del sito e l'efficienza complessiva dell'esecuzione dei servizi Il tuo background Laurea in ingegneria, gestione tecnica o in un campo correlato 3+ anni di esperienza nella gestione di progetti o nel coordinamento dei servizi sul campo Handson mentalità e forte interesse per strumenti, calibrazione, sicurezza e preparazione tecnica Solide competenze organizzative e comunicative Esperienza in standard di qualità (ad esempio, ISO): Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e assumersi la responsabilità dei compiti dall'inizio all'estremo, Affare fluente in francese e inglese; Il tedesco è un vantaggio Più su di noi Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le performance personali e aziendali, creando al contempo un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le proprie competenze e crescere.
descriptionByLocale.en: The opportunity Join our Local Service Center Switzerland for a dynamic position that blends project management with hands-on field responsibilities. In this role, you will oversee power transformer service projects from start to finish, ensuring all tools, equipment, and calibration procedures are meticulously prepared for safe and efficient onsite operations. By joining our team, you will contribute directly to the stability of Switzerland's electrical grid and have the opportunity to collaborate with key players in the Swiss energy market. If you enjoy managing stakeholders as much as rolling up your sleeves to make sure field teams are ready for action, this is the role for you. Please submit your documents in English. How You'll Make an Impact Lead and coordinate cross‑functional transformer service projects end‑to‑end, onsite execution, and close‑out, with full ownership of schedule, cost, quality, resources, and risks Ensure availability, compliance, and reliability of tools, instruments, and testing equipment, including maintenance, calibration, certification, and readiness for transformer service operations Manage and optimize tooling and equipment logistics, covering inventory control, storage, replenishment, shipment, project‑specific material preparation, and resource sharing across projects Support field teams with complete job packs, including technical documentation, procedures, safety requirements, and onsite coordination when required Act as the primary interface between customers, field service teams, workshops, suppliers, and internal stakeholders, ensuring clear, proactive, and satisfaction‑oriented communication throughout the project lifecycle Plan, schedule, and supervise service activities, ensuring full job readiness prior to site mobilization, including technical scope, documentation, permits, access, logistics, and HSE prerequisites Prepare and coordinate onsite activities, guarantee safe, smooth, and efficient execution, and providing hands‑on operational support during critical or complex situations Identify, escalate, and resolve project and operational risks, ensuring strict compliance with HSE rules, ISO standards, and regulatory requirements Drive continuous improvement and standardization, enhancing tooling management, site preparation processes, and overall service execution efficiency Your background Degree in engineering, technical management, or a related field 3+ years of project management or field service coordination experience Handson mindset and strong interest in tools, calibration, safety, and technical preparation Solid organizational and communication skills Experience with quality standards (e.g., ISO) Ability to work independently and take ownership of tasks end-to-end Business fluent in French and fluent English; German is a plus More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Gelegenheit Treten Sie unserem lokalen Service-Center Schweiz für eine dynamische Position bei, die Projektmanagement mit praktischen
• Aufgaben vor Ort verbindet. In dieser Rolle beaufsichtigen Sie die Serviceprojekte für Leistungstransformatoren von Anfang bis Ende und stellen sicher, dass alle Werkzeuge, Geräte und Kalibrierungsverfahren sorgfältig auf einen sicheren und effizienten Betrieb vor Ort vorbereitet sind. Indem Sie sich unserem Team anschließen, tragen Sie direkt zur Stabilität des Schweizer Stromnetzes bei und haben die Möglichkeit, mit wichtigen Akteuren auf dem Schweizer Energiemarkt zusammenzuarbeiten. Wenn Sie Stakeholder genauso gerne verwalten wie die Ärmel hochkrempeln, um sicherzustellen, dass die Außendienstteams einsatzbereit sind, ist dies die richtige Rolle für Sie. Bitte reichen Sie Ihre Unterlagen in englischer Sprache ein. Wie Sie eine Wirkung erzielen Führen und koordinieren funktionsübergreifende Transformator-Serviceprojekte Ende-zu-Ende, Ausführung vor Ort und Abschluss, mit vollständiger Verantwortung für Zeitplan, Kosten, Qualität, Ressourcen und Risiken Stellen Sie die Verfügbarkeit, Konformität und Zuverlässigkeit von Werkzeugen, Instrumenten und Prüfgeräten sicher, einschließlich Wartung, Kalibrierung, Zertifizierung und Bereitschaft für den Transformator-Servicebetrieb Verwalten und optimieren Sie die Werkzeug- und Ausrüstungslogistik, einschließlich Bestandskontrolle, Lagerung, Nachschub, Versand, projektspezifische Materialvorbereitung und projektübergreifende Ressourcenteilung Unterstützen Sie Außendienstteams mit vollständigen Arbeitspaketen, einschließlich technischer Dokumentation, Verfahren, Sicherheitsanforderungen und Vor-Ort-Koordination bei Bedarf Handeln Sie als
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'occasion Joignez-vous à notre Centre de services locaux Suisse pour une position dynamique qui combine la gestion de projet avec des responsabilités pratiques sur le terrain. Dans ce rôle, vous superviserez les projets de service de transformateurs de puissance du début à la fin, assurant que tous les outils, équipements et procédures d'étalonnage sont méticuleusement préparés pour des opérations sur place sûres et efficaces. En rejoignant notre équipe, vous contribuerez directement à la stabilité du réseau électrique suisse et aurez la possibilité de collaborer avec des acteurs clés du marché suisse de l'énergie. Si vous aimez gérer les parties prenantes autant que monter vos manches pour vous assurer que les équipes de terrain sont prêtes à agir, c'est le rôle pour vous. Veuillez soumettre vos documents en anglais. Comment vous ferez un impact Dirigez et coordonnez des projets de services de transformation transfonctionnels en anglais, de bout en bout, d'exécution sur place et de fermeture, avec pleine propriété du calendrier, du coût, de la qualité, des ressources et des risques Assurer la disponibilité, la conformité et la fiabilité des outils, des instruments et du matériel d'essai, y compris la maintenance, l'étalonnage, la certification et la préparation aux opérations de transformation Gérer et optimiser l'outillage et la logistique du matériel, y compris le contrôle des stocks, le stockage, la reconstitution, l'expédition, la préparation du matériel spécifique au projet et le partage des ressources entre les projets Soutenir les équipes de terrain avec des équipes de travail complètes, y compris la documentation technique, les procédures, les exigences en matière de sécurité et la coordination sur place au besoin Agir comme interface principale entre les clients, les équipes de services sur le terrain, les ateliers, les fournisseurs et les intervenants internes, assurer une communication claire, proactive et axée sur la satisfaction tout au long du cycle de vie du projet Plan, du calendrier et de la supervision des activités de service, assurer une pleine préparation au travail avant la mobilisation du site, y compris la documentation et les permis, l'accès.

descriptionByLocale.it: Die Möglichkeit Wir suchen eine engagierte Persönlichkeit als Transport, Trade & Logistics Specialist Export, die unsere internationalen Transportprozesse aktiv mitgestaltet und optimiert. In dieser Rolle sind Sie verantwortlich für die Organisation und Überwachung weltweiter Transporte über Luft, See, Strasse und Kurierdienste. Du arbeitest eng mit Spediteuren und internen Stakeholdern zusammen, um eine reibungslose Abwicklung sicherzustellen. Das kannst du bewirken Organisation und Überwachung von weltweiten Transporten (Luft, See, LKW, Kurier) Beauftragung, Erstellung, Disponierung und Überwachung von Sendungen Abwicklung von Beglaubigungen, Akkreditiven, Carnet ATA und Versicherungszertifikaten Kontrolle der Leistungsverrechnungen Ausstellung von Versanddokumenten via ERP und anderen Tools (GTS\/SAP, Excel etc.) Auswertung von Transportofferten und Prüfung von Frachtrechnungen Kontinuierlicher Austausch mit internen und externen Stakeholdern Anwendung Ihres Fachwissens in Exportkontrolle, Ursprungsregeln und Güterbeförderung mit allen Transportträgern Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Exportfachmann\/-frau 2–3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im relevanten Bereich Fundiertes Know-how in der Logistikbranche Digitale Kompetenzen (API, EDI, AI): Standard Erfahrung im Stakeholder Management (SCM, Planung, Lieferanten, PMs, Engineering, Qualität, Import\/Export, Finanzen) Kenntnisse in SAP TMS & GTS sowie MS Office (Excel, SharePoint etc.) Sprachkenntnisse: Deutsch fliessend, Englisch B2 erforderlich, Französisch\/Italienisch von Vorteil Fähigkeiten: Problemlösungskompetenz, gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, Eigeninitiative Mehr über uns Bei Hitachi Energy glauben wir, dass Innovation aus Vielfalt und Zusammenarbeit entsteht. Wir fördern ein integratives und vielfältiges Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen gemeinsam an nachhaltigen Energielösungen arbeiten.

descriptionByLocale.it: The opportunity As a Transport, Trade & Logistics Specialist Domestic at HITACHI ENERGY LTD, you will be responsible for the efficient and compliant movement of goods within national borders, ensuring timely delivery, cost-effectiveness, and adherence to all domestic transportation and trade regulations. How you'll make an impact Plan, organize, and monitor domestic transportation of goods, including selection of carriers, negotiation of rates and optimization of routes to minimize costs and maximize efficiency. Prepare and process all necessary documentation for domestic shipments, such as packing lists and forwarding orders, ensuring accuracy and completeness. Coordinate with internal departments (e.g., production, sales, warehousing) and external stakeholders (e.g., carriers or customers) to ensure smooth logistics operations. Track and trace domestic shipments, proactively identifying and resolving any delays, issues, or discrepancies. Manage and maintain relationships with domestic carriers and logistics service providers, evaluating performance and ensuring adherence to service level agreements. Ensure compliance with all relevant domestic transportation laws, regulations, and company policies Identify and implement continuous improvement initiatives for domestic logistics processes to enhance efficiency, reduce costs and improve service levels. Handle domestic freight claims and resolve shipping discrepancies with carriers. Participate in logistics-related projects and initiatives as required. Your background Swiss Apprenticeship or Higher Education (in the area of transport) Minimum of 2-3 years of relevant experience in domestic transportation, logistics, or supply chain operations, preferably within a manufacturing or industrial environment. Strong understanding of domestic transportation modes and their associated regulations. Proficiency in logistics software and enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems (e.g., SAP). Good negotiation and communication skills, both written and verbal in German and English. Proven ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment. Good analytical and problem-solving abilities with a keen attention to detail. Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook). Knowledge of dangerous goods regulations for domestic transport is a plus. More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
descriptionByLocale.en: The opportunity As a Transport, Trade & Logistics Specialist Domestic at HITACHI ENERGY LTD, you will be responsible for the efficient and compliant movement of goods within national borders, ensuring timely delivery, cost-effectiveness, and adherence to all domestic transportation and trade regulations. How you'll make an impact Plan, organize, and monitor domestic transportation of goods, including selection of carriers, negotiation of rates and optimization of routes to minimize costs and maximize efficiency. Prepare and process all necessary documentation for domestic shipments, such as packing lists and forwarding orders, ensuring accuracy and completeness. Coordinate with internal departments (e.g., production, sales, warehousing) and external stakeholders (e.g., carriers or customers) to ensure smooth logistics operations. Track and trace domestic shipments, proactively identifying and resolving any delays, issues, or discrepancies. Manage and maintain relationships with domestic carriers and logistics service providers, evaluating performance and ensuring adherence to service level agreements. Ensure compliance with all relevant domestic transportation laws, regulations, and company policies Identify and implement continuous improvement initiatives for domestic logistics processes to enhance efficiency, reduce costs and improve service levels. Handle domestic freight claims and resolve shipping discrepancies with carriers. Participate in logistics-related projects and initiatives as required. Your background Swiss Apprenticeship or Higher Education (in the area of transport) Minimum of 2-3 years of relevant experience in domestic transportation, logistics, or supply chain operations, preferably within a manufacturing or industrial environment. Strong understanding of domestic transportation modes and their associated regulations. Proficiency in logistics software and enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems (e.g., SAP). Good negotiation and communication skills, both written and verbal in German and English. Proven ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment. Good analytical and problem-solving abilities with a keen attention to detail. Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook). Knowledge of dangerous goods regulations for domestic transport is a plus. More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

titleByLocale.it: Vice Presidente Vendite e Marketing GPQSS

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione La nostra Grid Integration – GPQSS (azienda di integrazione del sistema AC) sta cercando un Leader di Marketing e Vendite globale per modellare, accelerare ed eseguire la nostra strategia commerciale mondiale. Questo ruolo strategico senior richiede un esecutivo di vendite realizzato in grado di guidare la crescita redditizia, rafforzare la nostra presenza di mercato, e leader team globali ad alto rendimento all'interno di una complessa matrice organizzazione. In qualità di Executive Sales & Marketing Manager, possederai la strategia commerciale a lungo termine e la sua esecuzione operativa per il Global Product Group, impostando la visione e gli obiettivi di vendita globali, garantendo un'efficace distribuzione in paesi e segmenti. Sarete responsabili di fornire obiettivi ambiziosi di crescita, di margine e di espansione del mercato in allineamento con la strategia di Marketing & Sales dell'unità aziendale. Come membro chiave del team di leadership globale, collaborerai a stretto contatto con la gestione dei prodotti, lo sviluppo aziendale, le operazioni, le finanze e i leader regionali, e rappresenterai il business di Hitachi Energy Grid and Power Quality Solutions and Service in senior customer engagement, forum industriali e partnership strategiche, posizionando l'organizzazione come leader tecnologico di fiducia. Come farai ad avere un impatto - Condurre lo sviluppo e l'esecuzione della strategia commerciale globale per il business GPQSS, stabilire una chiara visione a lungo termine, traducendola in piani di vendita a livello nazionale e specifici per segmenti che consentono una crescita coerente e scalabile in tutto il mondo. - Definire e possedere l'ambizione di vendita globale, tra cui ricavi, margini e obiettivi di espansione del mercato, assicurando che gli obiettivi di vendita non siano allineati solo con la strategia di Marketing & Sales della Business Unit, ma anche sostenuti da insight basati sui dati, posizionamento competitivo e tendenze dei clienti emergenti. - Promuovere una crescita proficua in tutte le regioni organizzando un approccio unificato di go-to-market, rafforzando la qualità delle tubazioni, migliorando la precisione delle previsioni e garantendo una gestione delle prestazioni commerciali disciplinata in una struttura di matrice complessa. - Elevate la presenza globale di mercato di Hitachi Energy's Grid and Power Quality Solutions & Services, posizionando il portafoglio come punto di riferimento del settore attraverso l'intelligenza di mercato mirata, le proposte differenziate di valore e le attività di leader di pensiero che rafforzano la nostra reputazione come leader tecnologico di fiducia. - Guidare, ispirare e sviluppare team di vendita e marketing globali ad alto rendimento, incorporando una cultura di responsabilità, collaborazione e eccellenza commerciale, fornendo ai team strumenti, formazione e strutture necessarie per eseguire in scala. - Agire come partner strategico per le principali parti interessate interne, tra cui gestione del prodotto, sviluppo aziendale, operazioni, finanza e leadership regionale, garantendo un allineamento stretto tra strategia commerciale, priorità roadmap del prodotto, capacità di consegna e obiettivi di performance aziendali. - Rappresentare l'azienda ai massimi livelli di impegno del cliente e dell'industria, costruire e nutrire relazioni esecutive, negoziare leader, e influenzare gli organismi del settore, alleanze strategiche e partner ecosistemici per far progredire la leadership di Hitachi Energy nell'integrazione della rete e nella qualità della potenza. - Guidare l'allineamento interfunzionale per accelerare la penetrazione del mercato, assicurando un coordinamento senza soluzione di continuità tra vendite, marketing, tendering, servizio e operazioni per massimizzare i tassi di vincita, ottimizzare le strategie di prezzi e migliorare il valore del cliente attraverso il ciclo di vita. - Superare i quadri di governance commerciale e le metriche di performance, assicurando che le attività di vendita globali siano eseguite in modo coerente, etico ed efficiente, e che il rigoroso monitoraggio delle prestazioni supporti il miglioramento continuo e l'agilità strategica. - L'innovazione del campione e le intuizioni di mercato, l'alimentazione del cliente, il concorrente e l'intelligenza di mercato nell'organizzazione per modellare le strategie future del prodotto, guidare le decisioni di investimento e identificare nuove opportunità di crescita.
descriptionByLocale.en: ## Descrizione The opportunity Our Grid Integration – GPQSS (AC system integration business) is seeking a global Marketing and Sales Leader to shape, accelerate, and execute our worldwide commercial strategy. This senior strategic role requires an accomplished sales executive capable of driving profitable growth, strengthening our market presence, and leading high-performing global teams within a complex matrix organization. As the Executive Sales & Marketing Manager, you will own the long-term commercial strategy and its operational execution for the Global Product Group, setting the global sales vision and targets while ensuring effective deployment across countries and segments. You will be responsible for delivering ambitious growth, margin, and market-expansion objectives in alignment with the Business Unit's Marketing & Sales strategy. As a key member of the global leadership team, you will collaborate closely with Product Management, Business Development, Operations, Finance, and regional leaders, and you will represent Hitachi Energy's Grid and Power Quality Solutions and Service business in senior customer engagements, industry forums, and strategic partnerships, positioning the organization as a trusted technology leader. ## How you'll make an impact - Lead the development and execution of the global commercial strategy for the GPQSS business, establishing a clear long-term vision while translating it into actionable, country-level and segment-specific sales plans that enable consistent, scalable growth worldwide. - Define and own the global sales ambition, including revenue, margin, and market-expansion targets, ensuring that sales objectives are not only aligned with the Business Unit's Marketing & Sales strategy but also underpinned by data-driven insights, competitive positioning, and emerging customer trends. - Drive profitable growth across all regions by orchestrating a unified go-to-market approach, strengthening pipeline quality, enhancing forecasting precision, and ensuring disciplined commercial performance management across a complex matrix structure. - Elevate the global market presence of Hitachi Energy's Grid and Power Quality Solutions & Services, positioning the portfolio as the industry benchmark through targeted market intelligence, differentiated value propositions, and thought-leadership activities that reinforce our reputation as a trusted technology leader. - Lead, inspire, and develop high-performing global sales and marketing teams, embedding a culture of accountability, collaboration, and commercial excellence while equipping teams with the tools, training, and structures they need to execute at scale. - Act as a strategic partner to key internal stakeholders, including Product Management, Business Development, Operations, Finance, and regional leadership, ensuring tight alignment between commercial strategy, product roadmap priorities, delivery capabilities, and business performance objectives. - Represent the business at the highest levels in customer and industry engagements, building and nurturing executive relationships, leading negotiations, and influencing industry bodies, strategic alliances, and ecosystem partners to advance Hitachi Energy's leadership in grid integration and power quality. - Drive cross-functional alignment to accelerate market penetration, ensuring seamless coordination between sales, marketing, tendering, service, and operations to maximize win rates, optimize pricing strategies, and enhance customer value across the lifecycle. - Oversee commercial governance frameworks and performance metrics, ensuring that global sales activities are executed consistently, ethically, and efficiently, and that rigorous performance tracking supports continuous improvement and strategic agility. - Champion innovation and market-back insights, feeding customer, competitor, and market intelligence into the organization to shape future product strategies, guide investment decisions, and identify new growth opportunities.
descriptionByLocale.de: Beschreibung Die Chance Unsere Grid Integration – GPQSS (AC-Systemintegrationsgeschäft) sucht einen globalen Marketing- und Vertriebsleiter, um unsere weltweite Handelsstrategie zu gestalten, zu beschleunigen und umzusetzen. Diese hochrangige strategische Rolle erfordert eine erfolgreiche Vertriebsleitung, die in der Lage ist, profitables Wachstum zu erzielen, unsere Marktpräsenz zu stärken und führende hochperformierende globale Teams innerhalb einer komplexen Matrixorganisation zu führen. Als Executive Sales & Marketing Manager besitzen Sie die langfristige kommerzielle Strategie und ihre operative Umsetzung für die Global Product Group und setzen dabei die globale Verkaufsvision und -ziele fest und gewährleisten einen effektiven Einsatz in Ländern und Segmenten. Sie werden dafür verantwortlich sein, ambitionierte Wachstums-, Margen- und Marktexpansionsziele im Einklang mit der Marketing- und Vertriebsstrategie des Unternehmens zu erreichen. Als zentrales Mitglied des globalen Führungsteams werden Sie eng mit Product Management, Business Development, Operations, Finance und regionalen Führungskräften zusammenarbeiten und das Unternehmen Grid and Power Quality Solutions and Service von Hitachi Energy in Senior Customer Engagements, Branchenforen und strategischen Partnerschaften vertreten und die Organisation als vertrauenswürdiger Technologieführer positionieren. Wie Sie einen Einfluss haben - Führen Sie die Entwicklung und Umsetzung der globalen kommerziellen Strategie für das GPQSS-Geschäft, die Schaffung einer klaren langfristigen Vision und die Umsetzung in handlungsfähige, landesweite und segmentspezifische Vertriebspläne, die ein konsequentes, skalierbares Wachstum weltweit ermöglichen. - Definieren und besitzen Sie den globalen Umsatz-Ehrgeiz, einschließlich Umsatz-, Margen- und Marktexpansions-Ziele, um sicherzustellen, dass die Verkaufsziele nicht nur mit der Marketing- und Vertriebsstrategie der Business Unit vereinbar sind, sondern auch durch datengetriebene Erkenntnisse, wettbewerbsfähige Positionierung und aufstrebende Kundentrends untermauert werden. - Fahren Sie profitables Wachstum in allen Regionen, indem Sie einen einheitlichen Go-to-Market-Ansatz orchestrieren, die Pipeline-Qualität stärken, die Prognosegenauigkeit verbessern und diszipliniertes kommerzielles Leistungsmanagement über eine komplexe Matrixstruktur gewährleisten. - Erhöhen Sie die globale Marktpräsenz von Hitachi Energy's Grid and Power Quality Solutions & Services und positionieren Sie das Portfolio als Branchen-Benchmark durch gezielte Marktinformationen, differenzierte Wertvorstellungen und durchdachte Führungsaktivitäten, die unseren Ruf als vertrauenswürdiger Technologieführer stärken. - Führen, inspirieren und entwickeln leistungsstarke globale Vertriebs- und Marketingteams, die eine Kultur der Rechenschaftspflicht, Zusammenarbeit und kommerziellen Exzellenz einbetten und Teams mit Werkzeugen, Schulungen und Strukturen ausrüsten, die sie im Maßstab ausführen müssen. - Handeln Sie als strategischer Partner für wichtige interne Interessenvertreter, einschließlich Product Management, Business Development, Operations, Finanzen und regionale Führung, um eine enge Abstimmung zwischen kommerzieller Strategie, Produkt-Roadmap-Prioritäten, Lieferfähigkeiten und Geschäftsleistungszielen sicherzustellen. - Repräsentieren Sie das Geschäft auf höchstem Niveau in Kunden- und Industrieengagements, Aufbau und Pflege von Führungsbeziehungen, führenden Verhandlungen und Einfluss auf Branchengremien, strategische Allianzen und Ökosystem-Partner, um die Führung von Hitachi Energy bei der Netzintegration und -qualität zu fördern. - Führen Sie die funktionsübergreifende Ausrichtung aus, um die Marktdurchdringung zu beschleunigen, eine nahtlose Abstimmung zwischen Vertrieb, Marketing, Angebot, Service und Betrieb sicherzustellen, um die Gewinnraten zu maximieren, Preisstrategien zu optimieren und den Kundenwert über den gesamten Lebenszyklus zu steigern. - Beaufsichtigen Sie kommerzielle Governance-Frameworks und Performance Metriken, um sicherzustellen, dass globale Vertriebsaktivitäten konsequent, ethisch und effizient ausgeführt werden und dass strenge Performance Tracking kontinuierliche Verbesserung und strategische Agilität unterstützt. - Championinnovation und Marktrückblicke, Fütterung von Kunden, Wettbewerbern und Marktinformationen in die Organisation, um zukünftige Produktstrategien zu gestalten, Investitionsentscheidungen zu führen und neue Wachstumschancen zu identifizieren.
descriptionByLocale.fr: Descrizione L'opportunité Notre intégration Grid – GPQSS (AC system integration business) cherche un leader mondial du marketing et des ventes pour façonner, accélérer et exécuter notre stratégie commerciale mondiale. Ce rôle stratégique de haut niveau nécessite un cadre commercial accompli capable de stimuler une croissance rentable, de renforcer notre présence sur le marché et de diriger des équipes mondiales à haut rendement au sein d'une organisation matricielle complexe. En tant que responsable des ventes et du marketing, vous serez propriétaire de la stratégie commerciale à long terme et de son exécution opérationnelle pour le Groupe de produits mondial, en définissant la vision et les objectifs des ventes mondiales tout en assurant un déploiement efficace à travers les pays et les segments. Vous serez responsable de la réalisation d'objectifs ambitieux de croissance, de marge et d'expansion du marché, conformément à la stratégie de marketing et de vente de l'unité commerciale. En tant que membre clé de l'équipe de direction mondiale, vous collaborerez étroitement avec la gestion des produits, le développement des affaires, les opérations, les finances et les dirigeants régionaux, et vous représenterez l'activité Grid and Power Quality Solutions and Service d'Hitachi Energy dans les relations avec les clients, les forums de l'industrie et les partenariats stratégiques. Comment vous ferez un impact - Diriger l ' élaboration et la mise en œuvre de la stratégie commerciale mondiale pour les activités du GPQSS, en établissant une vision claire à long terme tout en la traduisant en plans de vente réalisables au niveau des pays et spécifiques à chaque segment, qui permettent une croissance cohérente et évolutive dans le monde entier. - Définir et posséder l'ambition des ventes mondiales, y compris les revenus, la marge et les objectifs d'expansion du marché, en veillant à ce que les objectifs des ventes ne soient pas seulement alignés sur la stratégie marketing et des ventes de l'unité commerciale, mais également étayés par des informations basées sur les données, un positionnement concurrentiel et de nouvelles tendances clientes. - Favoriser une croissance rentable dans toutes les régions en orchestrant une approche unifiée de l'accès au marché, en renforçant la qualité des pipelines, en améliorant la précision des prévisions et en assurant une gestion des performances commerciales disciplinées dans une structure matricielle complexe. - Augmenter la présence sur le marché mondial des solutions et services Grid and Power Quality d'Hitachi Energy, positionner le portefeuille en tant que référence de l'industrie grâce à une intelligence de marché ciblée, à des propositions de valeur différenciées et à des activités de réflexion qui renforcent notre réputation de leader technologique de confiance. - Diriger, inspirer et développer des équipes de vente et de marketing mondial hautement performantes, intégrer une culture de responsabilité, de collaboration et d'excellence commerciale tout en équipant les équipes des outils, de la formation et des structures dont elles ont besoin pour exécuter à l'échelle. - Agir en tant que partenaire stratégique pour les principaux intervenants internes, y compris la gestion des produits, le développement des affaires, les opérations, les finances et le leadership régional, en assurant l'harmonisation étroite entre la stratégie commerciale, les priorités de la feuille de route des produits, les capacités de prestation et les objectifs de rendement opérationnel. - Représenter les entreprises aux plus hauts niveaux dans les engagements des clients et de l'industrie, établir et entretenir des relations avec les cadres supérieurs, diriger les négociations et influencer les organismes de l'industrie, les alliances stratégiques et les partenaires écosystémiques pour faire progresser le leadership d'Hitachi Energy dans l'intégration du réseau et la qualité de l'énergie. - Conduire l'alignement interfonctionnel pour accélérer la pénétration du marché, assurer une coordination transparente entre les ventes, le marketing, l'appel d'offres, le service et les opérations afin de maximiser les taux de réussite, d'optimiser les stratégies de tarification et d'améliorer la valeur du client tout au long du cycle de vie. - Superviser les cadres de gouvernance commerciale et les indicateurs de performance, en veillant à ce que les activités de vente mondiales soient exécutées de façon cohérente, éthique et efficace, et à ce que le suivi rigoureux des performances favorise l'amélioration continue et l'agilité stratégique. - Championne l'innovation et les perspectives de marché, alimente la clientèle, les concurrents et l'intelligence du marché dans l'organisation pour façonner les stratégies futures de produits, orienter les décisions d'investissement et identifier de nouvelles possibilités de croissance.

descriptionByLocale.it: The opportunity As part of our ongoing digital transformation journey, we are developing ACE, a cutting-edge Generative AI-powered platform designed to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of our Bid & Proposal Management process within the Transformers Business Unit. We are seeking a Prompt Engineer who will play a pivotal role in this initiative. This individual will be responsible for designing, testing, and optimizing domain-specific prompts that enable ACE to generate accurate, context-aware, and business-aligned outputs. The role requires a deep understanding of transformer industry, industrial equipment standards as well as basic understanding of prompt engineering best practices and GenAI model behavior, ensuring that ACE delivers high-quality responses tailored to complex business scenarios. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with IT Experts, Subject Matter Experts, Business stakeholders, and Module Owners to break down complex business logic into domain-specific prompts. How you'll make an impact Develop, refine, and maintain prompt libraries for various transformer units\/factories. Implement advanced techniques like prompt chaining, context injection, and few-shot learning for enterprise-grade accuracy. Own prompt lifecycle management including versioning, traceability, and governance. Evaluate LLM responses for precision, compliance, and bias mitigation. Conduct A\/B testing and maintain performance dashboards for prompt effectiveness. Work closely with Module Owners, Subject Matter Experts, and Business Stakeholders to embed prompts into ACE workflows. Create clear documentation for prompt strategies and maintain best practices aligned with Hitachi Energy's AI Ethics Charter. Stay updated on emerging GenAI technologies, frameworks, and tools to enhance ACE capabilities. Implement and recommend best practices for prompting across different ACE modules. Your background Bachelor or master degree in electrical engineering Experience working in the transformer industry, with international standards and customer documentation. Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking. Strong linguistic and logical reasoning for crafting precise prompts. Strong understanding of NLP, context management, and token optimization. Ability to experiment and iterate to optimize outputs. Ability to understand business processes and translate them into ACE-specific prompts. Hands-on experience with LLMs and prompt engineering techniques. Strong interest in AI enterprise-grade solutions. Willingness to learn Python and experience with AI APIs services. Ability to work in Agile environments and manage multiple stakeholders. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Analytical mindset with attention to detail. Empathy for end users and curiosity for experimentation. Commitment to ethical AI practices and continuous learning. Reduction in prompt failure rate and model hallucination. Improvement in accuracy of outputs by modules. Speed and scalability of prompt deployment across ACE modules within the Transformer Business Unit. Compliance with AI governance and security standards. More about us Be part of a global digital transformation initiative. Work on cutting-edge GenAI solutions. Collaborative culture with opportunities for career growth and innovation. We are committed to full transparency and compliance with all legal requirements, ensuring that every candidate knows exactly what to expect at each stage of the recruitment process. Once the process is successfully completed, we will share detailed information about financial conditions and benefits with the selected candidate. Before signing the employment contract, you will receive all remaining details of the offer, giving you the time and space to review everything carefully. * * Applicable only for Poland location align with local law regulations

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità

Il nostro gruppo di prodotti locale Insulation & Components è il leader tecnologico nella progettazione e produzione di boccole per trasformatori ad alta potenza. Tutte le rinomate aziende internazionali dell'industria elettrica, attive nella produzione di energia, trasmissione e distribuzione sono tra i nostri clienti. Abbiamo una posizione superiore nelle aree boccole trans-former ad alta tensione in tutto il mondo.

In questo ruolo altamente responsabile e dinamico, guiderete il nostro team di laboratorio a MICAFIL a Zürich-Altstetten (ZH) e vi assicureremo di rafforzare ulteriormente la nostra competitività e sviluppare il nostro ramo svizzero per soddisfare la crescita globale del mercato nel campo dell'energia. In questo importante ruolo, continuerai a guidare i processi efficienti e innovativi dei nostri 3 laboratori diversi insieme a un team forte. Se avete una passione per la leadership e i test ad alta tensione, vi offriamo la fase per portare a cambiamenti reali e modellare attivamente il futuro dei nostri processi produttivi.

Come farai ad avere un impatto

• Guidare il team di laboratorio, tra cui la gestione delle risorse e lo sviluppo del team (15 FTE) e agire come punto di contatto per il test HV a Zürich-Altstetten MICAFIL

• Garantire il rispetto degli standard di sicurezza e qualità (IEC/IEEE)

• Analizzare e implementare processi produttivi e aziendali efficienti per aumentare la sicurezza, la qualità e la produttività

• Assicurare l'alta potenza attraverso procedure di prova ad alta tensione affidabili (AC, DC, impulso, scarico parziale)

• Identificare e integrare nuove tecnologie e migliori pratiche per guidare il processo di miglioramento continuo (CIP) insieme al team e al nostro team di Process Engineering

• Collabora a stretto contatto con la pianificazione, la garanzia della qualità, la logistica, altri dipartimenti di produzione e le parti interessate rilevanti per la progettazione e il miglioramento di processi olistici

• Essere responsabile di istruzioni di lavoro e manutenzione ottimali e di altre normative pertinenti (ad esempio ISO, Lean, Six Sigma)

• Sviluppare e monitorare i più importanti indicatori chiave di performance (KPI) per misurare il successo e il re-port al responsabile delle operazioni

• In qualità di People Manager, sarai responsabile di garantire il rispetto delle normative, procedure e linee guida esterne e interne applicabili

Il tuo sfondo

• Apprendistato tecnico e qualifiche (Bachelor / Master) nel campo dell'ingegneria elettrica o equivalente

• Diversi anni di esperienza in una posizione di leadership simile (High-Voltage Testing/Insulation Technology/Power Engineering)

• Conoscenza solida nei sistemi di alta tensione, generatori e sistemi di automazione

• Conoscenza solida della gestione magra, Six Sigma e altri metodi di ottimizzazione dei processi

• Esperienza dimostrata nei team leader e motivanti

• Forte capacità di problem solving e un approccio data-driven al processo decisionale combinato con un forte focus sulla sicurezza

• Gestione del tempo eccellente, comunicazione e competenze organizzative

• Fluente in tedesco e inglese

Ulteriori informazioni su di noi

Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.
descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity

Our local product group Insulation & Components is the technology leader in design and manufacture of high volt-age transformer bushings. All renowned international companies of the electrical industry, active in power genera-tion, transmission and distribution are among our customers. We have a top position in the high voltage trans-former bushing areas worldwide.

In this highly responsible and dynamic role, you will lead our laboratory team at MICAFIL in Zürich-Altstetten (ZH) and ensure that we further strengthen our competitiveness and develop our Swiss branch to meet the global market growth in the field of energy. In this important role, you will continuously drive forward the efficient and innovative processes of our 3 different laboratories together with a strong team. If you have a passion for leadership and high voltage testing, we offer you the stage to bring about real change and actively shape the future of our production processes.

How you'll make an impact

• Lead the laboratory team, including resource management and team development (15 FTE) and act as the point of contact for HV testing at Zürich-Altstetten MICAFIL

• Ensure compliance with safety and quality standards (IEC/IEEE)

• Analyze & implement efficient production & business processes to increase safety, quality and productivity

• Ensure high output through reliable high-voltage testing procedures (AC, DC, impulse, partial discharge)

• Identify and integrate new technologies and best practices to drive the continuous improvement process (CIP) together with your team and our Process Engineering team

• Collaborate closely with planning, quality assurance, logistics, other production departments and relevant stakeholders for holistic process design and improvement

• Be responsible for optimal work and maintenance instructions and other relevant regulations (e.g. ISO, Lean, Six Sigma)

• Develop and monitor the most important key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure success and re-port to operations manager

• As People Manager, you will be responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures and guidelines

Your background

• Technical apprenticeship and qualifications (Bachelor / Master) in the field of Electrical Engineering or equivalent

• Several years of experience in a similar leadership position (High-Voltage Testing/Insulation Technology/Power Engineering)

• Solid knowledge in high-voltage systems, generators, and automation systems

• Solid knowledge of lean management, Six Sigma and other process optimization methods

• Proven experience in leading and motivating cross-functional teams

• Strong problem-solving skills and a data-driven approach to decision making combined with a strong focus on safety

• Excellent time management, communication and organizational skills

• Fluent in German and English

More about us

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Chance

Unsere lokale Produktgruppe Insulation & Components ist Technologieführer in der Entwicklung und Herstellung von Hochspannungstransformatordurchführungen. Wenn Sie eine Leidenschaft für Führung und Hochspannungstests haben, bieten wir Ihnen die Bühne, um echte Veränderungen herbeizuführen und die Zukunft unserer Produktionsprozesse aktiv zu gestalten.

Wie Sie eine Wirkung erzielen werden

• Führen Sie das Laborteam, einschließlich Ressourcenmanagement und Teamentwicklung (15 FTE) und fungieren Sie als Ansprechpartner für HV-Tests in Zürich-Altstetten MICAFIL

• Gewährleistung einer hohen Leistung durch zuverlässige Hochspannungsprüfverfahren (AC, DC, Impuls, Teilentladung)

• Identifizieren und integrieren Sie neue Technologien und Best Practices, um den kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprozess (CIP) gemeinsam mit Ihrem Team und unserem Process Engineering Team voranzutreiben

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Planung, Qualitätssicherung, Logistik, anderen Produktionsabteilungen und relevanten Stakeholdern für ganzheitliche Prozessgestaltung und -verbesserung

• Verantwortung für optimale Arbeits- und Wartungsanweisungen und andere relevante Vorschriften (z.B. ISO, Lean, Six Sigma)

• Als People Manager sind Sie dafür verantwortlich, die Einhaltung der geltenden externen und internen Vorschriften, Verfahren und Richtlinien sicherzustellen.

Dein Hintergrund

• Technische Ausbildung und Qualifikationen (Bachelor / Master) im Bereich Elektrotechnik oder gleichwertig

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Führungsposition (High-Voltage Testing/Isolation Technology/Power Engineering)

• Fundiertes Wissen in Hochvoltanlagen, Generatoren und Automatisierungssystemen

• Solides Wissen über Lean Management, Six Sigma und andere Prozessoptimierungsmethoden

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Leitung und Motivation von funktionsübergreifenden Teams

• Starke Problemlösungsfähigkeiten und ein datengesteuerter Entscheidungsansatz kombiniert mit einem starken Fokus auf Sicherheit

• Ausgezeichnetes Zeitmanagement, Kommunikation und organisatorische Fähigkeiten

• Fließend in Deutsch und Englisch

Mehr über uns

Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsweisen helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
